jobs.title: Global Director, Mid-Market Onboarding
Software Engineer, Mobile Core (Android)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is building the operating system for knowledge work, and we want people to be able to do substantive knowledge work from their phone.

A great native app is what makes that possible. On Android, that means Notion should feel like it was built for the platform: fast to open, smooth to scroll, and reliable offline or on a spotty connection. We’re investing in a more native foundation for how people read, write, and edit in Notion. That lets users capture ideas in the moment, find answers across their workspace, manage tasks and projects, and work with teammates, with the speed, polish, and dependability people expect from the best apps on their phone.

As an Android engineer, you’ll help build that native foundation, from how pages render and how people write and edit, to the navigation and app chrome people use every day, like Home, Search, and Inbox, along with the shared frameworks the rest of the app is built on. You’ll work across the Android stack, with chances to dig into our shared Rust layer and the AI tools we use for mobile development. Along the way, you’ll pair with experienced product and mobile AI engineers to find what slows the team down, try new Android capabilities, and help decide what ships in the app.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Ship the core Notion experience on Android: Build and polish the surfaces people use every day—opening and reading pages, writing and editing, navigating the app, and the Home, Search, and Inbox tabs—on a native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose stack that is fast to open, smooth to scroll, and dependable offline.

 - Build with product and design, and iterate fast: Partner with product managers and designers to turn ideas into shipped features, then use feedback and data to make them better. Use AI coding tools and agents to build, test, and investigate faster, while you stay accountable for review, validation, and quality.

 - By the end of your first year, own a core product area: Take a core part of the Android app, like Home, Inbox, or a piece of the editor, from idea to launch, and shape it into an experience that helps people do their life’s work from their phone.

 - Make the app feel fast and reliable: Find and fix issues in startup time, scrolling, typing latency, crashes, and memory use across the surfaces you own, and add the tests and monitoring that catch regressions before users do.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Solid Android fundamentals: You’ve built and shipped Android apps, through work, internships, or your own projects, and you’re comfortable with modern Android—Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines/Flow, and Gradle. Experience with a large, modular codebase is a plus.

 - Care for native UI and performance: You enjoy making UI feel fast and smooth, and you’re curious about things like custom text rendering, complex lazy lists, or rich-text editing. Experience with performance profiling, realtime collaboration, or offline sync is a plus.

 - Product instincts: You care about how the app feels to use, not just how it works. You sweat the details of interactions and polish, and you use feedback and data to decide what to build next.

 - Thoughtful problem-solving and clear communication: You build a clear picture of the problem before jumping to a fix, you can explain trade-offs in writing, and you ask for help early when you’re stuck. Experience moving a hybrid or web-based surface to native, or building something from 0→1, is a plus.

 - AI-native, end-to-end engineering practice: You use AI tools and agents as real collaborators, framing tasks clearly, reviewing generated changes, testing behavior, and designing workflows that make the broader team more effective. Web experience (TypeScript, React, Node) is welcome but not required.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Digital Experience & Website Lead – 12 month FTC
jobs.description:
What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.


A feel for our culture:

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.


Does this sound like you?
Flagstone is entering a pivotal phase for its website – a full redesign and relaunch, running alongside a parallel Brand refresh. We're looking for a senior website and digital experience leader to own this as a strategic programme, and to act as the Squad Lead for the WWW (website) Squad, leading our cross-functional team, spanning Product, UX, Data, Engineering & Digital Marketing.

Sitting within our Product function, you'll set the direction and commercial strategy for the site, sequence the programme, and coordinate contributors across Brand, Marketing, Growth/Creative, Data, and Tech – while giving your team the space to execute against a clear plan. You've owned a public website as a commercial and brand-critical asset before, and you'll need minimal supervision on process: you're trusted to run the show, escalating only what genuinely needs senior leadership's input rather than day-to-day noise.

You might currently hold a title such as Head of Website, Head of Web Experience, Head of Conversion Rate Optimisation, or Digital Product Marketing Lead. What matters most is that you've owned a website end-to-end as a revenue and brand-driving channel, with a strong track record in CRO, experimentation, and digital experience at scale.


What you’ll do:

  • Own the strategy, commercial roadmap and outcomes for the website redesign and relaunch, working hand-in-hand with the Brand team so the two workstreams land as one coherent outcome.

  • Lead the cross-functional Website squad – setting priorities, unblocking the team, and holding the group (product, UX, data, engineering, digital marketing) to a shared plan.

  • Design and run the end-to-end programme: sequencing dependencies across product, marketing, creative, data, and engineering, and keeping it on track without needing to escalate routine issues upward.

  • Define the strategic direction for site structure, customer journeys, and conversion approach, translating business goals into a clear plan the team can execute against.

  • Represent the website programme to senior stakeholders – bringing clarity and options, not problems, to conversations with the Senior Leadership Team.

  • Set the standards and guardrails for how experimentation, CRO, and iterative. improvement will work post-relaunch, handing over a structured, sustainable operating model.

  • Manage risk and trade-offs across the programme – commercial, technical, brand, and customer experience – and make the calls needed to keep momentum.

  • Build strong working relationships with Brand, Marketing, UX, Engineering, and third-party partners/agencies, ensuring the programme benefits from – rather than competes with – parallel initiatives.

  • Coach and line manage Product managers within the WWW squad to deliver high-quality outcomes.

What you’ll bring:

  • Proven experience owning a public-facing website as a commercial and brand asset – ideally as a Head of Website, Head of Web Experience, Head of CRO, or equivalent digital/marketing leadership title – through a redesign or relaunch from strategy through to delivery.

  • Deep experience with conversion rate optimisation, experimentation, and website analytics, with the judgement to know how much to own directly versus delegate.

  • Strong data analytics skills, with hands-on experience using product analytics tools (ideally Heap or similar) to inform decisions and track programme impact.

  • Experience leading a genuinely cross-functional team (product, UX, data, engineering, marketing), ideally in a scale-up or fast-moving environment.

  • A track record of running complex, multi-stream programmes of work with minimal oversight – comfortable owning ambiguity and making decisions.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting to and managing expectations of senior leadership.

  • A strategic mindset paired with enough tactical fluency to know when to step in and when to trust your team.

  • Familiarity with CMS platforms and working with third-party agencies and/or engineering teams to deliver change.

  • Strong written and verbal communication – you can turn a strategic vision into a plan others can execute against.

Nice to haves

  • Experience running a redesign alongside a parallel brand or rebrand workstream.

  • Background in financial services or fintech, particularly regulated environments.

  • Familiarity with agile ways of working and cross-functional delivery models.

  • Experience with tools such as VWO, Umbraco, or similar CMS/experimentation platforms.

 

How we reward you:

At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits:

  • Hybrid working - Spend at least 1 day a week with your team in our collaborative London office

  • Competitive bonus scheme - designed to reward and recognise high performance

  • Flexible benefits budget - a pot to fund meaningful benefits for you, whether it's hormone or fertility testing, cancer screening, neuro-diversity coaching or something that matters for you.

  • A range of salary sacrifice options to help you make tax efficient savings on electric cars, nursery schemes, home and tech goods.

  • Around the World scheme - 3 months work from anywhere scheme (some exclusions do apply)

  • Mental wellbeing support – Access therapy and mental health sessions through Spill

  • Learning and development – £1,000 personal development budget to help you grow in your role.

  • Private health care - Enjoy all the benefits AXA has to offer, including reduced gym memberships and medical history disregarded

  • Medical cash plan - To help you with the costs of dental and optical expenses

  • Life insurance and Income Protection- four times your annual salary for peace of mind

  • Matched pension contributions up to 5%

  • 25 days holiday - plus bank holidays, well-being days and volunteering days

  • Enhanced Parental Leave – enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay.  


All are welcome.

At Flagstone, we’re assembling a diverse team that defies our industry’s norms. Think this role could suit you? We encourage you to apply, no matter your background.

jobs.title: Engineering Team Lead - 12 month FTC
jobs.description:
What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.


A feel for our culture:

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.


Does this sound like you?

You're a hands-on Engineering Lead, ideally with around 10 years' experience, ready to run a squad with real autonomy. You'll lead the Banks squad on the Bank Portal, the partner-facing application our banking partners use to view and act on their Flagstone relationship. By the time you start, the squad will have delivered the foundational rebuild (migrating banks off the legacy tool to full feature parity), and you'll pick up the next phase: building the commercial capability on top of that foundation and turning the portal into a genuine commercial engine for the partnership.

This is a full-stack squad (.NET backend, React/TypeScript frontend) working in a regulated, data-sensitive environment, so the role carries real weight: partner-facing delivery, strict data isolation between banks, and the judgement calls that come with both.


What you’ll do:
You'll own the squad's technical direction and quarterly roadmap, not just participate in it, driving the commercial features that build on the migrated foundation (self-serve rate changes, new product submissions, liquidity data) while keeping the newly-migrated platform stable and any remaining cohorts or legacy decommissioning on track. You'll make most technical debt and risk calls autonomously, escalating only where tribe-level coordination is genuinely needed.

On people, you'll run day-to-day delivery and performance management, including the harder conversations, handling underperformance and any exits directly rather than deferring them upward. Within the FTC's 12 months, expect the emphasis to sit more on driving commercial delivery at pace than on longer-term development pathways, though coaching engineers and creating stretch opportunities is still part of the job.

You'll also work as a peer across the tribe: contributing to engineering-wide standards, comparing notes with other Team Leads, and representing the squad's constraints and progress in tribe-level planning.

 
What you’ll bring:
We're a Microsoft shop: C#/.NET is our core backend language, on Azure, cloud-first. The Bank Portal specifically runs on .NET (Aspire, Duende BFF, YARP) with a React/TypeScript frontend, so while backend depth is the priority, comfort reviewing across a full-stack architecture matters more here than on a purely backend squad.

We'd like to see a good mix of:

  • Strong commercial C#/.NET experience, with a solid grasp of SOLID, event-driven architecture and DDD

  • RESTful API design and SQL skills

  • Cloud-native Azure development

  • Enough frontend fluency to review React/TypeScript work, even if you're not hands-on day to day

  • TDD in practice (NUnit, MSTest, Playwright/Selenium or similar)

  • Experience with agentic development tools (Claude Code or similar)

  • Comfort working in a regulated or data-sensitive environment, this squad enforces strict per-bank data isolation and audit logging as a core part of the architecture

  • Comfort working in an agile environment, and being the final escalation point for decision making

  • An ability to assess and weigh risk, making sound, defensible decisions rather than deferring by default

And on the people side:

  • A track record of direct, fair performance management, including the difficult conversations

  • Confident stakeholder management, and the ability to translate technical trade-offs for non-technical audiences

  • Genuine enthusiasm for coaching and developing engineers

  • Proactive, collaborative problem-solving

 

How we reward you:

At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits:

  • Hybrid working - Pop into our London office to spend time with team

  • Competitive bonus scheme - designed to reward and recognise high performance

  • Flexible benefits budget - a pot to fund meaningful benefits for you, whether it's hormone or fertility testing, cancer screening, neuro-diversity coaching or something that matters for you.

  • A range of salary sacrifice options to help you make tax efficient savings on electric cars, nursery schemes, home and tech goods.

  • Around the World scheme - 3 months work from anywhere scheme (some exclusions do apply)

  • Mental wellbeing support – Access therapy and mental health sessions through Spill

  • Learning and development – £1,000 personal development budget to help you grow in your role.

  • Private health care - Enjoy all the benefits AXA has to offer, including reduced gym memberships and medical history disregarded

  • Medical cash plan - To help you with the costs of dental and optical expenses

  • Life insurance and Income Protection- four times your annual salary for peace of mind

  • Matched pension contributions up to 5%

  • 25 days holiday - plus bank holidays, well-being days and volunteering days

  • Enhanced Parental Leave – enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Defence-Tech-Scale-up · C-UAS / Drohnenabwehrsysteme · München

Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes europäisches Defence-Tech-Unternehmen, das technologisch anspruchsvolle unbemannte Systeme für militärische Anwender entwickelt und bereits international im Markt aktiv ist.

Für die nächste Wachstumsphase suchen wir einen Chief Technology Officer (m/w/d), der die Verantwortung für Engineering und die technologische Weiterentwicklung des Produktportfolios übernimmt.

Die Rolle verbindet strategische Technologieverantwortung mit Organisationsaufbau: Du skalierst eine bereits etablierte Engineering-Organisation, entwickelst die Produktarchitektur weiter und treibst den Ausbau eines zukunftsorientierten Portfolios software-definierter Produkte voran, das Hardware und Software zu integrierten Lösungen vereint.

Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die Führung und Weiterentwicklung der Engineering-Organisation
  • Du baust eine belastbare zweite Führungsebene mit Engineering- und Team-Leads auf und rekrutierst dafür die passenden Führungskräfte
  • Du entwickelst Strukturen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Ownership so weiter, dass Engineering auch bei starkem Wachstum effizient funktioniert
  • Du stellst Projekt- und Produktteams mit den richtigen technischen Kompetenzen zusammen
  • Du stärkst Software Engineering innerhalb der Organisation und entwickelst Hardware- und Softwareentwicklung zu einer integrierten software-defined Entwicklung weiter
  • Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit dem Management die technologische Ausrichtung neuer Produkte
  • Du stellst sicher, dass neue Entwicklungen nicht nur als kurzfristige Prototypen entstehen, sondern architektonisch die Grundlage für ein skalierbares und ausbaufähiges Produktportfolio bilden
  • Du entwickelst die Zusammenarbeit und Abgrenzung zwischen Engineering und Product Management weiter
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Business Development und Product zusammen und bewertest neue Kundenanforderungen hinsichtlich technischer Machbarkeit, Aufwand und strategischem Fit
  • Du bist technischer Sparringspartner des Gründers und des übrigen Managementteams

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Führungs- und Managementerfahrung in technischen Organisationen
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Skalierung von Engineering-Teams
  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Defence-Umfeld und ein gutes Verständnis militärischer Nutzer, Anforderungen und Rahmenbedingungen
  • Ein ausgeprägtes software-defined Mindset bei gleichzeitig gutem Verständnis physischer Systeme
  • Erfahrung mit komplexen Produkten, bei denen Hardware und Software eng zusammenspielen
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Embedded Software, Echtzeitsystemen, Robotik, autonomen Systemen oder vergleichbaren cyber-physischen Systemen
  • Berührungspunkte mit Hardwareentwicklung, beispielsweise Elektronik, Mechanik oder Verbundwerkstoffen
  • Ausreichende technische Tiefe, um Architekturentscheidungen einzuordnen und erfahrene Engineers fachlich zu führen
  • Erfahrung in einem schnell wachsenden Start-up oder Scale-up ist ein großer Vorteil

Ein Background bei einem etablierten Defence- oder Aerospace-Unternehmen kann ebenfalls sehr gut passen – insbesondere dann, wenn du bereits Erfahrung außerhalb klassischer Konzernstrukturen gesammelt hast.

Was uns wichtig ist

Wir suchen nicht zwingend jemanden, der bereits CTO war.

Entscheidend ist, dass du die Führungs- und Managementerfahrung sowie die technische Reife mitbringst, um eine wachsende Engineering-Organisation zu führen und weiterzuentwickeln.

Du solltest strategisch denken können, gleichzeitig aber flexibel genug sein, technische Prioritäten anzupassen, wenn sich Kundenanforderungen, Technologien oder operative Rahmenbedingungen verändern.

Ein starrer Mehrjahresplan passt weniger zu dieser Rolle als die Fähigkeit, eine klare technologische Richtung vorzugeben und diese bei Bedarf schnell an neue Realitäten anzupassen.

Was dich erwartet

  • Eine C-Level-Rolle mit direkter Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründer
  • Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum bei Technologie, Organisation und Produktentwicklung
  • Verantwortung für eine bereits etablierte und weiter wachsende Engineering-Organisation
  • Die Möglichkeit, den Übergang hin zu einer stärker software-defined Produktentwicklung maßgeblich zu gestalten
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem, Product Management, Business Development und dem übrigen Management
  • Ein schnell wachsendes Defence-Tech-Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und hoher Eigenverantwortung
  • Standort München mit regelmäßiger persönlicher Präsenz beim Engineering-Team

jobs.title: Senior Talent Partner
jobs.description:
About Legend


At Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company.

Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive.


The Role

We're looking for a Senior Talent Partner who loves the chase and gets results. Someone who knows the gaming talent market inside out, knows where the best people are, and knows how to bring them in.

You'll carry a live portfolio of at least 10 roles at any one time and close at least four a month, across senior, specialist and hard-to-fill searches. You'll partner with senior leaders, challenge thinking that narrows the market, and keep every search moving.

You won't just recruit the way it's always been done. We want someone who brings fresh thinking, uses AI and a modern ATS to work smarter, and helps shape how Talent works at Legend as we grow. For the right person, this role has room to grow into something bigger.


Your Impact
Deliver at pace
•    Run a live portfolio of 10+ roles, closing at least four a month without lowering the hiring bar.
•    Own every search end to end, from intake to accepted offer.
•    Build a clear plan for each role from day one and keep momentum through to close.
•    Use funnel data to spot blockers early, make decisions and keep searches moving.
•    Set clear expectations with hiring managers and hold yourself and them to account.

Find the talent others miss
•    Use your gaming and iGaming network to reach people who aren't looking, and know when to go wide and when to go deep.
•    Map markets across locations, competitors and adjacent sectors, and build pipelines for future needs, not just today's vacancies.
•    Write outreach that stands out and gets replies from people who ignore most recruiters.
•    Use market and pay insight to challenge assumptions about where talent sits and what it costs.
•    Build relationships with great people long before there's a role for them.

Change how we hire
•    Use AI across the hiring process, from research, mapping and sourcing to outreach, interview design and reporting.
•    Get the most from our ATS and automation to cut out low-value admin.

In this role you will collaborate across product development teams and help shape the direction of the organization.

  • Participate in developing methodologies for chip test and validation from requirements through tape-out.
  • Contribute towards the continuous development of Tools, Technology and Flows.
  • Foster a culture of continuous engineering improvement through mentorship, feedback, and metrics.  
  • Develop training and documentation, supporting your team and product development.
  • Work with peers to implement best practices and continuous improvements to Cirrus Logic characterization and validation methodologies.
  • Collaborate closely with IC Design engineers, Systems engineers, and Application Engineers to collaborate in test and validation methodologies.

    • Required Skills and Qualifications
  • Bachelor's/master's degree in electrical engineering with proven experience in silicon test and characterization projects.
  • Experience leading engineers or technical projects, whether as a people manager or a technical lead.

jobs.description:
Pedagogisk- psykologisk rådgiver

Veiledningssenteret Asker og Bærum har en fast stilling ledig fra 01.01.27 og et vikariat ledig fra 01.01.27 til 31.12.27.

Stillingene er i PP-tjenesten for videregående opplæring i Asker og Bærum. Veiledningssenteret består av pedagogisk psykologisk tjeneste (PPT), oppfølgingstjenesten, karrieretjenesten og voksenopplæring.

Veiledningssenteret har 30 ansatte, hvorav 15 ansatte i PPT. 

PPT skal hjelpe skolene i arbeid med kompetanseutvikling og organisasjonsutvikling for å legge opplæringen til rette for elever med særskilte behov. Vi arbeider system- og individrettet og samhandler tett med skolene i regionen.

For mer informasjon om veiledningssenteret se Veiledningssentrene i Akershus

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • utføre sakkyndighetsarbeid i tråd med lov og forskrifter
  • gi veiledning og direkte hjelp til elever og lærlinger
  • samarbeide med skolene om tilrettelegging av opplæringen

Kvalifikasjoner

  • master i pedagogisk-psykologisk rådgivning, spesialpedagogikk, psykologi eller utdanning som psykolog
  • relevant erfaring fra PPT er ønskelig

Personlige egenskaper

  • proaktiv og engasjert medarbeider
  • gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter
  • utviklingsorientert med god gjennomføringsevne

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.

Vi tilbyr

  • faglig utvikling innen tjenestens ansvarsområder
  • et godt arbeidsfellesskap
  • sentral beliggenhet på Sandvika videregående skole
  • lønns- og arbeidsvilkår fastsatt i lov- og avtaleverk
Ansettelsesform: Fast ansettelse.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Akershus fylkeskommune ønsker medarbeidere som tar en aktiv, engasjert, reflektert og ansvarlig rolle i organisasjonen vår. Hos oss møtes mennesker med ulik kompetanse- og utdanningsbakgrunn for å skape gode tjenester til våre innbyggere. jobs.title: Mekanikkonstruktör till växande bolag
jobs.description:

Har du en passion för mekanisk konstruktion och vill arbeta i en innovativ och tekniskt utmanande miljö? Vill du vara en del av ett engagerat team där du får möjlighet att utvecklas och arbeta med spännande projekt? Då kan detta vara rollen för dig!

Om rollen

Som mekanikkonstruktör hos oss kommer du att arbeta med konstruktion, produktutveckling och tekniska lösningar för både nya och befintliga produkter. Du blir en viktig del av vårt team och bidrar med din expertis i hela utvecklingsprocessen – från idé och design till prototyptillverkning och produktion.

Dina arbetsuppgifter inkluderar:

Konstruktion och utveckling av mekaniska komponenter och system.

3D-modellering och ritningsframtagning i CAD-verktyg (SolidWorks eller Inventor).

Beräkningar och materialval för att optimera konstruktion och hållfasthet.

Framtagning av prototyper och testning av produkter.

Tätt samarbete med kunder, produktion och leverantörer för att säkerställa kvalitet och funktionalitet.

Medverkan i tekniska projekt där du bidrar med innovativa lösningar.

Vem är du?

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är en noggrann och kreativ ingenjör med ett stort teknikintresse. Du trivs med att lösa komplexa problem och har en god förståelse för mekaniska konstruktioner och tillverkningsprocesser.



Vi söker dig som har

Relevant teknisk utbildning,

Erfarenhet av mekanisk konstruktion och produktutveckling, gärna inom industrin.

Goda kunskaper i CAD-verktyg såsom SolidWorks, Creo eller Inventor.

Förståelse för materialval, hållfasthet och produktionsmetoder.

Goda kommunikationsfärdigheter och en förmåga att arbeta både självständigt och i team.

Flytande svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Varför ska du välja oss?

En spännande och omväxlande roll där du får arbeta med tekniskt avancerade projekt.

Möjlighet att utvecklas och växa tillsammans med bolaget

Ett starkt team med kompetenta och engagerade kollegor.

Chansen att påverka och skapa högkvalitativa mekaniska lösningar.

jobs.title: Har du erfaring med kvalitetskontroll og ønsker å bidra til leveranser av avanserte luftvern- og radarsystemer?
jobs.description:
Som Quality Assurance Controller i produksjonen hos Air & Coastal Defence Systems får du en sentral rolle i å sikre kvalitet gjennom hele leveranseløpet – fra montering til ferdig produkt. Du blir en del av et erfarent fagmiljø med høy teknisk kompetanse, der du samarbeider tett med kollegaer fra ulike fagområder for å sikre at produktene oppfyller krav til kvalitet, dokumentasjon og utførelse.

Hos oss får du en variert arbeidshverdag med stort ansvar, korte beslutningsveier og muligheten til å påvirke både produkter og arbeidsprosesser. Trives du med å kombinere detaljfokus, teknisk forståelse og samarbeid med andre, kan dette være rollen for deg.

Din hverdag

Som Quality Assurance Controller vil du følge produktene gjennom produksjonsløpet og sikre at kvaliteten opprettholdes i alle ledd. Du gjennomfører kvalitetskontroller av mekaniske og elektriske komponenter, vurderer utførelse opp mot gjeldende krav og standarder, og sørger for at nødvendig dokumentasjon er på plass.

Du vil arbeide med avviks- og endringshåndtering, gi konstruktive tilbakemeldinger når produkter eller prosesser avviker fra kravene, og bidra til kontinuerlige forbedringer innen kvalitet, montering og produksjon. Rollen innebærer også tett samarbeid med produksjon, engineering og andre fagmiljøer for å utvikle mer effektive arbeidsprosesser, verktøy og løsninger.

Er dette deg?

Du har erfaring med kvalitetsarbeid innen mekanisk produksjon og god forståelse for kvalitetskontroll, konfigurasjonsstyring og tekniske krav. Du er komfortabel med å lese tekniske tegninger og har et godt blikk for detaljer, kvalitet og godt håndverk.

Vi tror du trives med å arbeide strukturert og nøyaktig, samtidig som du evner å se helheten. Du er trygg nok til å gi tilbakemeldinger når kvaliteten ikke er som den skal være, men gjør det på en konstruktiv måte som bidrar til forbedring og samarbeid. Videre tar du initiativ, viser engasjement og liker å finne smartere måter å løse oppgaver på.

Gode samarbeidsevner er viktig, samtidig som du evner å arbeide selvstendig og ta ansvar for egne oppgaver. Du har grunnleggende digitale ferdigheter og kommuniserer godt med kollegaer på tvers av fagområder.

Dette får du hos oss

Hos oss får du arbeide med avanserte produkter og teknologi som stiller høye krav til kvalitet, presisjon og pålitelighet. Du blir en del av et kompetent fagmiljø med stor bredde og erfaring, der kunnskapsdeling, samarbeid og kontinuerlig forbedring står sentralt.

Vi tilbyr spennende og varierte arbeidsoppgaver i et høyteknologisk miljø, med gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling i et internasjonalt selskap. I tillegg får du konkurransedyktige betingelser, solide pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, eget treningssenter, hytteutleie og flere andre velferdsgoder som bidrar til en god balanse mellom jobb og fritid.

Kandidater som søker på stillingen, vil i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprosessen bli gjenstand for bakgrunnssjekk og vurdering av denne vil bli lagt til grunn ved valg av kandidat.For å være aktuell kandidat til stillingen må du være kvalifisert for å bli sikkerhetsklarert, jfr. Sikkerhetsloven.


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Defence Systems er en divisjon i Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace AS. Divisjonen består av fem forretningsenheter som alle utvikler og leverer avanserte og teknologisk ledende kommando-, kontroll-, og kommunikasjonsløsninger. Denne stillingen tilhører Air & Coastal Defence Systems. Vi utvikler og leverer avanserte luftvernsystemer og kystforsvarssystemer. Et av norsk forvarsindustris største eksportsuksesser er NASAMS (National Advanced Surface-to-Air Missile System), og er utviklet på KONGSBERG. NASAMS er et såkalt nettverksbasert og modulært system. Det innebærer samhandling og deling av data, og kan settes sammen på svært fleksibelt vis, alt etter hvilket oppdrag som skal løses.

jobs.title: Vill du vara med och göra skillnad för elevers skolgång?
jobs.description:
Varje dag vill vi på Antonskolan ge alla våra elever goda förutsättningar för utveckling och lärande. Vi arbetar målmedvetet för att alla elever ska ha god måluppfyllelse, så att alla kan nå så långt som möjligt i en trygg och stimulerande miljö. Vi söker nu dig som vill vara med och stötta våra elever under deras skoldag. På köpet får du en bra arbetsplats med engagerade medarbetare och en härlig vi-känsla.

Anton Utbildning har två grundskolor, Antonskolan Blekedamm och Antonskolan Österäng, med årskurserna från förskoleklass till årskurs 9. Vi värnar om små elevgrupper med utbildad personal. Vi tror att detta är förutsättning för att skapa en trygg lärmiljö för våra elever. På Antonskolan arbetar vi värdegrundsbaserat utifrån ANTON-orden Ansvar, Närhet, Trygghet, Omsorg och Nyfikenhet. En värdegrund som vi vill att du delar med oss. Vår profil är internationell förståelse och solidaritet: “Vi utrustar världsmedborgare som gör skillnad”.

ARBETSUPPGIFTER

Arbetet kan innebära att du är resurs både för enskild elev och elever, i klassrummet och på raster. Det kan även innebära arbete som resurs och som fritidspersonal i vårt fritidshem. Ditt arbete kommer ske i samarbete med lärare, andra resurser, personal från elevhälsan och fritidshem.

KVALIFIKATIONER

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn med särskilda behov och kunskap om lågaffektivt bemötande.  

Som person är du lösningsorienterad, trygg och stabil. Har goda kunskaper i att möta elevers olika behov, lätt för att samarbeta och skapa goda relationer. Du har förmåga att såväl se till den enskilda elevens som gruppens behov och skapar tillsammans med eleven/eleverna och personal en positiv miljö som främjar elevens utveckling och lärande. Under hela dagen hjälper du eleverna att lyckas i det sociala samspelet med andra elever.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

ANSTÄLLNINGSVILLKOR

Tjänsten är en elevresursanställning med start enligt överenskommelse. Tjänstgöringsgrad kan diskuteras.

Innan du erbjudits en anställning på Antonskolan måste du lämna ett utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister enligt skollagen 2 kap. 31§.

Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande under ansökningstiden.

Välkommen med ditt personliga brev och cv omgående till nedanstående mail. Ange ”Ansökan resurs” i ämnesraden.

jobs.title: Automationsingenjör med passion för teknik
jobs.description:
Automationsingenjör med passion för teknik – Bli en del av vårt team!

Är du en erfaren automationsingenjör med en bakgrund inom el och automation? Vill du arbeta med spännande projekt i en dynamisk miljö där du får utveckla dina färdigheter inom PLC, HMI och SCADA? Då kan detta vara din nästa stora möjlighet!

Vi söker dig som vill ta nästa steg i karriären och arbeta med innovativa lösningar hos vår kund, med utgångspunkt från Malmö.

Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer att inkludera:

- Programmering och konfigurering av PLC-, HMI- och SCADA-system.

- Medverkan i projekt från idé till färdig lösning – inklusive test och driftsättning.

- Felsökning och problemlösning inom både elektriska system och mjukvara.

- Samarbete med kollegor, kunder och tekniker för att säkerställa smidig projektgenomföring.

- Resor till kunders anläggningar för installation och driftsättning.

Vi söker dig som:

Har flera års erfarenhet som automationsingenjör, gärna inom tillverkningsindustrin.

Besitter gedigen erfarenhet av PLC-programmering (exempelvis Siemens, Mitsubishi, Rockwell eller liknande).

Har arbetat med HMI- och SCADA-system.

Är självgående och van att driva projekt framåt.

Har erfarenhet av felsökning, både elektriskt och inom mjukvara (meriterande).

Innehar B-körkort och är flexibel att resa i tjänsten.

Varför ska du söka?

En spännande och varierad roll med tekniska utmaningar.

En arbetsmiljö där din kompetens värderas och du får utvecklas.

Om du är redo för en ny utmaning och vill bli en del av ett framgångsrikt team – tveka inte att höra av dig!



Har du några funderingar?

Kontakta gärna Jerry Stenberg på jerry.stenberg@prowork.se.



Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

jobs.title: BPA-assistent søkes til aktiv gutt på 9 år - 100% fast,/avlastning/nattevakt
jobs.description:
Jeg er en gutt på 9 år som ser etter noen fine folk som kan bli en del av hverdagen min. Kanskje er du en som liker å være aktiv, kreativ og leken, men som samtidig klarer å være den rolige og trygge voksne når jeg trenger det?

Akkurat nå søker vi først og fremst en assistent i 100 % stilling til og med februar, med mulighet for forlengelse. Det er også aktuelt med mindre faste stillinger og tilkallingsvikarer, så du må gjerne søke selv om fulltid ikke passer for deg.

Først litt om meg:

Jeg er en smilende og pratsom fyr, og det er sjelden stille når jeg først kommer i gang! Jeg liker å tulle, være kreativ og ha noen rundt meg som byr litt på seg selv. De gangene ting blir litt vanskelig, trenger jeg en voksen som klarer å beholde roen selv om jeg ikke gjør det. En som kan hjelpe meg med å skjerme litt, gi meg tid og støtte meg tilbake til en god følelse igjen. Av og til kan jeg teste grenser eller være lite gira på å samarbeide, og da trenger jeg først og fremst at du er trygg, tydelig og tålmodig.

Jeg har Tourettes og ADHD, og det betyr blant annet at det noen ganger kan bli litt mye for både hodet og kroppen min. Hvis det skjer mye rundt meg, planer plutselig endrer seg eller ting ikke blir helt som jeg hadde sett for meg, kan jeg bli urolig eller frustrert. Jeg liker å tegne, male og lage ting, gjerne inspirert av karakterer fra spill og film. Roblox og Minecraft står også ganske høyt på lista, så hvis du synes det er gøy å spille litt sammen med meg, får du fort noen plusspoeng. Jeg liker også å være ute, selv om jeg ikke alltid kommer på ideen helt av meg selv. Med et lite dytt blir jeg gjerne med på tur i skogen eller fjæra, spesielt hvis vi kan lete etter kule steiner til samlingen min. Jeg liker også sykling, trampoline og basketball, så her er det gode muligheter for å være både kreativ og aktiv sammen.

Jeg bor sammen med familien min i et rolig og røykfritt hjem. Her håper jeg å finne en assistent som kan bli en trygg og positiv del av hverdagen min, en som både kan være med på alt det morsomme, og som står stødig ved siden av meg de dagene jeg trenger litt ekstra støtte.

Arbeidstid og sted:

  • Dag, ettermiddag, kveld, natt og helg
  • Det er også mulighet for utvidet arbeidstidsordning og langvakter. Det kan blant annet være aktuelt å jobbe avlastningshelger/langhelger, for eksempel fra fredag til søndag.
  • For deg som liker å jobbe mer sammenhengende og få lengre friperioder mellom arbeidsperiodene, kan dette være en veldig fin måte å organisere arbeidstiden på. Samt kombinere med studier og annen jobb (56 timers vakter)
  • Det vil være mulig å jobbe med studier i dødtid
  • Du kan godt holde til andre steder enn Silsand. Feks. Tromsø/Sørreisa/Bardufoss.

Jeg håper at du er:

  • Rolig, trygg og tålmodig
  • Klarer å være tydelig og trygg
  • Tåler at ting ikke alltid går helt etter planen
  • Gir meg tid til å roe meg ned og omstille meg
  • Kan sette gode og forutsigbare grenser
  • Liker å være aktiv og med på aktiviteter
  • Kan motivere meg når jeg trenger et lite dytt

Har du erfaring med barn, ADHD, Tourettes eller reguleringsvansker er det fint, men personlig egnethet og kjemien mellom oss er viktigst.

Du vil blant annet:

  • Være sammen med meg etter skole, i helger og ellers etter behov
  • Selta i lek, spilling og kreative aktiviteter
  • Motivere meg til å komme meg ut og være i aktivitet
  • Støtte meg når jeg blir overstimulert
  • Hjelpe meg med å finne ro og ta gode pauser
  • Skape struktur og forutsigbarhet rundt dagen
  • Hjelpe meg med gode rammer rundt spilling og skjermtid
  • Støtte meg ved måltider, hygiene og andre daglige rutiner
  • Det vil også være noen praktiske oppgaver knyttet til hverdagen min, som å lage enkle måltider, rydde etter aktiviteter og gjøre lett renhold.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg?

Vi søker deg som har lyst til å bli kjent med meg og være en stabil del av hverdagen min over tid.

Det viktigste er ikke om du kan alt fra før. Det viktigste er at du er villig til å lære, at du møter meg med ro og respekt, og at du klarer å være trygg også de dagene jeg trenger litt mer av deg.

Kanskje er du akkurat den trygge voksne jeg trenger på laget mitt?

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Boendestödjare till gruppbostad
jobs.description:
Vill du erbjudas ett spännande och utvecklande jobb samtidigt som du arbetar för att dagligen ge människor ett bra liv? Vill du dessutom få möjlighet att utvecklas på ett företag som har engagemang, glädje och ansvar som ledord? Då har du möjligheten att söka jobb hos oss på Humana. I rollen kommer du tillsammans med oss att arbeta efter vår vision – Alla har rätt till ett bra liv.

Om oss

Gruppbostad

Gruppboende för vuxna som omfattas av LSS personkrets 1, med individuellt anpassat stöd utifrån den enskildes behov. Vi arbetar med tydliggörande pedagogik och lågaffektivt bemötande. Boendet ligger i lugnt villaområde med närhet till både natur och Nässjö centrum.

Om tjänsten

Vi söker nu en ny boendestödjare till vår verksamhet. Som boendestödjare arbetar du med människor som behöver stöd med sin dagliga livsföring. Du arbetar både självständigt och i nära samarbete med kollegor.

I rollen arbetar du med att:

    

Ge individuellt stöd, omvårdnad och serviceinsatser

    

Planerar och genomför aktiviteter med klienten

    

Genomför delegerade hälso- och sjukvårdsuppgifter

Anställningsvillkor

Exempel: Vi söker nu en medarbetare för en tillsvidareanställning, vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning. Tjänsten är på 100% och arbetstiderna är varierande dag, kväll och helg.

Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning och övriga ersättningar sker enligt kollektivavtal. Tillträde för tjänsten sker enligt överenskommelse.

Vem är du?

Som person är du serviceinriktad, uppmärksam och tillmötesgående. Tjänsten som boendestödjare ställer även krav på tålamod, flexibilitet och lyhördhet. Som medarbetare på Humana tar vi ett gemensamt ansvar för vår arbetsmiljö och strävar efter att skapa ett gott klimat på enheten och i arbetsgruppen genom ett respektfullt bemötande. Stor vikt kommer därför att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

För att söka tjänsten krävs det att du har:  

    

Utbildning som undersköterska, specialpedagog eller beteendevetare

    

Erfarenhet från liknande verksamhet

    

Kunskaper inom lågaffektivt bemötande, tydliggörande pedagogik

    

Goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift då dokumentation är en stor del av arbetet

    

B-körkort

Vi erbjuder

Engagerade kollegor som har en god sammanhållning och drivs av viljan att förbättra kvaliteten i vår verksamhet. Humana har kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, försäkringar, friskvårdsbidrag samt en intern lärportal med ett brett utbud av utbildningar.

Vad händer nu?

Vi ser gärna att du ansöker snarast då vi går igenom urvalet löpande och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdag.

Vill du veta mer om tjänsten eller rekryteringsprocessen är du varmt välkommen att kontakta oss!

Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Julehjelp/sesonghjelp
jobs.description:
Er du den beste til å jobbe i vår butikk? 

Til vår butikk i Tønsberg søker vi nå etter en serviceinnstilt sesongmedarbeider/julehjelper. Stillingen vil vare fra oktober frem til slutten av desember/begynnelsen av januar.

I tillegg til faste vakter er det ønskelig at du er fleksibel til å ta ekstravakter ved behov.

Vi søker deg som har en utpreget serviceinnstilling med glimt i øyet, og som trives med salg og butikkarbeid. Du jobber etter våre verdier og sørger for at vi skaper markedets beste kjøpsopplevelse. 

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Aktivt salgsarbeid
  • Varehåndtering og vareeksponering
  • Varetelling
  • Sikre at butikken er innbydende og selgende
  • Kasseoppgjør
  • Rutiner som delegeres fra butikkleder

 Nøkkelkvalifikasjoner 

  • Salgsorientert
  • Erfaring fra salg/service, gjerne fra detaljhandel er ønskelig, men ikke et krav
  • Ansvarsbevisst og pliktoppfyllende
  • Trives med salg og butikkarbeid
  • Engasjert og blid
  • Over 18 år  

 

Å jobbe i butikk medfører spennende og varierte arbeidsoppgaver. Vi er en kjede i positiv utvikling som satser på våre medarbeidere i et trivelig og uformelt miljø. Gode karrieremessige muligheter, og gunstig personalrabatt ordning. Lønn etter tariff.

 

Søknadsfrist snarest. Søknader behandles fortløpende, og kun søknader som sendes elektronisk blir vurdert. Vi har desverre ikke kapasitet til å håndtere søknader som kommer via e-post. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Christiania Glasmagasin er blant Norges eldste og mest anerkjente handelsbedrifter. Siden 1739 har det vært et veletablert konsept som står for kvalitet og trygghet. I de senere år har Christiania Glasmagasin utviklet og fornyet seg til å bli en landsomfattende, moderne butikkjede med butikker over hele Norge. Du finner et stort utvalg av glass, servise, kjøkkenartikler og gaver til enhver anledning. jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THIS JOB

We're looking for a Head of Marketing Strategy & Operations to run the business side of marketing. Our marketing team went from two people to 25 this year, organized around four functions: product marketing, brand and consumer, enterprise, and growth. This is the first operations hire on that team. You'll own the marketing budget with Finance, run our planning cycle and operating cadence, keep hiring aligned with the plan, and partner directly with the CMO on how marketing sets priorities and tells its story to the executive team and the board.

It's a role for someone who has sat close to a CMO and a CFO, likes turning ambiguity into a plan people can execute, and is comfortable building the function themselves before building a team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Budget & Financial Operations

 - Own the marketing budget end to end with Finance: allocation across teams and channels, tracking against plan, forecasting, variance flags, and the tradeoff conversations that follow

 - Build the layer of visibility leadership needs (spend by team, channel, and program) on top of the spend-tracking tools we already have, so decisions get made with numbers

 - Run quarterly, half-year, and annual budget planning, and make marketing's case to Finance and the executive team

 - Own marketing's vendor and agency contracts end to end: evaluations, procurement, renewals, and a clear view of what we pay for and why



Planning & Operating Cadence

 - Own marketing's planning cycle: translate company goals into marketing objectives, OKRs, and resourced plans, and keep them current as priorities shift

 - Bring a point of view. Pressure-test plans, frame the tradeoffs, and help the CMO decide where marketing places its bets

 - Design the lightweight processes and internal tools (planning, intake, reporting) that let a 25-person team operate like a much bigger one

 - Run the operating rhythm for the marketing leadership team: meetings, all-hands, team-wide readouts, agendas, decisions, and follow-through

 - Keep the marketing functions connected so plans, launches, and budgets move together



Executive Partnership

 - Partner directly with the CMO on board materials, executive readouts, and strategy documents. Own first drafts and make them data-backed and on-message

 - Extend the CMO's reach across the team: surface risks early, chase decisions to closure, and keep priorities clear week to week

 - Represent marketing in cross-functional planning with Finance, Sales, and Product



Hiring & Org Operations

 - Partner with Talent Acquisition and marketing leads on headcount planning, requisition tracking, and interview process, and keep hiring plans aligned with budget and org design

 - Standardize the basics across sub-teams (job descriptions, interview loops, scorecards) and help new leaders land well




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 10+ years in marketing strategy and operations, business operations, strategic finance, management consulting, or a similar role supporting a CMO, GM, or business unit leader

 - You've owned a sizable marketing or departmental budget end to end and can talk about spend, forecast, and variance the way Finance does

 - You've built or run a planning cycle (annual or half-year, OKRs) and an operating cadence for a leadership team

 - You've drafted board or executive materials for a senior leader and know the difference between a readout and a narrative

 - Experience with headcount planning and hiring operations alongside a Talent team

 - You've run vendor evaluations and procurement alongside Finance and kept a clean view of contracts and renewals

 - Comfortable as an individual contributor. This is the first ops hire; you'll do the work before you have a team

jobs.title: People Partner Lead, Germany & Sweden
jobs.description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Why this role exists

You’ll help build Neko’s clinical organisation in Germany from the ground up, and then lead the people strategy that helps it scale.

Neko’s clinics are where our mission comes to life. The experience members have is shaped by the teams behind it, making the organisation itself one of the most important products we build. In Germany, this organisation doesn’t exist yet. Before the first clinic opens, you’ll help define clinical roles, workforce planning, compensation, and the employee experience that attracts exceptional talent. Then, as clinics launch and grow, you’ll partner with leaders to ensure those teams perform, develop, and scale successfully.

This is a rare opportunity to build an organisation from day one – and to shape what it becomes as Neko brings prevention-first healthcare to another market.

Phase one: build the foundation, pre-launch

  • Ensure the German employment framework is appropriately set up with legal, external counsel, key internal teams, like People Ops and Workforce Planning – contracts, working-time and rostering models, pay structures, policies, payroll and people systems

  • Design the clinic organisation from a blank sheet, and a staffing model sized to Neko’s ambition for the market rather than to the first clinic

  • Own the launch workforce plan, the cover and contracting model, and reward in a German context – pay, pension, equity

  • Build a German clinical employer proposition from zero with TA, and a playbook the next market can reuse

Build for German employment structures from day one

  • Design workforce policies (scheduling, pay, performance) with German labor law and employee representation requirements in mind from the start

  • Work with legal counsel to determine the right structure for German clinic operations

  • Ensure people systems and tools are built to comply with German labor regulations

Phase two: run clinical people strategy live

  • Be the day-to-day People partner across German clinical leadership, from senior operations and medical leaders through to frontline clinic managers

  • Spend real time in clinics, and read what members experience there as signal about how teams are resourced, structured and led – spotting strain, inconsistency or risk early, because it usually shows up in the clinic room before it shows up in the data

  • Coach clinic leaders through hiring, performance and the conversations that are hard but important – and build the leadership capability and multi-way feedback culture that keep employee relations issues from piling up, while supporting teams and leaders through the ones that do

  • Support first-time clinic managers as they build confidence, capability and steady leadership habits

  • Hold the staffing model against the growth plan: German absence, leave and part-time realities, the clinical qualification and mobility pipeline, and honesty when the plan and the labour market disagree

  • Turn central People programmes into clinic-ready practice, and call out where a centralised approach misses frontline reality

  • Revisit what you built pre-launch as clinics run, and put data and AI to work in how the People agenda actually operates – sharper decisions, less manual effort, more time on the judgement calls

  • Take change from decision to genuine adoption, bringing clinic teams with you without pausing delivery to do it

Beyond Germany

  • Help drive the global People Partner team’s clinical strategy rather than just feed into it

  • Bring the German clinical reality into that team's agenda, so decisions made at scale hold up on the ground

  • Support the wider European market as it grows, and other markets as needed

What you bring

  • 8+ years as a senior People or HR Business Partner leader, across senior levels of leadership and frontline leaders of larger teams

  • A builder's mindset – comfortable starting from a blank sheet, having opened or scaled operations in Germany or built a German people function from close to nothing

  • Deep, practical command of German employment law and co-determination, with the judgement to know when to bring in counsel

  • Germany is the core requirement; multi-market European experience is strongly preferred – you have worked across more than one European employment landscape (Sweden a significant plus) and know what scales beyond a single market

  • Has built a staffing model that had to scale on an opening cadence, and has localised reward in Germany – pay, pension, equity

  • Comfortable in both phases – the ambiguity of pre-launch and the discipline of running something live

  • Moves at the pace of the business and leads people through change – you have taken teams through reorganisations, new operating models or rapid scaling, and kept trust and delivery intact while doing it

  • A local delivery mandate and a real seat in cross-market strategy, held at the same time, at pace

  • Fluent with people data and using AI in your own work, and ties people decisions to what members actually experience in the room

  • Fluent German and English, based in Berlin, and ready to spend regular time in clinics

jobs.title: Social Media Manager (m/w/d) – Werkstudent
jobs.description:
DEINE ROLLE

Du bist auf Instagram, LinkedIn & Co. zu Hause, hast ein gutes Gespür für Content und kannst selbst starke Posts, Reels und Stories produzieren? Du interessierst dich außerdem für Wirtschaft, Investments und die Welt rund um Vermögen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Als Social Media Manager (m/w/d) unterstützt du uns dabei, unsere Social-Media-Kanäle weiterzuentwickeln – von der ersten Content-Idee über die Produktion bis zur Veröffentlichung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Content-, Brand- und Podcast-Team zusammen und bringst deine eigenen Ideen und dein Gespür für guten Social Content ein.

Von Anfang an übernimmst du Verantwortung für eigene Themen und Formate. Ob Social Posts, Reels, Podcast-Clips oder Event-Content: Du hilfst uns dabei, komplexe Finanz- und Investmentthemen verständlich, relevant und visuell stark für Social Media aufzubereiten.

Was machst du dabei konkret?

  • Social Media & Planung: Du betreust unsere Kanäle auf Instagram, LinkedIn und Facebook und planst gemeinsam mit dem Team, welche Themen und Formate wann und wo stattfinden.

  • Content Creation: Du entwickelst Posts, Carousels, Reels und Stories von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung. Gleichzeitig machst du aus bestehenden Inhalten wie Magazinartikeln, Marktkommentaren, Interviews, Events oder Expertengesprächen eigenständigen Social Content – von starken Hooks und Captions bis zu Recaps und Key Takeaways.

  • Podcast & Video: Du unterstützt bei der Produktion von That’s Smart Money und entwickelst aus unseren Gesprächen relevante Clips und Short-Form-Content. Dabei arbeitest du unter anderem mit Riverside und unseren Video-Tools.

  • Trends & neue Ideen: Du beobachtest, welche Formate und Mechaniken auf Social Media funktionieren, und überlegst, was davon zu LIQID passt. Gute Ideen sollst du bei uns nicht nur vorschlagen, sondern auch ausprobieren können.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Du verstehst Social Media und hast bereits selbst Content gemacht: Ob für einen eigenen Account, ein Projekt, dein Studium oder ein Unternehmen, ist für uns zweitrangig. Entscheidend ist, dass du ein gutes Gespür dafür hast, was auf Social Media funktioniert.

  • Du kannst Geschichten erzählen und richtig gut schreiben: Du erkennst den interessanten Gedanken in einem Thema, findest einen starken Einstieg und kannst auch komplexere Inhalte verständlich und präzise auf den Punkt bringen.

  • Du hast ein gutes visuelles Gespür und Lust auf Produktion: Fotografie, Typografie, Layout und Video interessieren dich und du setzt Content gerne selbst um. Erfahrung mit Riverside, CapCut, Premiere oder ähnlichen Tools ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

  • Du packst selbst an: Du arbeitest eigenständig und zuverlässig, bringst Ideen mit und hast Lust, Verantwortung für eigene Themen und Formate zu übernehmen.

  • Du bist neugierig auf Finanzthemen: Du musst noch kein Investment-Profi sein. Aber Wirtschaft, Märkte und Investments interessieren dich und du hast Lust, dich auch in komplexere Themen einzuarbeiten.

  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team: Du hast Spaß daran, gemeinsam mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Content, Brand, Podcast und anderen Bereichen aus einer guten Idee richtig guten Content zu machen.

So geht es für dich weiter

Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte – und geben dir gleichzeitig die Möglichkeit, LIQID und das Team kennenzulernen.

  • Erstes virtuelles Kennenlernen mit unserer Social Media Managerin Verena: Wir tauschen uns darüber aus, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen.

  • Kleine praktische Aufgabe: Du bekommst eine Aufgabe, die sich an typischen Themen aus deinem zukünftigen Arbeitsalltag orientiert. So sehen wir, wie du Content denkst und umsetzt – und du bekommst einen konkreten Eindruck von der Rolle.

  • Gespräch mit unserer Hiring Managerin Lenika & Team: Wir tauchen tiefer in die Rolle ein, sprechen über deine bisherigen Erfahrungen und geben dir einen Einblick in unsere Content- und Social-Media-Arbeit.

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem betreuten Vermögen von über 4 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen.

LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt.

  • Learn how a company gets built, from the people building it. You work directly with the founders and see every decision from the inside: what works, what breaks, and why.

Responsibilities

  • Growth Projects: You work directly with the founders on whatever moves Uplane forward right now: scaling the team internationally, launching new projects.

Requirements

  • Passion for building, you love growth, people and getting things done

  • Strong social skills, you win people over

  • Structured and organised, you run many things in parallel without dropping any

jobs.title: Brøytesjåfør søkes
jobs.description:

Hva vi ser etter

  • Den fleksible: En som kan snu døgnet og hoppe i arbeidsklærne når alarmen går klokken 03:00 en søndags morgen.

  • Lønn etter avtale

  • Grundig opplæring og gjennomgang av roder før sesongstart

Liten bedrift i Målselv som driver med brøyting på vinter og gårdsarbeid på sommeren.

jobs.title: BPA søkes i medleverturnus hos mann i Grong!
jobs.employer: ABERIA OMSORG & ASSISTANSE AS AVD HUSØY
jobs.description:
Brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA) er en måte å organisere praktisk bistand for personer med nedsatt funksjonsevne. Ordningen omfatter hjelp til dagliglivets praktiske gjøremål, og hjelpen gis både i og utenfor hjemmet.

Kanskje akkurat du er min nye assistent?

Å jobbe som brukerstyrt personlig assistent er et serviceyrke hvor kjemi, forståelse og respekt er viktig for alle parter.

Vi kan tilby et godt miljø med god takhøyde og latteren sitter løst. Opplæring og veiledning vil bli gitt, men det kreves at du er selvgående og tar initiativ.

Jeg er en ung mann med Down Syndrom og har behov for assistanse i hverdagen. Jeg liker meg godt hjemme hos meg selv, men også turer og nye opplevelser Jeg har eget hus og bil.

Arbeidsoppgaver

1.Husarbeid og enkelt vedlikehold (i og utenom hus)

2.Assistanse i sosiale tilstelninger og reiser

3.Snørydding/plenklipping

4.Matlaging

5.Forberede selskap og høytider

6.Assistere med bilkjøring

7.Bistå med handling og nødvendige innkjøp

8.Reiser etter avtale

Krav til stillingen

1.Snakker og skriver godt norsk

2.God på kommunikasjon

3.Ærlig og ansvarsfull

4.Kunne veilede, berolige og oppmuntre

5.Være presis

6.Sosial utadvendt og ha godt humør

7.Sans for humor

8.Du må ha god orden, være løsningsorientert og initiativrik.

9.Kunne motivere

10.Glad i mennesker

11.Trygg på deg selv

12.Være sjåfør - førerkort klasse B da jeg har egen bil med manuelt gir, samt normalt vedlikehold av bil eks. sjekke olje, vask ut og innvendig

13.Tåle katt (da jeg passer en av og til)

14.Fleksibilitet vil bli satt pris på.

15.Fordel om du kan matlaging (mat er viktig opp mot helse og laktoseintoleranse)

16.Ikke røyker

17.Stabil som tenker langsiktig da jeg trenger tid til å bli kjent med deg

Personlige egenskaper

1.Empati og omsorg

2.Du må være en god lagspiller og bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø

3.Ansvarsfull, tålmodig og kreativ

4.Trygg på deg selv

5.Personlig egnethet vektlegges

6.Krav om politiattest før oppstart.

Vi tilbyr

1.Spennende stilling

2.En unik mulighet for deg som vil utvikle deg og lære nye ting

3.Kurs

4.Konkurransedyktig lønn

5.Godt arbeidsmiljø

Hvis du kjenner deg igjen i beskrivelsene over og tenker at dette er jobben for deg, og du er eldre enn 25 år, oppfordrer vi deg til å søke på stillingen. Vi ønsker at du legger inn så mye informasjon som mulig, slik at vi får riktig inntrykk av deg som søker. Vi behandler søknaden fortløpende og ønsker tiltredelse snarest mulig, så vi anbefaler å sende søknad allerede i dag.

Arbeidstid

Medleverturnus - 3/7 - 4/7, med jobb hver tredje helg.

Originale vitnemål og attester tas med på et eventuelt intervju.

Du ansettes som assistent i Aberia Omsorg og Assistanse, en norskeid og ansvarlig arbeidsgiver som har levert helse- og omsorgstjenester siden 1981.

Vi kan tilby deg:

  • Lønn etter overenskomst (tariff) mellom Fagforbundet og NHO. Lønn etter relevant ansiennitet. Egen lønnsstige for relevante fagbrev.

  • Innskuddspensjonsordning på totalt 8,6%, iberegnet 2% egensparing og AFP.

  • Yrkesskadeforsikring, fritidsskadeforsikring og gruppelivsforsikring.

  • Overordnede kurs og opplæring (eks intro-kurs, sikkerhetskurs brann/førstehjelp, Tamigo-opplæring, kurs i løft og forflytning, diagnose-spesifikke kurs etc).

  • Tilknytning til et bredt fag- og kompetansemiljø, med gode utviklingsmuligheter (vi leverer også tjenester innenfor barnevern og omsorg).

  • Fordeler som ansatt i en stort konsern, med blant annet personalrabatter på en rekke hoteller i Skandinavia.

  • En lett tilgjengelig BPA-rådgiver som nærmeste arbeidsgiver-kontakt.

  • Åpen vakttelefon fra kl 06-23 alle dager.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Aberia AS leverer en rekke velferdstjenester på oppdrag fra offentlig sektor. Vi tilbyr tilpasset bistand til enkeltpersoner og familier. Mange av de som tar imot våre tjenester, er barn og unge. Aberia AS og datterselskapet Aurora Omsorg AS er til stede over hele landet fra nord til sør, med omsorgs- og avlastningstjenester, barnevern, spesialiserte fosterhjem, flyktning- og asylsøkertjenester og BPA. Vi vokser og er i dag cirka 3000 ansatte som skaper verdier og leverer høy kvalitet i møte med andre mennesker.

jobs.title: Senior Game Designer - Systems & Economy - Fully Remote
jobs.description:
At SOFTGAMES, we build games played by millions of players worldwide. We are looking for a Senior Game Designer (Systems & Economy) to help evolve our leading games. You will own the long-term evolution of one or two existing games with a loyal player base, balancing player satisfaction, engagement, and commercial performance.

In this role, you will own the design and optimization of progression, economy, events, and monetization systems. Your mission is to continuously evolve these games by creating compelling short-, mid-, and long-term goals that keep players engaged for months and years while maximizing player satisfaction and business performance.

*Qualified applicants will be expected to complete a design test.

This is a remote position.

Your Role:

  • Design, balance, and optimize the game’s economy, progression, and reward systems.

  • Create engaging player motivation loops across events, features, and monetization.

  • Develop and maintain a cohesive ecosystem of LiveOps events, ensuring they work together rather than compete for player attention.

  • Design systems that improve retention, engagement, and monetization while preserving a great player experience.

  • Build and maintain economy models, balancing spreadsheets, and simulations.

  • Use data to identify player friction points, progression bottlenecks, and monetization opportunities.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, BI, UA, Art, and Development teams to improve game performance.

  • Analyze KPIs such as Retention, ARPDAU, Conversion, LTV, and Engagement to guide design decisions.

  • Drive feature and event improvements through continuous testing, iteration, and experimentation.

  • Clearly communicate design rationale, trade-offs, and recommendations across the team.

Your Profile:

  • 5+ years of experience designing and operating successful F2P mobile games.

  • Strong experience in systems design, economy design, progression design, and LiveOps.

  • Proven track record working on casual or puzzle games.

  • Deep understanding of player motivation, retention mechanics, and monetization design.

  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to design and evaluate A/B tests and translate data into actionable improvements.

  • Comfortable making decisions based on KPIs and player behavior.

  • Self-driven and proactive, with the ability to identify opportunities without waiting for direction.

  • Ability to quickly understand new games, systems, and player audiences and take ownership when moving between projects.

  • Advanced spreadsheet skills and experience building balancing, simulation, and forecasting models.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written.

  • Passion for creating engaging and sustainable player experiences.

  • Proficient in using AI tools to improve productivity, analysis, and decision making.

Benefits:

SOFTGAMES offers a competitive package, including:

  • Remote-first, your way — Work fully remote from wherever you do your best work, or drop into our modern Berlin office whenever you like. You choose

  • Flexible hours — Structure your working hours to your needs. No crunch culture. No overtime

  • Generous vacation — Time to recharge, wherever in the world you are

  • Home office budget — We fund your setup so your home office actually works for you

  • Learning & development — Training budget for everyone, whether you're deepening expertise or picking up something entirely new

  • Top-tier equipment — A high-spec laptop, ready to get your best work done

  • Meal allowance — A monthly budget dedicated to your lunches

  • Home office utility grant — We cover a monthly contribution toward your electricity and internet costs

  • Company swag — Hoodies, bags, mugs — the good stuff

  • Annual company retreat — At least once a year, the whole company comes together to connect, align, and celebrate. Our events in general are epic but our off-site Retreat is one of a kind.

At SOFTGAMES, we value a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone's ideas are heard and valued. Join our dynamic team and be part of the exciting world of mobile gaming. Apply now and let your expertise shine!


SOFTGAMES is the leading instant gaming company. We develop casual, truly social games that can be played instantly across all devices. Our hypersocial blockbuster game “Bubble Shooter Pro” became a global top grossing game on Facebook and is played by millions of people around the world every day. We partner closely with Facebook, Samsung and more to craft the next generation of instant games that billions of people can play together. SOFTGAMES is a remote first company and the home of 100 people from all over the world. We believe in proactive, independent teams with the freedom to take initiative, challenge the status quo, and with the mission to create fun and everlasting Instant Games.

At SOFTGAMES, we believe that different perspectives and background in our teams contribute to the quality of our work. We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion / worldview, disability, age as well as sexual orientation and identity.

Have we caught your interest? Then we look forward to your detailed application.
