Our core platform (Snowflake, dbt, Airflow) is established and isn't changing. What is changing is the layer on top: we're rethinking our semantic and BI layer for AI/MCP-driven self-service, so analysts, stakeholders, and AI agents can query trusted metrics directly. This is also a role built around AI-assisted development. Data Modelling & Transformation

  • Build and maintain dbt models, using AI coding assistants to accelerate development while retaining full understanding of the resulting logic

  • Translate business requirements into scalable data models

  • Design warehouse schemas using dimensional modelling (facts, dimensions, SCDs, etc.)

  • Participate in design and code reviews — including reviewing AI-generated code with the same rigour as hand-written code

  • Define and expose models and metrics through our semantic layer, with an eye to how AI agents will consume them via MCP

Testing, Documentation, and CI/CD

  • Implement dbt tests for data quality and accuracy

  • Document models and metric definitions clearly, for both human and AI consumption

  • Use GitHub and CI/CD pipelines, incorporating AI-assisted workflows where they add value

Performance & Architecture

  • Optimise dbt models and SQL queries for performance and maintainability

  • Work with Snowflake on top of a data lake architecture

  • Contribute to evolving our semantic/BI layer toward AI/MCP-driven self-service

What we're looking for

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience building and optimising complex SQL (joins, window functions, optimisation)

  • Strong grasp of data modelling and warehouse design (Kimball-style)

  • Production dbt experience, including testing and documentation

  • Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g. Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) as a real part of your workflow, not occasional use

  • Strong-enough fundamentals to work confidently without AI assistance and to critically assess AI-generated output

  • Familiarity with version control (GitHub)

  • Able to independently translate business logic into technical implementation

  • Comfortable giving and receiving code review

Desirable - but not required

  • Snowflake experience

  • Semantic layer experience (e.g. Omni, Cube, dbt Semantic Layer)

  • BI tools (e.g. Omni, Tableau, Metabase)

  • Exposure to AI agent tooling / MCP

  • CI/CD for data workflows

  • Python/Airflow familiarity

  • Terraform / IaC

You'll be the single owner of the operative funnel, working across acquisition (including paid channels), Live Operations, our site teams, and Product and Engineering, who build the integrations the funnel runs on. TENEX is an AI-native, automation-first, built-for-scale Managed Detection and Response (MDR) provider. Culture is one of the most important things at TENEX.AI—explore our culture deck at culture.tenex.ai to witness how we embody it, prioritizing the irreplaceable collaboration and community of in-person work.

The Opportunity

This is a build role for an experienced operator who wants ownership, not a seat in an established machine. As the first Customer Success hire in EMEA, you will be both the senior customer-facing face of TENEX in the region and the person who builds the CS team beneath you. Early on you will carry a small book of strategic accounts yourself; over time you will shift from doing the work to hiring, coaching, and scaling a team that does.

You will be the day-to-day CS partner to our EMEA commercial leadership, while staying tightly connected to our global CS motion, framework, and quality bar. If you want to shape how customer success is delivered across a region from a blank page — and be measured on real retention and expansion outcomes — this is that role.

What You Will Do

  • Own the customer relationship (player): Personally own named strategic EMEA accounts as the senior CS point of contact, especially in the first ~90 days. Drive onboarding, adoption, value realization, and executive alignment for MDR engagements — the moments where CISOs form their durable impression of TENEX. Serve as the in-region escalation point and trusted advisor for security leaders across EMEA.

  • Build and lead the team (coach): Hire, onboard, and develop the EMEA CSM team, scaling the function from one (you) to a multi-person pod as the business grows. Run interview loops, build a bench in-region and in-time-zone, and set the local operating rhythm (QBRs, health reviews, escalation paths) in lockstep with the global CS framework.

  • Partner across the business: Act as the day-to-day CS partner to EMEA commercial leadership, contributing to account strategy, expansion planning, and regional go-to-market. Represent the voice of the EMEA customer back into global CS, product, and delivery. Partner with Project Management on onboarding delivery to protect time-to-value in-region.

  • Own the outcomes: Carry regional accountability for the metrics that matter: gross revenue retention (GRR), net revenue retention (NRR), and time-to-value. Translate TENEX's data-residency and compliance posture into clear, confident onboarding conversations with EMEA customers.

What You Bring

  • Deep background in MDR, managed security services, or a comparable high-touch B2B managed-services / SaaS environment.

  • A track record of scaling a customer success team from roughly 1 to 5+ people — you've built, not just inherited.

  • Demonstrated player-coach experience: credible carrying strategic accounts yourself and effective at hiring and developing a team.

  • Strong command of retention and expansion mechanics (GRR / NRR) and the operational levers behind them.

  • Executive presence with security leadership; comfortable being the senior in-region relationship owner for enterprise CISOs.

  • Native or near-native English.

  • Based in (or willing to relocate to) London, with the flexibility to work across EMEA time zones and maintain overlap with an AMER-based global team.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Familiarity with the EMEA security and regulatory landscape (e.g., GDPR, data-residency considerations, and the way native-language delivery expectations vary by market).

  • Experience standing up customer success in a region for a company scaling internationally.

  • Exposure to Google SecOps or adjacent detection-and-response tooling.

  • Additional European language(s).

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI-driven cybersecurity technologies and Google SecOps solutions.

jobs.title: Lead Customer Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

Over 200,000 businesses run on DeepL, and their stories are the most persuasive asset we have. This role puts them front and centre across brand, demand and growth. Buyers evaluating Language AI trust other buyers. We're building the proof that puts customer stories in front of them at scale.

You'll sit in Product Marketing, report to the VP, and work at pace with Field, Brand, Digital, Comms and PR.

 

Your responsibilities

  • Amplify our customers’ success: Surface the stories our customers are already telling within support tickets, sales nominations, deal wins and win-loss interviews, and choose the few that deserve to become full stories. Ship marquee stories (blue-chip, video, event-ready), named case studies and quantified proof points that show DeepL's AI doing real work in real businesses.

  • Put our customers on the world stage: Press interviews, webinars, keynotes and our Customer Advisory Board advocacy track. You recommend who speaks, agree the narrative with them in advance, and make each appearance count beyond the day itself..

  • Put a real customer in front of every buyer: Sales and Customer Success come to you when a deal needs a reference. You'll know which customers will speak, what they'll speak about, and how recently each was asked. Sales enablement builds the seller tools - you supply the customers and the proof that goes inside them.

  • Share stories while they still matter: Stories work hardest published alongside a launch, event or campaign they belong to. You own the run from interview to live asset, including the legal and brand engagement, and keep customer permissions current so nothing sits waiting.

 

Measures of success (first 12 months)

  • New marquee stories the field, brand and events teams all pull from.

  • Named case studies covering every region, product lines and priority verticals

  • Reference requests resolved within the agreed turnaround time

  • Stories publishing in the same window as the launch or event they belong to

  • Clear evidence that deals using a customer reference close at a better rate

 

Qualities we look for

  • Proven success in B2B marketing, over many years: customer marketing, content, comms or advocacy, with a track record of stories that engaged buyers and moved deals

  • Bias for action: you're a self-starter who clears your own hurdles. You do not wait for a brief

  • Automate before you escalate: when a step is slow, your instinct is to build a way round it. AI is already in your workflow, not on your list of things to try.

  • Storytelling: genuine curiosity about a customer's business problem, and the instinct to find the narrative inside it

  • Customer-facing polish: comfortable with customers from first discovery call through to launch

  • Strategic judgement: you can map advocacy output to our priorities and back the stories that serve them

  • Operational rigour: you have built the production, approvals and permissions process - and made it fast

 

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

 

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

#LI-JW2

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

Meget gode betingelser!

Minstetid fire timer pr dag

Godt arbeidsmiljø.

Karriereveiledning.

Kundene våre er lokale og nasjonale innen flere bransjer.

jobs.title: CONSULTANT.E COMMERCIAL  DÉVELOPPEMENT RÉSEAU HÔTELIER - CDI - H/F
jobs.description:
Description :


CARACTÉRISTIQUES DU POSTE

-       DOMAINE D'ACTIVITÉ : Commercial

-       TYPE DE CONTRAT : CDI

-       LIEU : Colombes (92)

-       DISPONIBILITÉ : Dès que possible

-       SUPÉRIEUR HIÉRARCHIQUE : Directeur Adjoint en charge du Service Commercial, de la Communication & du Marketing  Digital



QUI SOMMES-NOUS ?

PROACHAT est une centrale de référencement dédiée à l'hôtellerie indépendante.

Notre rôle est de permettre à nos adhérents de bénéficier de conditions négociées auprès de fournisseurs et industriels référencés, tout en leur donnant accès à une offre de solutions adaptées aux différents besoins de leur établissement.

Notre réseau compte aujourd'hui plus de 1 600 adhérents et plus de 200 fournisseurs et industriels référencés, représentant près de 100 M€ de volume d'affaires annuel.

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous renforçons notre équipe commerciale et recherchons un Consultant commercial en développement réseau hôtelier.



VOS MISSIONS

DÉVELOPPER VOTRE PORTEFEUILLE

Votre objectif est simple : faire progresser le portefeuille d'hôtels qui vous est confié.

Pour cela, vous disposez de deux leviers commerciaux complémentaires :

_1. CONQUÉRIR DE NOUVEAUX ADHÉRENTS_

Vous identifiez les établissements hôteliers de votre secteur qui pourraient rejoindre le réseau PROACHAT.

Vous prospectez, prenez contact avec les décideurs, découvrez leur fonctionnement et leurs besoins, présentez la valeur ajoutée de PROACHAT et accompagnez les prospects jusqu'à leur adhésion.

Vous êtes responsable du développement de votre secteur.

_2. DÉVELOPPER LES ACHATS DE VOS ADHÉRENTS_

Votre travail ne s'arrête pas lorsqu'un hôtel devient adhérent.

Vous analysez son potentiel et cherchez à comprendre quelles familles de produits et de services il achète aujourd'hui en dehors du réseau.

Votre rôle consiste alors à lui faire découvrir les fournisseurs référencés par PROACHAT et les conditions négociées pour les adhérents, afin de développer progressivement la part de ses achats réalisée auprès du réseau.

Vous cherchez en permanence de nouvelles opportunités de développement :

jobs.title: CHEF DE RÉCEPTION - H/F
jobs.description:
Description :


MISSIONS PRINCIPALES

Le/La Chef(fe) de Réception garantit une qualité de service irréprochable, conforme aux standards d'un établissement 4 étoiles. Il/Elle veille au respect strict des normes, procédures et bonnes pratiques de la réception, et pilote la mise en place d'outils et de méthodes visant à améliorer de façon continue l'expérience client.

1. EXCELLENCE DU SERVICE ET QUALITÉ CLIENT

- Assurer un accueil chaleureux, personnalisé et conforme aux standards Best Western Signature Collection.

- Garantir une prise en charge fluide et professionnelle du client du check-in au check-out.

- Contrôler régulièrement la qualité de service délivrée par l'équipe et mettre en place des actions correctives.

- Piloter la collecte des feedbacks clients (Guest Relations, reviews en ligne, questionnaires internes).

- Mettre en œuvre des actions pour augmenter la satisfaction et la fidélisation de la clientèle.

2. RESPECT DES NORMES, STANDARDS ET PROCÉDURES

- Veiller au respect des normes d'accueil, de sécurité, d'hygiène et de confidentialité.

- Rédiger, mettre à jour et faire appliquer les procédures opérationnelles (SOP).

- Assurer la bonne utilisation des outils PMS et logiciels internes selon les standards établis.

- Garantir la conformité administrative (fiches de police, données personnelles, facturation, archives).

- Former l'équipe aux procédures internes et vérifier leur application quotidienne.

3. MANAGEMENT ET MONTÉE EN COMPÉTENCES DE L'ÉQUIPE

- Encadrer, animer et motiver l'équipe de réception dans un esprit de service et d'excellence.

- Élaborer les plannings, gérer les absences et optimiser l'organisation du service.

- Assurer l'intégration et la formation continue des collaborateurs.

- Réaliser des briefings quotidiens et des audits qualité réguliers.

- Développer les compétences de l'équipe via des formations internes et externes.

4. GESTION OPÉRATIONNELLE ET ADMINISTRATIVE

- Superviser la gestion des réservations et optimiser le taux d'occupation.

- Garantir la maîtrise des encaissements, facturations et clôtures journalières.

- S'assurer de la fiabilité des données PMS et de la tenue rigoureuse des dossiers clients.

- Coordonner les actions avec les services housekeeping, maintenance et restauration.

- Analyser les indicateurs clés (RevPAR, taux de satisfaction, remontées terrain).

5. DÉVELOPPEMENT, OPTIMISATION ET AMÉLIORATION CONTINUE

- Mettre en place ou optimiser des procédures pour améliorer la fluidité du parcours client.

- Participer à la stratégie tarifaire et commerciale de l'établissement.

- Suivre et exploiter les tableaux de bord et KPI pour piloter le service.

- Proposer des leviers pour améliorer l'expérience client, la performance et la conformité.

  
  
Profil recherché :
  
  
COMPÉTENCES & SAVOIR-FAIRE

Maîtrise parfaite des bases métier en réception (check-in, check-out, facturation, gestion PMS, réservations).Excellente connaissance des normes hôtelières, des standards qualité et des procédures (SOP).Capacité à mettre en place, structurer et faire appliquer des procédures opérationnelles.Aisance dans la gestion des situations délicates, réclamations et demandes complexes.Esprit analytique pour suivre les KPI, tableaux de bord, qualité et performance.Expérience confirmée dans l'encadrement d'une équipe (formation, motivation, organisation). Le poste est shifté.

SAVOIR-ÊTRE & QUALITÉS HUMAINES

Sens inné de l'accueil chaleureux et personnalisé.Calme, diplomatie, empathie et gestion du stress.Rigueur, fiabilité, sens du détail et amour du travail bien fait.Leadership positif, exemplaire et bienveillant.Capacité à représenter l'établissement avec élégance et professionnalisme.

EXPÉRIENCE ET FORMATION

Expérience de 2 à 5 ans minimum en réception ou en tant que chef(fe) de réception, idéalement en hôtellerie haut de gamme / lifestyle / boutique hôtel.La connaissance d'un PMS (HOIST/HOTSOFT etc.) est un plus.Niveau d'anglais professionnel exigé ; une seconde langue appréciée.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist (m|w|d)
jobs.description:

Du willst wissen, ob Deine Erwartungen und unsere Rollenanforderung ein Match sind? Dann lies einfach weiter:

Dein Value: Du hast bereits erste Berufserfahrung im Digital Marketing gesammelt und möchtest jetzt den nächsten Schritt machen. Du denkst nicht nur in einzelnen Kanälen, sondern hast Lust zu verstehen, wie Paid, Organic, Search, Content, Marketing Automation und AI zusammenspielen, um messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

Dabei musst du noch lange nicht alles können. Uns ist wichtiger, dass du neugierig bist, gerne ausprobierst, aus Daten lernst und Verantwortung für deine Themen übernehmen möchtest.

Dein Purpose: Gemeinsam mit unserem Marketing-Team entwickelst und realisierst du digitale Kampagnen entlang unserer B2B Customer Journey – von Awareness und Traffic über Conversion bis hin zu Lead Nurturing.

Deine Vorteile bei uns: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag, FlexWork mit 100% Remote bis 100% Office, Erfolgsbeteiligung, E-Bike-Leasing sowie Vertrauensarbeitszeiten und betriebliche Altersvorsorge sind bei uns nichts Außergewöhnliches. Vielmehr hast Du die Möglichkeit bei der Simplifier AG einen richtig großartigen Teamspirit zu erleben.

Aufgaben

Was machst Du:

Digital Campaigns & Paid: Du bist für Planung, Umsetzung und Optimierung digitaler B2B-Kampagnen verantwortlich, insbesondere über LinkedIn. Du entwickelst Landingpages weiter und behältst User Journey und Conversion im Blick.

Marketing Automation & Nurturing: Du nutzt HubSpot (oder ein anderes Automation Tool) für Kampagnenentwicklung, E-Mail-Strecken und automatisierte Prozesse. Du sorgst dafür, dass Interessenten relevante Inhalte erhalten.

SEO, GEO & Organic: Du unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer SEO-Strategie und übernimmst Teilbereiche der Optimierung unserer digitalen Inhalte. Du beschäftigst dich mit GEO / AI Search und unseren organischen Präsenzen auf LinkedIn.

AI in Marketing: AI ist Teil deiner täglichen Arbeit. Du experimentierst damit im Bereich Marketing, um Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten und identifizierst neue AI Use Cases.

Qualifikation

Was bringst Du mit:

Du hast erste praktische Berufserfahrung im Digital Marketing.

Du hast idealerweise bereits im B2B-Umfeld gearbeitet.

Du hast erste praktische Erfahrung mit Paid Social, idealerweise LinkedIn Ads.

Du kennst die Grundlagen von SEO und interessierst dich für neue Entwicklungen rund um GEO und AI Search.

Du hast bereits mit Marketing Automation oder CRM-Systemen gearbeitet – idealerweise HubSpot.

Du hast ein grundlegendes Verständnis für E-Mail-Marketing, Lead Generation und Nurturing.

Du kannst Marketing nicht nur kreativ, sondern auch datengetrieben betrachten und kennst relevante KPIs wie CTR, Conversion Rate oder CPL.

jobs.title: Algorithm Developer (m/w/x)
jobs.description:
Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe.

Europe's plants run on gas, power, heat and steam – and all of them are being rebuilt at the same time. The hard part isn't ambition, it's arithmetic: which asset to buy, when to run it, what to hedge. Europe's largest companies (~2% of total energy demand) answer these questions with our Energy OS: a digital twin of the site, an optimizer that plans it, and agents that operate it.

The optimizer is yours. Twenty-year investment decisions, quarter-hourly dispatch, real tariffs, real market rules. You report directly to the CTO – and nobody stands between your model and the plant it runs on.

Tasks

Optimization Models End-to-End: Own capacity expansion planning over multi-year horizons, dispatch at quarter-hour resolution, and MIP production scheduling with sequence-dependent setup times.

Model Physics & Contracts: Storage, thermal networks, transmission, flexibility, self-consumption, minimum part loads, start-up costs – formulate what reality actually demands.

Make It Solve: Tighten big-Ms, scale models cleanly, decide where decomposition earns its complexity – and where it doesn't.

Smart Data Reduction: Time series clustering, extreme periods, segmentation and aggregation – without accuracy quietly disappearing.

Regulation into Constraints: Model grid fees, levies, tariffs, balancing power and intraday trading per country, and understand what they do to the objective function.

Prove It's Right: Test cases on real customer systems, fixtures that catch regressions, and infeasibility output an engineer can actually diagnose.

Interface & Production: Define inputs and outputs with the Product Engineers; own the runs on Kubernetes – solve time, memory and cost are your numbers.

Explain to the Customer: When a customer questions a schedule, you're the one who can say why the model chose it.

Requirements

Education & Background: Degree in mathematics, operations research, computer science, physics, energy systems engineering, business mathematics or a comparable STEM qualification.

Optimization: Deep familiarity with LP and MILP and the craft around it – formulation strength, relaxations, warm starts, solver behavior.

Practice over Papers: You've taken a model from formulation to production that others depended on.

Code & Solvers: Strong Julia – or strong Python/C++ and a real appetite to learn Julia (JuMP) fast. Hands-on with Gurobi or HiGHS, including reading logs and knowing when to reformulate instead of tuning.

Data Sense & Engineering: Comfortable with long time series, unit and sign conventions; tests, version control, code review and CI are second nature.

AI-Native: Claude Code, agents and subagents are part of your daily loop – a requirement, not a plus.

High Ownership, Low Ceremony: You take on the unclear. Energy domain knowledge helps but isn't required.

Nice to have: Stochastic or robust optimization, Benders or column generation, unit commitment, energy market modeling.

Benefits

Share in the Success: Competitive base salary plus equity – we set your level during the process, not based on your CV.

Top-Tier Venture Capital Network: Direct access to the Point 9 and Earlybird networks – including formats for sparring, mentoring and further education.

Unforgettable Team Offsites (Workation): Once a year, the whole team goes on a workation. Including exclusive exchanges with our Visionary Voices (e.g. Robert Habeck, Kitty Mayo, James Vincent).

Corporate Health: Full flexibility for your fitness and health with Urban Sports Club.

Out to the Plant: Seeing the boiler you modeled changes how you build the product.

Our stack: Julia with JuMP on Gurobi and HiGHS, forecasting in Python, the product in TypeScript (Vue, Node, PostgreSQL), Google Cloud with Kubernetes for optimization jobs, GitLab CI, agents on LangGraph.

Small team, no layers between you and the decision. A model change that lands on Tuesday is in front of the customer on Thursday. In-person onboarding, then hybrid from Munich, Düsseldorf or Münster.

Not a research position without deployment – and not a place where solve time is someone else's problem.

jobs.title: Leefgroepbegeleider Kinder-en jeugdpsychiatrie
jobs.description:
Als leefgroepbegeleider binnen de kinder- en jeugdpsychiatrie (*) neem je de volgende taken op jou :

- Je bent overal inzetbaar in de volledige equipe van de K-dienst (Nest, Beren, IKO, Opstap en STEK), waarbij er wordt gestreefd naar een toewijzing aan een leefgroep
- Je creëert een veilig klimaat (fysiek en emotioneel) voor de kinderen en jongeren met de middelen die voorhanden zijn
- Je observeert de groepsdynamische processen en rapporteert deze zowel schriftelijk als mondeling

(*) Tilia biedt een breed aanbod aan met poliklinische werking, liaisonfunctie, dag- en residentiële behandeling en dit aan jongeren van 0 tot 18 jaar en hun gezinnen.

Poliklinisch is de dienst actief op de K-dienst te Sint-Niklaas waar de klemtoon ligt op crisiswerk, infantwerking, psychosomatiek en voor- en nazorg van opnames. Op de campus te Beveren kan men terecht voor ambulante trajecten.

Op de K-dienst zijn de volgende leefgroepen gehuisvest:

- de leefgroep voor kinderen van 0 tot 6 jaar genaamd ‘Nest’ met vier stoelen
- ‘De Beren’ voor kinderen met lagere schoolleeftijd die zes bedden en twee stoelen telt
- drie afdelingen voor adolescenten, nl. ‘Iko’ met focus op crisisbehandeling (zes bedden en twee stoelen), ‘De Opstap’ voor adolescenten met nood aan grondige observatie en behandeling (zes bedden) en de Dagbehandeling ‘Stek’ (acht stoelen).

De dienst biedt ook een liaisonfunctie aan die wordt uitgevoerd in nauwe samenwerking met de diensten pediatrie en materniteit maar ze kan ook ingezet worden op andere afdelingen.

De behandelvisie vertrekt vanuit het unieke van de persoon van het kind en zijn ouders/verzorgers. Een biopsychosociaal psychiatrisch concept ligt aan de basis van het handelen, samen met een integratie van ontwikkelingspsychologie, psychodynamische/analytische en systeem/contextuele invalshoeken.

Opmerking : de Tilia of de lindeboom staat in legendes en de volkscultuur bekend als 'de goede boom' die mensen weer sterk zou maken en een helende werking zou hebben. Het staat ook voor levenskracht, samenkomst en wederopbloei. Zij geeft aan mensen rust en troost.

Meer weten over de job en jouw (beestige) collega's? Surf naar https://bit.ly/zorghonden-tilia en 'het verhaal van Sandy'

Voor de overige taakinhouden verwijzen we naar de functieomschrijving “Leefgroepbegeleider”. Je kan dit bekomen bij de dienst Personeel & Organisatie.

- Je bent een graduaat of bachelor psychiatrisch verpleegkundige, een verpleegkundige met een affiniteit met de psychiatrie of een bachelor orthopedagoog, sociale readaptatiewetenschappen, ...
- Je hebt kennis van de verschillende problematieken op de diverse afdelingen
- Je bent bereid om te werken in een ploegenstelstel (7,6 uur per dag tussen 6.54 uur en 22.06 uur ) en 7 à 8 weekenddagen per kwartaal
- Je bent positief ingesteld en je hebt een groot relativeringsvermogen
- Je bent stressbestendig en flexibel
- Je bent een teamplayer

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Cards
jobs.description:
Our Story
 
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
 
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! 
 
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. 
 
If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

The Team

Credit Cards is focused on creating distinctive products and growing profitably. The Originations team owns the experience and capabilities that take a customer from a customer’s first interaction with Zopa through application, decisioning and onboardingbringing together engineering, credit, fraud operations and partners. 

 As Senior Product Manager, you will own the Originations product and its performance — driving profitable new-account growth, conversion and customer experience from a customer’s first interaction with Zopa through to onboarding. You’ll partner closely with Credit, who own credit strategy, customer selection and pricing. 


A day in the life:

  • Set the direction and roadmap for Credit Cards Originations from a customer’s first interaction with Zopa through application and onboarding. 

  • Use customer, commercial and risk signals to identify the biggest product opportunities to improve profitable new-account growth.

  • artner with Credit and Fraud to build and evolve the capabilities behind eligibility, affordability, decisioning, pricing and fraud prevention. Credit owns credit strategy, customer selection and pricing; you own how these are translated into scalable product capabilities and customer experiences. 

  • Lead the product direction for a squad of engineers and work closely with shared decisioning, design, analytics and operations colleagues. 

  • Improve conversion by simplifying journeys, reducing avoidable referrals and testing web and in-app changes. 

  • Shape partnerships and data opportunities, including open-banking and third-party propositions. 

  • Make pragmatic trade-offs across customer outcomes, conversion, economics, risk, quality and delivery speed. 

  • Develop the team’s ways of working, including practical use of AI and automation to improve productivity, speed and quality. productivitiy and effectiveness. 


About you:

  • You have owned measurable commercial and customer outcomes across a complex digital product area. 

  • You can turn ambiguous problems into a clear direction, prioritised roadmap and well-defined measures of success. 

  • You bring sound commercial judgement and can balance growth, conversion, unit economics, customer outcomes and risk considerations. 

  • You are comfortable being accountable for clear goals and KPIs, and changing course when the evidence shows the current plan is not working. 

  • You build strong product-engineering partnerships and lead work end to end, from problem definition and discovery through launch, measurement and iteration. 

  • You use data to form hypotheses, make decisions and explain what you chose not to do. 

  • You influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners without relying on hierarchy. 

  • You are hands-on, decisive and comfortable getting into the detail when needed. 

  • You continually improve how a team works and are open to using AI and automation thoughtfully. 


Added bonus

  • Experience in consumer fintech or a fast-moving, customer-facing scale-up. 

  • Comfortable working directly with data using SQL, scripting languages and BI / analytical tools where needed. 

  • Experience developing or coaching product managers or analysts. 

  • Experience of third-party data, open banking or strategic partner propositions. 

At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

*Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

 

Diversity Statement

Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments. 

 

Our approach to AI in interviews

At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs. 

Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process. 

Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other. 

Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

jobs.title: Corporate Tax Services - Senior Manager
jobs.description:
About CFGI:
 
Corporate Finance Group, Inc. (“CFGI”) was founded in 2000 by former Big 4 professionals. CFGI is an established industry leader with the resources to successfully navigate today’s complex accounting, reporting, compliance, and tax landscape. An assemblage of top-flight professionals with in-depth public accounting expertise, CFGI can fulfil a variety of client needs without the restrictions of auditor independence. With a foundation of knowledge amassed while serving a variety of industries, CFGI can guide companies through a wide range of routine and complex business scenarios. The resulting partnership is an innovative resource with the power to address our clients’ most crucial accounting, finance, and operational challenges.
 
We provide our clients with a unique combination of integrity, flexibility, creative solutions, and deep tax technical expertise. Many of our clients are global, market leading, publicly held companies, while others are privately held, early stage, or venture-backed emerging businesses. Here at CFGI, we place a high value on a culture of continued learning, where teamwork is encouraged, and professional excellence is rewarded. 
 
 Overview of role:
 
CFGI seeks a highly motivated tax manager to join its UK tax team. This role will provide a fantastic opportunity for an individual who is driven, entrepreneurial and constantly looking to challenge the status quo around the UK tax services industry.
 
You will be involved in all aspects of UK corporate tax (reporting, compliance, governance and advisory) and will have direct interaction with both our clients and senior members of the UK tax team in order to deliver these services. 
 
1.     Client service delivery      
 
a)     Tax reporting:
 
You will be involved in the delivery of UK tax reporting services to our diverse client base, which includes the following:
 
·       UK publicly listed companies.
·       US headquartered multinationals (including US listed groups).
·       UK privately owned and private equity backed groups.
 
The exact scope of tax reporting work for our clients will vary but is likely to include the following:
 
·       Preparation of UK entity only tax numbers in accordance with IFRS or UK GAAP.
·       Preparation of UK group tax numbers, likely to involve the incorporation of tax numbers for non-UK subsidiaries, GAAP-to GAAP adjustments (e.g. US GAAP to IFRS) and consolidation adjustments.
·       Advising on client’s tax reporting processes.
·       Advising on the tax aspects of GAAP conversion projects.
·       Advising on the tax reporting (and other) aspects of IPO readiness.
 
b)    UK corporation tax compliance:
 
You will be involved in the preparation and submission of UK corporation tax returns for our clients. This will involve you leading the day-to-day interaction with our clients to obtain all the information required to complete and file their returns in a timely manner. Whilst a formalized compliance process is in place, you will have a good degree of autonomy to manage the process in your own way, albeit with a focus on ensuring that our tax compliance offering is high quality, efficient and cost effective for our clients.
 
c)     Tax governance
 
You will be involved in the delivery of our tax governance proposition to clients, advising on tax strategy, risk management and controls.
 
d)    Tax advisory
 
You will be involved in tax advisory work likely to include the following:
 
·       Ad hoc corporate tax advisory work originating from compliance engagements – e.g. loss planning and utilization, tax implications of trade and asset transfers, interest deductibility.
·       Cash tax modelling exercises.
·       Group simplification exercises.
·       Tax due diligence for client transactions.
·       Tax structuring for client transactions.
 
2.     Business development
 
As CFGI is looking to rapidly expand in the UK, there will be plenty of opportunity to get involved in business development activities, including the following:
 
·       Assisting with the origination of tax opportunities on new and existing clients, drafting of proposals and involvement in the sales process (e.g. meetings, pitches, etc.).
·       Teaming with colleagues from other CFGI UK and US service areas (e.g. accounting advisory, business transformation) to identify and propose tax opportunities.
·       Teaming with the CFGI US tax team to support with and identify UK tax opportunities on US clients.
·       Identifying additional revenue streams with our clients.
 
Skills and Competencies:
 
Knowledge:
 
·       Experience of UK tax reporting processes.
·       Knowledge of tax reporting IFRS and UK GAAP; high level understanding of US GAAP desired but not essential.
·       Experience of the UK tax return preparation process, and good technical understanding with common tax adjusting items such as capital allowances and other incentives, interest deductibility, hybrid mismatches, loss utilisation etc.
·       Experience of responding to and managing HMRC tax enquiries.
·       Knowledge / an appreciation of cross-border tax matters would be highly desirable, e.g. transfer pricing, country by country reporting etc.
 
Skills:
 
·       Experienced with using Microsoft Excel and tax software packages i.e. OneSource.
·       Demonstrated ability to effectively present information and appropriately respond to questions from clients and team members.
·       Excellent organizational skills, ability to multi-task, and work under deadlines.
·       Excellent analytical, supervisory, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills are necessary.
·       Demonstrated ability to be accountable for independently completing assignments.
·       Capable of collaborating and communicating with people of different technical backgrounds and roles.
·       Analytical ability to navigate work-related situations with practicality, sound reasoning, and demonstrating creativity in problem solving.
·       Other key characteristics: the ideal candidate must demonstrate integrity and accountability, always remaining flexible, adaptable, and willing to accept coaching, building and managing professionally healthy relationships, and continually developing awareness of business-related topics.
·       As an entrepreneurial business you will be working with a growing team and with a range of service lines and so a desire to collaborate and work cross service line will be important. 
 
 Qualifications:
 
·       Three to five years of corporate tax experience with some/all of this time ideally spent in the Big 4.
·       Professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACA, ACCA) required; additional tax qualification (e.g. CTA) strongly desired.

jobs.description:
Vill du kombinera operativ löneexpertis med verksamhetsutveckling i en nordisk miljö? Nu finns möjligheten att kliva in i ett spännande konsultuppdrag där du får vara med och forma framtidens nordiska lönehantering genom att kartlägga, harmonisera och utveckla processer över flera marknader.

Det här är en roll för dig som trivs med att både arbeta hands-on i löneprocessen och samtidigt driva förbättringsinitiativ som skapar långsiktigt värde. Du blir en viktig del i ett nordiskt Payroll-team och får möjlighet att påverka arbetssätt, struktur och framtida lösningar inom området.

Rollen som Nordic Payroll Consultant

Som Nordic Payroll Consultant ansvarar du för att stötta verksamheten under en period av föräldraledighet samtidigt som du bidrar till att utveckla och harmonisera de nordiska löneprocesserna.

Idag arbetar de nordiska marknaderna med olika system, rutiner och arbetssätt. Uppdraget handlar därför om att kartlägga nuläget, identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och driva initiativ som skapar ett mer effektivt, skalbart och enhetligt Payroll-arbete. På längre sikt kan arbetet utgöra en grund för en nordisk Shared Service-modell eller outsourcinglösning.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter

    

Ansvara för och stötta löneadministrativa processer och lönekörningar.

    

Kartlägga befintliga Payroll-processer och arbetssätt i de nordiska länderna.

    

Identifiera effektiviseringsmöjligheter och harmoniseringsinitiativ.

    

Analysera processer, system, roller, ansvar och kostnadsstrukturer.

    

Ta fram beslutsunderlag och konkreta förbättringsförslag.

    

Driva förändrings- och utvecklingsprojekt inom Payroll.

    

Samarbeta nära chefer, lokala verksamheter och andra intressenter i Norden.

    

Bidra till ökad standardisering och förbättrad användarupplevelse för verksamhetens chefer.

Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet av löneadministration och Payroll, med ansvar för svenska lönekörningar och gärna erfarenhet från flera bolag. Du har arbetat med nordiska Payroll-processer och har god förståelse för skillnader i regelverk, processer och arbetssätt mellan de nordiska länderna. Vidare har du erfarenhet av processkartläggning, harmonisering och förändringsarbete inom Payroll och är van att analysera både data och processer för att identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och omsätta dessa till konkreta åtgärder.

Du har en god systemförståelse och det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Agda, Hogia, Catalystone och Power BI. Du är även van att driva projekt och skapa struktur, framdrift och förankring hos olika intressenter. Eftersom rollen har en nordisk kontext kommunicerar du obehindrat på både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We're looking for a CTO who wants to own engineering end to end: the systems, the people, and the standards for a company whose work changes lives.

  • Keep us moving fast as we get bigger: We deliberately favour fewer processes, simple designs, and deeply understood tools, because that's what lets a small team operate a system this important. Your job is to protect that as the headcount grows and ensure more ownership per engineer, and a clear view of where complexity is worth the tradeoff.
  • Own reliability: Wave is the financial system for tens of millions of people. You'll set the standards for uptime, incident response, and how carefully we change things that move money and you'll be accountable when we fall short.
  • Build and lead the leadership layer: You'll inherit 5 direct reports and an engineering organization of ~100 people including security, data and infrastructure. You will be responsible for hiring, developing, and where necessary replacing engineering managers and directors. You'll be personally involved in senior hiring.
  • Set our vision on AI: Set our vision on AI. We're already seeing AI accelerate product velocity, but we think we're in the early days of what we can do with AI in our apps and to move faster across the org. We want you to make Wave a truly AI forward organization.
  • Support expansion. Wave already has over 25M users with accelerating growth. This scale and each new market brings new challenges and constraints. You'll help us plan the right architecture and organisational structure to help us grow smoothly and consistently.
  • Represent engineering to the company. Wave is very transparent, whether that's defaulting to public conversations in slack, frequent Ask Wave Anything sessions, or defaulting to writing public docs to explain major decisions. You'll communicate openly and clearly about what engineering is doing and why, to an audience that includes engineers, non-engineers, our leadership team, and our when needed regulators.

Key details

Reports to: Drew Durbin, CEO.

Team: Around ~100 engineers across 5 teams (Payment, User-facing products, Internal, non-product teams and platform) plus 5 leaders. Engineering teams are co-led by Product Managers and an engineering manager. 

Stack: Python 3 with mypy on the backend, GraphQL API layer, Postgres and Redis, Kotlin/Jetpack on Android (our main client), Swift/SwiftUI on iOS, TypeScript and React on the web. Infrastructure on GCP, managed with Kubernetes and Terraform. Most backend work happens in a large Python monolith, deployed across multi-country architecture. Current in-flight work includes agentic developer tooling, a large scale migration of our databases, and some refactoring of our monolith.

Location: Location: This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (Spain, UK, East Coast of USA, Canada, Kenya, Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, etc. Expect to travel to our markets a minimum of twice per year to stay close to local realities, products, teams and of course our users. Wave covers all costs.

Compensation: Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary of up to $356,500 USD, plus a generous equity package:

  • Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support coworking meetups with teammates.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
    • 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.
    • Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days exclusive of statutory holidays.
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Process: The process runs up to 5 conversations, including 2 technical discussions. We want this to be a 2-way assessment: as much a chance for you to evaluate us as for us to get to know you. Along the way you'll meet our CEO, Head of People, Head of Product, both Engineering Directors, and a senior leader from one of our markets.

Requirements

  • You've managed an engineering organisation of at ~100 people, including managers who manage others. You can describe how your own job changed as the org grew.
  • You have a software engineering background and are good at it. You can still read code and follow a technical argument to the end.
  • You've been accountable for a system where failure was expensive: money, safety, or regulated data.
  • You've hired senior engineering leaders, and you've moved someone out of a role that wasn't working. You can talk about both honestly.
  • You write well. Clear, short, and persuasive, for readers who aren't engineers.
  • You have a clear and positive point of view on AI in engineering: something you've tried, changed, or abandoned, not a plan to look into it.
  • You believe in what we're building and can say why without being prompted.

You might be a good fit if you

  • Would rather run a great team than be the smartest engineer in the room, and don't feel a loss in that trade.
  • Are comfortable being the person who says the unwelcome thing in a meeting, and can do it without making it personal.
  • Change your mind in public when the evidence changes.
  • Prefer the simplest system that works to the most interesting one.
  • Care about what our users actually experience: how long a transfer takes on a bad network, what happens to a shop owner when a deposit fails and bring that up unprompted when discussing infrastructure.
  • Take responsibility for outcomes rather than processes, including when the outcome is bad.
  • Are drawn to a company that publishes its numbers internally every month, expects direct feedback in both directions, and would rather be embarrassingly honest than comfortable.
  •  

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Technical Marketing Engineer
jobs.description:
The role

Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories.

You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market.

Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications.

This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams.

Your mission

Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable.

You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it.

The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate.

What you will do

Drive technical co-builds with partners

  • Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept.

  • Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks.

  • Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure.

  • Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories.

  • Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets.

  • Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility.

Produce technical marketing content

  • Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives.

  • Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations.

  • Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets.

  • Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember.

  • Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity.

Build for the audience

  • Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work.

  • Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype.

  • Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance.

  • Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology.

  • Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication.

What we are looking for

  • A strong engineering background

  • The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems.

  • Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video.

  • A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation.

  • Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value.

  • Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams.

  • The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

This role may suit you if

  • You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing.

  • You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value.

  • You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market.

  • You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems.

  • You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message.

This role is probably not for you if

  • Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations.

  • You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it.

  • You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete.

  • You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes.

How the role complements Product Marketing

Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity.

The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content.

What success looks like

Within the first year, you will have:

  • Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners.

  • Produced partner demonstrations that create concrete content, event and relationship opportunities.

  • Built a steady flow of high-quality technical articles, demos and videos.

  • Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance.

  • Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

Working with multidisciplinary teams across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and more, you will manage the interdependencies between technical departments and use model-based systems engineering (MBSE) to keep system-level decisions connected. Your work will lay the technical foundation for successful vehicle integration and launch.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Act as the Systems Technical Authority for the orbital rocket programme, providing vehicle-level systems leadership and maintaining technical coherence across the complete vehicle.

  • Lead the definition, ownership, and resolution of system interfaces across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and other technical departments.

  • Identify and manage interdependencies, assumptions, constraints, and cross-subsystem impacts as the vehicle design develops.

  • Use MBSE models and related system artefacts to maintain a connected view of vehicle architecture, requirements, and interfaces.

  • Lead cross-disciplinary systems discussions and reviews, bringing forward system-level trade-offs, resolving technical conflicts, and ensuring decisions are clearly recorded.

  • Coordinate technical departments around vehicle-level priorities and help keep subsystem work aligned with the needs of the overall programme.

  • Track system-level issues and interface actions through to resolution, helping establish the conditions for successful vehicle integration and launch.

What we’re looking for

  • Strong understanding of model-based systems engineering and its application to complex, multidisciplinary engineering programmes.

  • Strong understanding of rocketry and how vehicle subsystems interact across the complete system.

  • Experience leading systems engineering work, system interfaces, or cross-disciplinary technical efforts on complex engineering projects.

  • A proven track record of successfully completing engineering projects.

  • The ability to maintain a vehicle-level perspective while engaging with technical teams across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and other disciplines.

  • Confidence facilitating technical decisions, managing competing subsystem needs, and driving interface issues toward resolution.

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

jobs.description:
As a Senior Technical Procurement Specialist – PCBs / Electronics, you are responsible for the end-to-end procurement of printed circuit boards (PCBs) through our manufacturing partners (Contract Manufacturers, CMs). You work at the interface between Engineering, Supply Chain, and Production, translating technical requirements into clear supplier packages, negotiating costs and lead times, and ensuring that the right boards are available on time and at the required quality level.

This role is ideal for someone who understands how PCBs are actually manufactured (stack-ups, materials, tolerances, DFM) and enjoys the commercial and operational aspects of bringing products to life at scale.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  •  Own PCB procurement end-to-end – from RFQ and quote analysis through PO creation, order tracking, delivery, and closure.

  •   Translate engineering needs into supplier-ready data – review BOMs, Gerbers, stackups, drawings, and specifications to ensure CMs have complete and correct information.

  • Manage contract manufacturers – build strong relationships, align on capabilities and capacity, and drive performance on cost, quality, lead time, and responsiveness, including on-site visits of contract manufacturers

  • Optimize cost and lead time – run competitive RFQs, analyze trade-offs (volume, lead time, technology level), and negotiate pricing and terms with CMs.

  • Mitigate supply and technical risks – monitor material availability (e.g. laminates, copper weights, finishes), propose alternates, and escalate issues before they become schedule slips.

  • Support NPI and engineering changes – coordinate production ramp-up, manage ECO impacts on PCB procurement, and ensure smooth transitions from prototype to volume.

  • Ensure quality and compliance – work closely with QA/engineering to address nonconformances, track supplier performance, and ensure boards meet required standards (e.g. IPC, customer specs).

  • Keep everything organized and visible – maintain accurate data in ERP/MRP and tracking tools, provide clear status updates, and keep stakeholders aligned on dates and risks.


What you bring to the team:

  • Technical background in electronics or PCBs – ability to read schematics, BOMs, and Gerber/ODB++ files; familiarity with PCB stackups, materials, finishes, and manufacturing constraints.

  • Experience in electronics/PCB procurement or supply chain – ideally working directly with PCB fabs and/or PCB assembly contract manufacturers.

  • Comfortable working with engineers – you can discuss layer counts, impedance, controlled tolerances, and DFM/DFT topics and translate that into supplier requirements.

  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills – able to compare quotes, build cost breakdowns, negotiate pricing and MOQs, and structure win–win agreements.

  • Data-driven and detail-oriented – you spot inconsistencies in BOMs/specs, track multiple orders in parallel, and use data (lead times, yields, costs) to drive decisions.

  •   Tool-savvy – experience with Netsuit ERP/MRP systems and common engineering tools (e.g. Altium/KiCad/Cadence exports, Excel/Sheets for analysis, ticketing/project tools for tracking).

  •   Familiarity with PLM and configuration management (ECR/ECO), supplier qualification, FAI (AS9102), and quality documentation.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, AI Software Factory
Speditör sökes till företag i centrala Göteborg
jobs.description:
Om tjänsten

Är du en strukturerad och serviceinriktad person som trivs i en roll med högt tempo och många kontaktytor? Har du erfarenhet av spedition och söker en ny utmaning? Då kan detta vara tjänsten för dig.

Arbetsuppgifter

Vi söker nu en speditör till ett väletablerat företag i centrala Göteborg. Här blir du en del av ett engagerat team där samarbete, kvalitet och god service genomsyrar det dagliga arbetet. Rollen passar dig som tycker om att planera, koordinera och hitta lösningar i en dynamisk arbetsmiljö.

Som speditör kommer du att ansvara för planering och koordinering av transporter, både inom Sverige och internationellt. Du har daglig kontakt med kunder, transportörer och samarbetspartners och ser till att transporterna genomförs på ett smidigt och effektivt sätt. Arbetet innebär även att följa upp leveranser, hantera transportdokument och arbeta löpande i företagets affärs- och transportsystem. Rollen är varierande och kräver att du kan prioritera, arbeta strukturerat och samtidigt ge en hög servicenivå.

Profil & bakgrund

Vi söker dig som har tidigare erfarenhet av spedition, transport eller logistik och som har en god administrativ förmåga. Du är van att arbeta i olika datorsystem och känner dig trygg med att kommunicera på både svenska och engelska, i såväl tal som skrift. Som person är du noggrann, lösningsorienterad och trivs med att arbeta i ett högt tempo där du har flera ärenden igång samtidigt. Du tycker om att samarbeta med andra och har ett professionellt bemötande i kontakten med kunder och kollegor.

Tjänsten är ett vikariat på heltid fram till hösten 2027 och för rätt person finns det goda möjligheter till förlängning efter vikariatets slut. Arbetstiderna är förlagda 08:00-17:00

Rekryteringsprocess och ansökan

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi bakgrundskontroller via Verifiera. Du får mer information om detta i ett tidigt skede av processen.

AI-baserade verktyg kan komma att användas som stöd i rekryteringsprocessen. Eventuell AI ersätter inte mänskligt beslutsfattande och bearbetar inte skyddade personuppgifter. Alla beslut fattas av våra rekryterare.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan.

Om Boxflow

Boxflow är ett av Sveriges snabbast växande logistikbolag och erbjuder tjänster inom tredjepartslogistik, sitelösningar, konsulttjänster samt bemanning av personal inom logistik och industri. Boxflow har verksamhet i Halmstad, Göteborg, Stockholm, Västerås Helsingborg, Malmö, Kristianstad och Perstorp.

Inom de närmsta åren beräknas Boxflow omsätta 1 miljard kronor och ha fler än 1100 anställda. Genom nära och långsiktiga samarbeten skapar Boxflow förutsättningar för hållbara och kostnadseffektiva logistiklösningar. Boxflows vision är att bli Norra Europas ledande logistikföretag.

jobs.title: Vil du jobbe med vinterdrift vei kommende sesong?

Er du glad i praktisk arbeid og trives med varierte arbeidsdager? Vi søker medarbeidere til et langtidsvikariat innen drift og vedlikehold av vei i vintersesongen. 

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Brøyting og strøing av vei i vintersesongen

Hvem ser vi etter?
Du har førerkort klasse B. Det er en fordel dersom du har ett av følgende: førerkort klasse T, C eller CE, eller maskinførerbevis. Har du flere av disse kvalifikasjonene, er det positivt, men det er ikke et krav. Det vil også være en stor fordel om du har erfaring fra vinterdrift eller tilsvarende arbeid innen vei, anlegg eller drift og vedlikehold. Du må ha grunnleggende IT- kunnskaper da all timeføring, informasjon o.l. vil foregå på digitale flater. Arbeidsspråket er norsk, så det er viktig at du behersker norsk både muntlig og skriftlig.

For å trives i rollen er det viktig at du er fleksibel og løsningsorientert. Arbeidsdagene påvirkes av vær- og føreforhold, og planlagte arbeidsoppgaver må ofte omprioriteres, for eksempel ved kraftig snøfall. Ettersom stillingen inngår i en beredskapsordning, må du derfor regne med arbeid ved utkalling på ettermiddag, natt og helg de ukene du har beredskapsvakt. 

Praktisk informasjon
Det er ønskelig med oppstart så snart som mulig. Stillingen er en heltidsstilling, og arbeidssted er i Trondheimsområdet. Oppdraget har varighet fra oktober 2026 til april 2027. 

Søknadsfristen er 12. oktober. Søknader vurderes fortløpende, og vi oppfordrer derfor interesserte kandidater til å søke så snart som mulig.

Heb jij een warm hart en zin om écht iets bij te dragen aan iemands leven? Dan ben jij misschien wie we zoeken!

Bij vzw Op Maat zijn we op zoek naar een persoonlijk assistent die mensen met een beperking ondersteunt in hun dagelijks leven. Dankzij jouw hulp kunnen zij hun leven op hun eigen manier vormgeven.

Wie zijn onze klanten? We bieden persoonlijke assistentie aan mensen met een beperking in West-Vlaanderen — dit kan gaan om een mentale, fysieke, visuele of auditieve beperking, autisme of niet-aangeboren hersenletsel.

Specifieke vacature

Voor een jongedame uit Zedelgem met een meervoudige beperking, die rolstoelgebonden is, zijn we op zoek naar een assistent die haar kan ondersteunen tijdens haar vrije tijd. Ze woont bij haar ouders. Ze is heel creatief en doet aan schilderen, keramiek, ... Daarnaast staan er ook andere activiteiten op het programma, zoals wandelen of een uitstap maken. Op dinsdag ga je samen zwemmen. Ook rijd je af en toe met het minibusje, dus rijervaring hiermee is een pluspunt.

De assistentie vindt plaats op zaterdag, om de twee weken, van 13u30 tot 18u, en op dinsdag van 16u tot 20u.

Als kinesitherapeut verzeker je aangepaste kinesitherapeutische zorgen aan de bewoners, teneinde hun capaciteiten en hun autonomie te behouden, te verbeteren en/of te herwinnen.

Uitvoeren van kinesitherapeutische onderzoeken en opstellen van een kinesitherapeutische diagnose, met bijzondere aandacht voor het behoud en de verbetering van de mobiliteit, functionaliteit en zelfredzaamheid van de bewoners.

Behandelen en begeleiden van bewoners volgens de voorschriften van de arts en de individuele zorgdoelstellingen, waarbij de evolutie systematisch wordt opgevolgd en bijgestuurd.

Actief inzetten op het behoud van fysieke functies en het voorkomen van achteruitgang door middel van gerichte activering, mobilisatie en oefentherapie.

Stimuleren en motiveren van bewoners om dagelijks te bewegen en actief deel te nemen aan hun therapie, rekening houdend met hun mogelijkheden en wensen.

Ontwikkelen, organiseren en begeleiden van individuele en collectieve bewegingsactiviteiten die bijdragen aan mobiliteit, spierkracht, evenwicht, conditie en algemeen welzijn.

Een actieve rol opnemen in preventieve zorg, met bijzondere aandacht voor valpreventie, contractuurpreventie, preventie van immobiliteitsgerelateerde complicaties en het bevorderen van een gezonde en actieve levensstijl.

Adviseren en coachen van bewoners en medewerkers inzake ergonomie, lichaamshouding, transfers, positionering en het correct gebruik van hulpmiddelen.

Nauw samenwerken binnen het multidisciplinair team en deelnemen aan overlegmomenten.

Global leader in specialized logistics and transportation solutions. The company supports time-critical shipments across healthcare, life sciences and other highly regulated industries, ensuring products reach their destination safely, securely and on time.

  • Maintain accurate records and customs documentation
  • Support customs audits and provide required reports and documentation
  • Identify opportunities to improve customs and import processes
  • Keep up to date with changes in customs legislation and international trade regulations

  • 2+ years of experience in import operations, customs clearance, or international logistics
  • Strong knowledge of customs procedures, import regulations, Incoterms, and trade compliance
  • Experience working with customs brokers, freight forwarders, and government authorities
  • Familiar with customs systems, ERP platforms (SAP is a plus), and Excel
  • Strong attention to detail and administrative accuracy
  • Able to prioritize, solve problems, and work in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent communication skills and a customer-oriented mindset
