jobs.title: PhD Candidate in International Business
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The position is at NTNU in Ålesund at the School of International Business. We are looking for candidates with an educational background in international business or international management. However, other business and management degrees, including technology management, innovation management, organizational leadership and behavior, or human resource management, will also be considered.

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate and, at the same time, gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a future career in higher education and research, both within and beyond academia.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


About the project

Digital technologies such as artificial intelligence, automation, and remote operations are transforming not only where people work, but also how work is organized. As technologies redistribute tasks, expertise, decision-making authority, and responsibility across people and locations, they can reconfigure established roles, relationships, and ways of working. These changes raise important leadership questions: How do leaders help employees navigate changing roles and responsibilities? How are trust, shared understanding, and coordination maintained when work becomes increasingly technology-mediated and geographically distributed? And how do leadership practices emerge as established authority structures are reshaped by technology?

These leadership challenges can become particularly pronounced in culturally diverse teams, where members may differ in their expectations regarding leadership, authority, autonomy, participation, communication, and responsibility. Such differences may reflect both the cultural composition of the team and the cultural values and orientations of individual members. The aim of this PhD project is to investigate how leadership and culture jointly shape responses to technology-driven changes in distributed work, with particular attention to how leaders navigate culturally diverse expectations as new ways of working emerge, and how these processes influence trust, role clarity, and coordination. 

The PhD project seeks to advance research on leadership, cross-cultural management, and technology-driven organizational change, potentially using remote maritime operations as a relevant empirical context in which geographically dispersed and culturally diverse actors must navigate shifting roles and authority while coordinating effectively in a safety-critical environment.

The successful candidate will have scope to develop the theoretical framework, research questions, and methodological design within the project's overall direction.


About the proposal

The PhD candidate should develop and submit a proposal within the scope of the topic, and, if selected as the preferred candidate, conduct research on the topic. Preferably, the PhD candidate’s research should focus on industries relevant to the Møre and Romsdal county, such as the marine and maritime industries.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the research group on international business and innovation.
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must have an academically relevant background, preferably within international business or international management. However, other business and management degrees including technology management, management of innovation, organizational leadership and behavior, or human resource management may also apply. 
  • You must have a master’s degree in international business, international management, business administration, or equivalent. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course in which 120 credits have been obtained at the master's level. Master's students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position. 
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree studies, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may still be considered if you can demonstrate that you are particularly well-suited for a PhD program.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty of economics and management doctoral programme (https://www.ntnu.edu/ok/research/phd)
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English and/or Norwegian.

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

 

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Good knowledge of industries represented in the region, such as the marine, maritime and furniture industry, both local and global.
  • Have strong motivation for advanced research work demonstrated by a motivation letter and a proposal within the scope of the project description above.
  • Good demonstrated theoretical and analytical skills.
  • Contribute to a positive work environment in general is emphasized.

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

 

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. (delete if not applicable)


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian or English. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include: 

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 2000 words/5 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
  • Possibly publications, etc., other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Possible letter(s) of reference/recommendation
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact the Head of Department, Associate Professor Mark Pasquine (mapa@ntnu.no), Professor Ghulam Mustafa (guma@ntnu.no), or the Deputy leader, Research & Innovation, Professor Richard Glavee-Geo (rigl@ntnu.no). If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Adviser Oddny Lyngvær at email: oddny.lyngvar@ntnu.no or telephone: +47 95011957. 

Application deadline: 25.10.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

 

Ålesund, known for its unique Art Nouveau architecture and spectacular nature, is a gem on Norway's west coast. The city offers a vibrant cultural life, modern facilities, and a dynamic business environment. With its strategic location by the sea, Ålesund provides a perfect balance between urban living and natural experiences. jobs.title: Hoitaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle Tammisaareen
jobs.description:
Hoiva-avustaja sympaattiselle ruotsinkieliselle seniorille

Haemme hoiva-avustajia osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista asiakastamme Tammisaareen. Asiakkaalla tarve usealle käynnille päivässä, joten haemme tähän helpperitiimiä jakamaan käynnit.

Haluaisitko tehdä hoiva-avustajan työtä osa-aikaisesti, kiireettömästi ja ilman sairaanhoidollisia työtehtäviä sympaattisten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva hoitaja-helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, kerryttänyt jo kokemusta hoiva-avustajana tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.

Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen omaavia helppereitä tiimiimme. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

Mitä hoitaja-helpperi tekee?

Hoitaja-helpperi on sosiaali- ja terveysalan koulutettu henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua ja seuraa omalle nimetylle ikäihmiselle. Hoitaja-helpperi tukee ikäihmistä kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilu ja kauppareissut, kodin ylläpito, ruokailussa tukeminen, saattoapu, yhdessäolo ja jutustelu.

Hoitaja-helpperi tukee seniorin hyvinvointia kokonaisvaltaisesti. Hoivan ja huolenpidon tehtävät sisältävät:

- suihkuapua

- voinnin tarkkailua

- kotona pärjäämisen tukemista

- liikkumisessa tukemista


Lisäksi voit auttaa asiakasta suihkussa ja henkilökohtaisessa hygieniassa. Työtehtäviin ei kuitenkaan kuulu sairaanhoidollisten palveluiden toteutusta, kuten lääkehoitoa.

Mitä hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii?

Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa ikäihmisiä. Lisäksi hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii sosiaali- ja terveysalan tai hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen tai vankan kokemuksen hoiva-avustajan työstä.

Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.

Mikä on parasta hoitaja-helpperin työssä?

Kysyimme tätä hoitaja-helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."

Hoitaja-helpperinä saat:

Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 15,29-17,29 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

Lähetä hakemus hoitaja-helpperiksi täällä.

Lue lisää Hembystä klikkaamalla tästä.

Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää hoitaja-helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: SOMMERJOB MED HAVUDSIGT
jobs.description:
NIXE - ÆRØ - JULI & AUGUST 2027

Færgen tager dig på arbejde. Og når du først er her, må du gerne blive hele sommeren.

Til Nixe, vores lille strand- og havnebar i Ærøskøbing, søger vi ekstra hænder i juli og august. Her mødes øboere, sejlere, sommergæster og folk, der egentlig bare lige skulle kigge forbi til en enkelt øl. Der er kaffe på kajen, kolde drinks, musik under lyskæderne og lange sommeraftener ved havnen.

Din hverdag foregår mest bag baren: Du laver kaffe og drinks, betjener vores gæster, tager imod betaling og hjælper med at holde det hele kørende. Glas, opvask og oprydning hører selvfølgelig også med. Har du barista-erfaring, er det et plus – og vi bager også pizza her. Når solen skinner, og havnen er fuld, kan der godt komme fart på.

Det vigtigste for os er, at du kan lide mennesker, tager fat, hvor der er brug for det, og stadig kan smile, når der pludselig står ti mennesker i kø. Erfaring fra bar, café eller service er dejligt, men god energi, pålidelighed og lyst til at være en del af holdet betyder mindst lige så meget for os.

Måske studerer du. Måske holder du lige en pause fra et eller andet. Måske har du bare lyst til at bruge en sommer på en dansk ø. Uanset hvad vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Skriv lidt om dig selv, hvad du har lavet før, og om du kan være her i juli og august.

Som det ser ud lige nu, kan vi desværre ikke tilbyde bolig, men vi hjælper gerne med at finde noget. De fleste vagter ligger mellem kl. 13.00 og 20.00.

Ansøgning: alexvoigt333@gmail.com

Vil du lige have en fornemmelse af stemningen først?
Så kig forbi Instagram: @nixe_aeroe

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Rosa & Alex

jobs.title: Vil du være en stemme for personer med utviklingshemning og bidra til et sterkere BPA-tilbud?
jobs.description:
Brenner du for at personer med utviklingshemning skal bli sett, hørt og forstått – og få leve et liv preget av trygghet, selvbestemmelse og gode muligheter?

Vi ser etter deg som forstår hvor viktig dette arbeidet er, og som vet at gode rammer, trygge relasjoner og riktig bruk av BPA kan gjøre en stor forskjell – både for den enkelte og for menneskene rundt. Vi ser etter deg som har egenerfaring med BPA og utviklingshemning, eller som har utdanning eller arbeidserfaring fra feltet – og som ønsker å bruke denne erfaringen til å skape noe bedre. For oss handler dette om mer enn tjenester og systemer. Det handler om retten til å bestemme over eget liv, om beslutningsstøtte som skaper trygghet, og om å se personen bak behovet. Du ønsker å bidra til at flere forstår hva BPA faktisk kan bety: frihet, mestring, deltakelse og en hverdag der mennesker får større rom til å være seg selv.


Stillingen kan ha arbeidssted flere steder i landet, fortrinnsvis i Trondheim eller Oslo, og inngår i fagavdelingen vår. Du blir en del av et lite og nært team i et større arbeidsmiljø, med mulighet til å jobbe med noe du brenner for. Hvis du liker utviklingsarbeid, faglige diskusjoner og å bidra til konkrete forbedringer i menneskers hverdag, kan dette være riktig sted for deg. I denne stillingen er det ikke CV-en eller ønsket stillingsprosent som teller mest. Rollen formes etter den rette personen. Det viktigste for oss er hvem du er, hva du har med deg, og hvordan engasjementet og erfaringene dine kan bidra til at personer med utviklingshemning får en enda tryggere, friere og bedre hverdag.


Vi ser for oss at du:

  • Har egenerfaring, utdanning eller arbeidserfaring innen utviklingshemning og BPA
  • Ønsker å dele kunnskap, erfaringer og perspektiver som kan gjøre oss bedre
  • Ønsker å bidra til å utvikle og styrke BPA-tilbudet for personer med utviklingshemning
  • Er engasjert og tydelig, og opptatt av verdighet, rettferdighet og selvbestemmelse
  • Arbeider strukturert og selvstendig, og er trygg på å følge opp egne oppgaver


Dette kan vi tilby:

  • En rolle der stemmen, erfaringen og engasjementet ditt virkelig betyr noe
  • Mulighet til å arbeide for en viktig sak som påvirker hverdagen til mange mennesker og deres pårørende
  • En fleksibel arbeidshverdag som kan tilpasses deg, kompetansen og livssituasjonen din
  • Meningsfylt arbeid i et sterkt, inkluderende og engasjert fellesskap


Dette er en mulighet til å bruke erfaringen din til noe som virkelig betyr noe. Vi håper du vil være med oss på laget! Vi behandler søknader fortløpende, så om dette treffer noe i deg, håper vi du søker.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

I Prima Assistanse ser vi stor verdi av å være en mangfoldig organisasjon. Derfor ønsker vi at du uavhengig av etnisitet, alder, kjønn, legning, funksjonsnedsettelse, utdanning eller bakgrunn søker på jobb hos oss. Gjennom verdiene våre "humor, tillit, fleksibilitet og lagarbeid" jobber vi hver dag for at alle skal få frihet til å leve! BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. For mer informasjon: www.prima-assistanse.no

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Physics-Adapted Numerical Methods
jobs.description:
Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Physics-Adapted Numerical Methods

The Department of Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Mathematical Sciences at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, has a vacancy for a postdoctoral research fellow in numerical mathematics for a period of 3 years.
 
About the postdoctoral project:

The postdoctoral position is part of the project “Physics-Adapted Numerical Methods for Two-Phase Flow” (PANum) funded by the Research Council of Norway. The project is a joint collaboration between Western Norway University of Applied Sciences and Hasselt University in Belgium.

In PANum the goal is to formulate and implement mathematical methods that are not only robust, efficient and have a low numerical error, but that also guarantee that important physical properties are fulfilled in the numerical solution. Ultimately, PANum will lead to a computational algorithm that reliably simulates two-phase flow.

The postdoctoral project will be part of developing and analyzing relevant numerical methods and implement them in an open-source framework that will be made openly available for others to use. This will be relevant for example for CO2 storage and design of fuel cells. 


Research environment:

The PANum project is situated in the Engineering Computing research group at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, and in the computational mathematics group (CMAT) at Hasselt University. Both groups focus strongly on numerical analysis and mathematical modelling. The prospective postdoctoral researcher will work in close collaboration with Carina Bringedal and Erlend Storvik from Engineering Computing, Jochen Schütz from CMAT, as well as the current PhD and master students connected to the PANum project.

 

Postdoctoral research fellows receive an annual work expense funding which can be used for conference participation, research visits, and equipment. The place of employment is campus Bergen or campus Førde. 


Qualifications:

Criteria for appointment to the position of postdoctoral fellow are regulated in Forskrift til universitets- og høyskoleloven.

Applicants must have earned a PhD degree in computer science, simulation science, applied mathematics or in a closely related field, or have submitted the PhD thesis before the application deadline. The PhD must have been awarded within 4 weeks after the application deadline. The scientific profile of qualified candidates must be within numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs.

 

A solid background in both the following fields is required:

  • Numerical analysis for ODEs and PDEs
  • Scientific programming using Python, MATLAB, C++, Julia, or similar

Furthermore, experience within:

  • collaborative code development and usage of version control tools like git
  • asymptotic methods, like two-scale asymptotic expansions or matched asymptotic expansions, for PDEs

will be considered an advantage when candidates are ranked. 

In addition to the required educational and scientific background, the following criteria will be evaluated:

  • Quality and relevance of PhD thesis
  • Quality and relevance of publications
  • Ability to work in intersection of theoretical and applied research
  • Ability to collaborate, lead the writing of research papers, ability to initiate and advance research, and research and scientific leadership potential
  • Oral and written good communication skills in English.

 

Career plan:

The person appointed shall, together with the institute, prepare a career plan that specifies the skills the postdoctoral researcher is to acquire. Competence goals shall be set both for the postdoctoral project and for any other career‑advancing work included in the position. The postdoctoral researcher will have access to career guidance.


Application procedure:

Applications will be evaluated by an expert panel of three members.

Applicants are asked to submit their application and CV online. Please use the link “Apply for this job” (“Søk stillingen”).

The following documentation should be uploaded as an attachment to the online application: 

  • A brief cover letter (max one page) including a description of research interests and motivation for working within the current project. The cover letter should include a detailed justification of your qualifications in relation to the listed requirements.
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and a complete list of academic publications)
  • PhD thesis
  • Transcripts and diplomas of bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degrees. If you have not yet been awarded your PhD degree, please submit a statement from your institution confirming the submission of the PhD thesis.
  • Copies of up to 5 selected academic publications
  • Names and contact details of 2 references (names, relation to candidate, email and telephone number).

Short-listed candidates might be required to give a research presentation, in addition to an interview. 

 

If the documents submitted are not in a Scandinavian language or in English, the applicants must submit certified translations of these. It is required that the applicant encloses a recognition document showing that their degree is equivalent to a Norwegian bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, or PhD. You can read more about applying for recognition of foreign higher education here.

 

The Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir) offers an automatic recognition document for certain degrees from selected countries. If the applicant’s degree is covered by the automatic recognition, it will be sufficient to attach this document. Read more about automatic recognition here.

 

As the HK-dir application process may take some time it is recommended to apply to HK-dir as soon as possible. If you have not received a recognition document from HK- dir within the application deadline, please enclose documentation from HK-dir showing that they have received your application.

 

Applicants should note that the evaluation will be based on the documentation submitted electronically via Jobbnorge within the submission deadline. The applicants are responsible for ensuring that all the documentation is submitted before the closing date. Applications cannot be sent by e-mail or to individuals at HVL.


Salary and benefits:

Exciting and stimulating work as part of a strong international academic environment.


An open and inclusive work environment with dedicated colleagues Favourable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.

The position as postdoctoral researcher is paid according to the Government's salary regulation, in position code 1352.


There is a compulsory 2 % deduction to the pension fund (see http://www.spk.no/en for more information). The successful applicant must comply with the guidelines that apply to the position at any time.


General information:

The appointment will be made in accordance with the regulations for State employees Law in Norway ("Lov om statens ansatte"). Organizational changes and changes in the duties and responsibilities associated with the position must be expected.

State employment shall reflect the multiplicity of the population at large to the highest possible degree. Western Norway University of Applied Sciences therefore aims to achieve a balanced age and gender composition and the recruitment of persons with diverse backgrounds.

Information about the applicants may be made public even though the applicant has requested not to be named in the list of applicants. The applicant will be notified if his/her request is not respected.

Short-listed applicants will be called in for an interview.

Employed on condition that you are granted a work and residence permit (must be considered individually).


Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is subjected to The Export Control Regulation. The regulation will be applied in the processing of the applications.


Contacts:

1) Professor Carina Bringedal, project leader of PANum

phone: +47 55 58 79 76, e-mail: carina.bringedal@hvl.no 

2) Associate Professor Therese B. Sjursen, assistant department leader

phone: +47 97 14 46 69 , e-mail: Therese.Berge.Sjursen@hvl.no 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

With about 17,500 students, Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is one of the largest higher education institutions in Norway. A broad range of academic programmes are offered at Bachelor, Master and PhD levels, spread out on five campuses Førde, Sogndal, Bergen, Stord og Haugesund.

Our ambition is to build stronger and more solid academic and research environments that will interact nationally and internationally. The aim is to become a recognized actor on the international higher education arena. Increased international cooperation and engagement in externally funded projects will work towards this goal.

The Department of Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Mathematical Sciences has a strong academic and research environment, offering programmes at bachelor’s, master’s and PhD levels. The department has around 1,100 students and more than 120 staff members, and plays a key role in advancing technologies for digitalisation and the green transition.

We offer education across our campuses in Førde, Bergen and Haugesund, with six study programmes in computer science and electrical engineering, and teaching contributions in mathematics, statistics and physics.

The department hosts active research groups in areas such as software engineering, artificial intelligence, robotics, human-computer interaction and sensor networks, and collaborates closely with industry and public sector partners.

jobs.title: Field Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.

If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.

At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.

Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.

Place of work: Boden

What you’ll do

Right now, we are looking for a Field Engineering Manager – STM for our Engineering team within Project Delivery. This is a site-based role in Boden, supporting the construction of our large-scale greenfield steel plant.

As Field Engineering Manager, you will be the key technical link between the design organization, construction teams, EPCM partners, and contractors. Your focus will be on making engineering work in the field: resolving technical and constructability issues, managing field changes, and ensuring construction teams have the right information and engineering support to keep execution moving safely and efficiently.

Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.

    Act as the primary on-site engineering contact, connecting design teams with construction and contractor organizations
    Review drawings, specifications, vendor documentation, and technical information to identify and resolve field and constructability issues
    Manage Site Technical Queries (STQs) and Requests for Information (RFIs), ensuring timely and clear resolution
    Lead constructability reviews together with construction teams, contractors, and design engineers
    Coordinate technical matters with EPCM partners, OEMs, procurement, QA/QC, HSE, and Project Controls
    Manage field changes, technical deviations, Site Instructions, redlines, and as-built processes through the appropriate approval routes
    Support construction planning and look-ahead activities by identifying engineering constraints and risks to schedule
    Lead and coordinate site-based field and discipline engineers, providing technical direction, support, and development

What you’ll bring

You’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.

For this role, we are looking for someone who combines strong engineering judgement with a practical understanding of construction. You should be comfortable being close to the work in the field, making decisions, resolving technical issues, and working across organizational boundaries to keep construction progressing.

Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below

    Relevant experience in field engineering, project engineering, or engineering-construction interface roles within large-scale industrial or construction projects
    Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Structural, Mechanical, or another relevant engineering discipline
    Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering activities in a site-based construction environment
    Strong ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, vendor documentation, and construction methods
    Good understanding of RFI/STQ processes, field changes, document control, redlines, and as-built documentation
    Experience working across design, construction, contractors, QA/QC, HSE, procurement, and Project Controls
    Strong practical problem-solving skills with the ability to develop solutions that can be implemented in the field
    Experience leading or coordinating engineering teams, with strong communication skills in English

Benefits at Stegra

At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.

You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.

This is Stegra

Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.

By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.

Our Boden Site

Our Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.

jobs.employer: PRIMA ASSISTANSE AS AVD MØRE OG ROMSDAL
jobs.description:
BPA assistent søkes – bli en viktig del av hverdagen.


Vil du ha en meningsfull og variert jobb hvor du kan gjøre en forskjell i et annet menneskes hverdag?

Jeg er en dame som ønsker å finne en trygg, positiv og pålitelig assistent som kan bli en viktig del av hverdagen min. Hos meg handler BPA om mer enn bare praktisk hjelp - det handler om å få en travel hverdag til å henge sammen, med rom for både humor, gode samtaler og hyggelige opplevelser.

Jeg setter stor pris på fleksible mennesker som kan være gode samarbeidspartnere og som kan ta initiativ samtidig som de respekterer at dette er mitt hjem og min hverdag. Kjemi, rolleforståelse og gode kommunikasjonsevner er viktig for meg. Jeg håper å finne en person som kan trives sammen med meg over tid.

Om jobben

Arbeidsoppgavene vil være varierte og tilpasses behovene i hverdagen. Det kan blant annet innebære:

·     Praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet og lettere husarbeid

·     Å bistå med arbeidsoppgaver på jobb

·     Bistand til ulike aktiviteter og gjøremål

·     Matlaging og tilrettelegging rundt måltider

·     Hjelp til personlig stell og forflytning

·     Å være med på turer og reiser

En viktig del av stillingen vil innebære å være med på jobb og bidra i arbeidsoppgavene mine. Det er derfor viktig at du er trygg og har evne til å tilpasse deg ulike settinger. Dette er noe du selvfølgelig vil få god opplæring i også.

Vi ser etter deg som

·      Er positiv, trygg og løsningsorientert

·      Er selvstendig og ansvarsfull

·      Har godt humør og bidrar til en hyggelig hverdag

·      Er strukturert og tilpasningsdyktig

·      Er fleksibel og en god samarbeidspartner

·      Er komfortabel med å være med på ulike aktiviteter og i forskjellige miljøer

·      Liker å lage mat – dette er en stor fordel

·      Har førerkort klasse B

·      Har mulighet til å jobbe både dag, ettermiddag/kveld og helg

·      Kan være med på turer og reiser

Det viktigste er ikke hvilken utdanning du har, men hvem du er. Ingen særskilt utdanning kreves, og du vil få god opplæring.

Hva er BPA?

BPA handler om å gi mennesker med assistansebehov større frihet til å styre sin egen hverdag. Som personlig assistent jobber du tett med et annet menneske og bidrar til at vedkommende kan leve et aktivt og mest mulig selvstendig liv – på egne premisser.

Dette er en jobb hvor du virkelig kan gjøre en forskjell. Du får samtidig en variert og meningsfull arbeidshverdag, gode relasjoner og muligheten til å bli en viktig del av en annens hverdag.

Vi tilbyr

·      God opplæring og trygg oppstart

·      En variert og meningsfull arbeidshverdag

·      Fast kontaktperson hos Prima Assistanse

·      Mulighet for å bli en del av et hyggelig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

Høres dette ut som en jobb for deg? Da håper vi å høre fra deg!

Ved ansettelse må politiattest fremlegges.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Founding Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
Who we are looking for

As our Founding Business Development Representative (BDR), you'll be the engine behind our sales pipeline - the first Birdsview person many prospects talk to. You'll open doors across Europe and beyond, working closely with our sales team to turn interest into qualified opportunities.

Birdsview - Prolonging the lifetime of the built world

Birdsview is a Norwegian technology company on a mission to change the way we preserve critical infrastructure to ensure a more sustainable and secure future.

Infrastructure is one of society’s most important assets. It includes the buildings we live in, the bridges we cross and the power grid that provides us with electricity. These structures are aging rapidly, and solutions that help preserve and secure critical infrastructure are now needed more than ever.

Birdsview's state-of-the-art technology combines radar (GPR), lidar, and AI to visualize what’s inside structures without destructive interventions. This allows for efficient and cost-effective inspection and monitoring of our most precious infrastructures - and enables clear, user-friendly visualizations that enhance understanding, extend asset lifespan, and promote material reuse - ultimately reducing costs and CO₂ emissions.

We are 17 people, we have customers in 9 countries, and we raised NOK 40.5 million from leading Nordic VC's to scale internationally.

About the job and why it matters

Much of concrete inspection today still relies on manual methods and fragmented, ageing non-destructive testing (NDT) equipment. You will help structural engineers, contractors, surveying specialists, and asset owners see clearly what is hidden inside the concrete. New critical data, faster inspections, and real cost savings are why they want our technology in their daily projects.

As a Founding BDA, you will be the engine behind our international growth. The role is to reach the right prospects, understand the problems they face, and show them what our technology does. You will build target account lists in HubSpot, make cold calls, drive LinkedIn and email outreach, and book qualified meetings for our sales team. This is a foundational role in a newly established sales team, where you will have a direct impact on our strategy, processes, and success.

  • Build the target list
    Research accounts across Europe and North America, and find the people who actually make the decision.

  • Run outbound
    Personalised outreach by phone, email and LinkedIn - plus follow-up on inbound leads and contacts from conferences.

  • Qualify and book
    Qualify opportunities, book meetings for the sales team, and keep our CRM clean enough that we can see what works.

  • Know the product and the market
    Deeply enough to have real conversations, not scripted ones.

  • Sharpen the message
    Feed back what you hear from prospects so marketing can build on it.

What we're looking for

  • Hunger and dedication to win.

  • Clear writing, thoughtful research, and confidence on the phone.

  • Outbound experience in SaaS, tech or another B2B role is a plus, not a requirement. Able to build pipeline yourself.

  • Organised and self-driven.

  • Comfortable working in a CRM. We use HubSpot.

  • At home where the process is still being figured out, you're helping figuring it out.

  • Fluent in English. Norwegian, German, Spanish or French is a strong plus given where our customers are.

Why this is interesting

  • Top-tier colleagues
    Work alongside leading people in a supportive and ambitious team culture, with regular social events and company trips.

  • Build it yourself
    Be a foundational member, directly shaping our international sales strategy and playbook.

  • Room to grow
    We're building the commercial team right now. What you own in a year depends on what you build in the first six months.

  • Impact
    Make a tangible impact on preserving critical infrastructure and fostering a circular economy.

  • Compensation
    Competitive salary, commission, and equity - become an owner.

  • Location
    Work in Bergen or Oslo with a fast-moving, hands-on team. Excellent working facilities at StartupLab centrally located in both cities.

View the full details for the job here.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Help us take Birdsview global!

Birdsview is building the "MRI for concrete", turning scans into clear answers about what's inside a structure, without breaking it open. Survey companies, structural engineers, and construction companies in 9 countries already use it in the field.

Who we are

Birdsview is building the "MRI for concrete", turning a scan into clear answers about what's inside a structure, without breaking it open. Survey companies, structural engineers, and construction companies in 9 countries already use it in the field.

We just closed a NOK 40.5 million funding round to scale internationally, and we're building our sales organization from the ground up. That's the opportunity here: this isn't a seat on an existing team following an existing playbook — it's a chance to help write it.

We're a team of 17 today, based in Bergen and Oslo, moving fast and covering a lot of ground.

Key figures

    Customers

    Employees

Our culture

🌍 Impactful work
Contribute to a sustainable future by prolonging the lifetime of the built world and circular economy

🤝 Collaborative team
Work alongside curious, innovative, and inspiring individuals.

Take individual responsibility and help build the company's future.

Share in our success and become a company owner.

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

OPENING FROM KRAKEN TECHNOLOGIES FRANCE 🇫🇷 - ALL LOCATIONS

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

 

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

 

We’re a technology company focused on creating a smart, sustainable energy system. From optimising renewable generation, creating a more intelligent grid and enabling utilities to provide excellent customer experiences, our operating system for energy is transforming the industry around the world in a way that benefits everyone.

 

It’s a really exciting time in energy. Help us make a real impact on shaping a better, more sustainable future.

 

Kraken Customer

 

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

Our mission is to provide cheaper, greener energy to the French market.

 

Octopus Energy France is a fast-growing energy company recognized as an ESS (social economy). **We offer a better experience to our customers through transparency, honesty and simplicity. We want to do better for the planet, through real, long-term investment in renewable energy production and a low-CO2 future that's better for our customers' wallets. We want to revolutionize the energy business through our people, our platform and our use of data.

 

Our focus is on customer satisfaction, and receiving positive reviews is important to us - we have the best score among French energy suppliers on Google Reviews and Trust Pilot.

 

Kraken technologies

 

Kraken Technologies is a company within Octopus Energy Group who are licensing the Kraken platform and operating model to clients across the world. Current clients are both the Octopus Energy retails businesses around the world as well as external clients such as Good Energy, Origin, EDF, E.ON & Queensland Energy - with many more expected to join over the next few years!

 

Our team

 

All technology is written and maintained by a multi-discipline engineering team of around 450 people globally. This includes server-side, client-side and mobile engineers working closely with UX experts, copywriters and designers.

We follow a Kanban-like approach, using Google docs and Asana to specify and manage work; Github, CircleCI and Terraform Enterprise as part of an immutable-infrastructure, continuous delivery pipeline; and Loggly, Sentry and Cloudwatch to measure performance and monitor production.

Some of our coding conventions are open-source.

Octopus is a great place to learn, work with some talented engineers and level-up your skills.

 

Our technology

 

On the server-side, we mainly use Python. Most of our websites are powered by Django and the Django-REST-framework. We also use Pandas, Numpy and Jupyter for analysis and forecasting, plus Celery, RabbitMQ, SQS and Airflow for background processing.

 

We use AWS heavily, employing most of the "Hashistack" (eg Packer, Consul, Terraform) as part of a continuous deployment pipeline. See, for example, Django, ELB health checks and continuous delivery.

 

Client-side, we use React, Redux and SASS; our mobile apps are built using native code or React Native.

 

🚀 What you’ll own

  • We have lots of difficult design challenges to solve. The French energy market is complicated, outdated and process-heavy - there's an awful lot of domain modelling that we need to get right. Strong attention to detail is essential.

  • You will be working in a multi-disciplinary software engineering team; solving design challenges; domain modeling; solving technical problems; engineering solutions for smart meters, writing robust fault-tolerant software primarily in Python and Django, Celery, and async processing

  • We have lots of difficult design challenges to solve. The energy market is complicated, outdated, and process-heavy - there's an awful lot of domain modeling that we need to get right. Strong attention to detail is essential.

  • We have difficult technical problems to solve. With the advent of smart meters, we'll soon be processing millions of meter readings a day.

  • There's a great opportunity for disruption in the energy market. The big suppliers still dominate but are not exactly popular. The energy landscape is changing as we move to more disaggregated forms of generation, with less predictability, more dynamism, and smarter technology. Octopus Energy was the first UK supplier to introduce a "tracker" tariff whose prices track the daily wholesale prices: http://www.cleanenergynews.co.uk/news/efficiency/octopus-offerstransparency-with-wholesale-price-tariff

  • You'll be working for a company that’s fighting climate change. Our parent company is the largest investor in solar generation in the UK and is funding wind and anaerobic digestion. As a supplier, we're helping people to use greener technology and renewable energy, all helping move the world towards a lower carbon future.

🧠 What you bring to the party

  • Python (minimum 7 y.e.)

  • Django (or equiv. web framework)

  • Fluent in French, and level B2 at least in English

  • Domain modelling

  • HTTP and REST APIs

  • Writing robust and fault-tolerant software

  • Celery and async processing

  • Postgres

⭐️ Bonus points

  • AWS

  • Terraform, Packer, Consul

  • React and Redux

jobs.title: Postdoc positions within Robotics for Laboratory Automation
jobs.description:
SDU Robotics is currently extending the team within the project CAPeX which focuses on robotics for laboratory automation. We therefore invite applications for one or more fully funded postdoc positions. The position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

 

What we offer

  • An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

  • Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

  • An opportunity to collaborate with excellent researchers within the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery

 

Job description

SDU Robotics currently has an open 2-year postdoc position in relation to CAPeX; specifically, for the development of a robotic solution for automation of laboratory experiments that require manipulation of tubes, fragile glass vials, and liquids. The robotic solution should be flexible in the sense that it should be able to conduct several experiments with little user-intervention, operate alongside humans, and recover from failures. Consequently, visual feedback must be used for adapting robot behavior to a dynamic environment.  The postdoc should contribute to the deployment of the developed solution in laboratories in both SDU and DTU. The successful candidate will work closely with other PhDs and postdoc candidates in CAPeX.

As a postdoctoral researcher, your role will encompass mainly research, but teaching responsibilities could also be part of the employment. The main duties and responsibilities include: 

  • Research in collaboration with colleagues from SDU Robotics and CAPeX.

  • Conducting scientific research and publishing the results in high quality scientific conferences/journals.

  • Supporting the team in securing external funding.

  • Contributing to the project CAPeX deliverables. 

 

Profile and requirements

The position requires research experience at PhD level in a relevant area such as robotics, preferably applied to robotic systems controlled using visual feedback. The candidate is hence expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Expert knowledge in the control of robots

  • Experience in simulation of robotic systems

  • Experience in design and development of robotic systems

  • Experience with using computer vision.

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to:

  • Have excellent knowledge of English (written and spoken).

  • Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team.

  • Have the ability of working independently.

  • Have a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Conduct independent research. 

 

Research environment

The candidate will be integrated into the SDU Robotics unit, which is a team of approx. 60 employees. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics. The group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners.

We are a team specialized in robot solutions involving modelling, estimation, and control of advanced robot systems. In addition, the candidate will be integrated into CAPeX - a pioneer center for accelerating P2X materials discovery and working on automation of laboratory experiments.

CAPeX is a 13-year and 300 MDKK “Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery”, funded by Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science, the Danish National Research Foundation, the Carlsberg Foundation, the Lundbeck Foundation, the Novo Nordisk Foundation, and the Villum Foundation. CAPeX is hosted by the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) and co-hosted by Aalborg University (AAU), and unites leading experts from DTU, AAU, University of Copenhagen, Aarhus University, and the University of Southern Denmark with international partners from Stanford University, Utrecht University, and the University of Toronto to form a truly Pioneering Center on P2X. You can read more about the CAPeX research themes and X-trails, our organization, and the other open PhD and postdoc cohort positions at http://www.capex-p2x.com. 

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your academic growth as a researcher in SDU Robotics. 

 

Further information 

Further information about this position is available via email from Professor Christoffer Sloth chsl@mmmi.sdu.dk.

Please visit us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sdu-robotics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

The application deadline is October 28, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Employment as a postdoc requires scientific qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications.

The application may also include: 

  • Research statement. 

  • Summary of experience in teaching. 

  • References (names and emails) and/or reference letters.

  • Documentation of other qualifications with relevance for the position. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2026. Extension may be possible depending on available funding (no more than 4 years at the same university).

The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

Research will be predominant in the position. Teaching assignments can be agreed individually. Furthermore, other types of assignments may occur to a limited degree. The faculty determines the distribution of the various assignments. The weighting of the different assignments may vary over time.

Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

jobs.description:
Haemme mekaniikka-asentajia Vantaalle!

Haemme asiakkaallemme Rosendahl Nextrom mekaniikka-asentajia teollisuuden laitteiden kokoonpanoon Vantaan toimipisteelle. Työsuhde alkaa määräaikaisena, ja jatkossa sinulla on mahdollisuus työllistyä asiakkaan omille kirjoille tai jatkaa vuokratyösuhteessa.


Työtehtävät

Tehtäviisi kuuluu teollisuuden laitteiden mekaaninen kokoonpano. Työt vaihtelevat pienkokoonpanoista suurempiin kokonaisuuksiin. Työ sisältää mm.:

 * peltien kiinnityksiä
 * laakerointeja
 * kuularuuvien ja lineaarikiskojen asennuksia sekä linjausta
 * porausta ja osien muokkausta tarpeen mukaan


Toivomme sinulta

 * kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä teollisuudessa
 * huolellista ja tarkkaa työotetta
 * reipasta ja oma-aloitteista asennetta
 * piirustusten lukutaitoa 

Huomioimme haussa myös uransa alkuvaiheessa olevat asentajat.


Palkkaus ja työaika

 * Palkkaus: sopimuksen mukaan (n. 15-16 €/h)
 * Työaika: ma-pe, pääsääntöisesti klo 7-15 (liukuma mahdollista)
 * Viikkotyöaika: 37,5 h

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan lokakuussa. Alkuun kanssasi solmitaan määräaikainen työsopimus vuoden loppuun saakka. Tämän jälkeen jatko mahdollinen oman suoriutumisen mukaan.

Rosendahl Nextrom is the leading global supplier of production technologies for optical fibers and fiber optic cables. Our core competencies include solutions for optical glass making, fiber drawing, fiber coating, ribbon making, proof testing and fiber optic cable production. From first contact onwards, we provide customized high quality solutions and personal support to ensure total customer satisfaction. Nextrom is a business unit of Rosendahl Nextrom GmbH.

Täytäthän hakemuksen huolellisesti oheisen linkin kautta ja liitä mukaan CV sekä palkkatoiveesi. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa HR-asiantuntijamme Isa Saarniala, isa.saarniala@rtkhenkilostopalvelu.fi / puh. 044 412 5543

RTK-Henkilöstöpalvelu auttaa työntekijöitä ja työnantajia löytämään toisensa nopeasti ja suoraviivaisesti. Tunnemme työelämän tarpeet erinomaisesti, mikä mahdollistaa erinomaisen osumatarkkuutemme. Näin autamme asiakkaitamme menestymään muuttuvassa työelämässä.

Olemme työntekijöillemme luotettava ja joustava työnantaja, joka valvoo etuasi ja on läsnä ja tukena arjessasi. Tuemme työntekijöittemme omaehtoista virkistystoimintaa tarjoamalla Edenred liikunta- ja kulttuurietua. Lisäksi työntekijät saavat käyttöönsä laajan henkilöstöetuohjelman ja aina uusia työtarjouksia tarpeen tullen.

Meillä on aina haku päällä – tutustu työpaikkojen kirjoon, täytä hakemus tai ota yhteyttä ja anna meidän hoitaa loput: www.rtkhenkilostopalvelu.fi/avoimet-tyopaikat/

jobs.title: Hub General Manager
jobs.description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Lead the future of PSD Hub ÖrebroAre you an experienced leader who thrives in complex, global environments and enjoys bringing people, functions, and strategies together? We are looking for a Hub General Manager to lead Parts & Services Division (PSD) Hub Örebro through an important transformation journey. This is a highly visible leadership role where you will bring together approximately 200 employees and 30 managers across multiple functions, strengthening collaboration, alignment, and engagement while helping shape the hub's future as a Solution Acceleration Center. The role reports to Vice President Operations, Christel Fuellenbach.



Join our teamPSD Hub Örebro brings together a broad range of capabilities, including engineering, technical service, service training, marketing, pricing, communications, e-commerce, and operational support functions. As Hub General Manager, you will act as the senior focal point for the hub and collaborate closely with divisional leadership, global stakeholders, HR, unions, Product Companies, and Customer Centers worldwide. The role is also part of PSD's global hub network, working closely with colleagues in Nanjing, Nashik, Garland, and Johannesburg.



Your missionYour mission is to create one aligned and high-performing hub organization while driving the transformation toward a stronger business-oriented and market-connected operating model.



Key priorities include:




    Building collaboration and a strong "one hub, one team" culture across functions and locations.
    Leading through influence in an environment with primarily indirect leadership responsibilities.
    Acting as the main interface between the hub and key stakeholders across the business.
    Strengthening cross-functional cooperation between engineering, operations, marketing, sourcing, and customer-facing organizations.
    Supporting the development of structures that improve value creation, revenue visibility, and solution commercialization.
    Driving organizational change while maintaining employee engagement and trust.  



Your profileWe believe you are an experienced leader who enjoys creating clarity, bringing people together, and driving change in complex organizations.



You have likely:




    Successfully led organizational transformation and change initiatives.
    Experience from large, cross-functional, and international organizations.
    Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trust across different levels of an organization.
    A collaborative leadership style with excellent communication skills.
    Experience from service, engineering, operations, aftermarket, or related business environments.



Experience from matrix organizations, indirect leadership, or commercial transformation is highly valued.



We know that great candidates do not always meet every single requirement. If this role interests you and you believe your experience can contribute to our success, we encourage you to apply.



Our leadership expectationsAt Epiroc, we expect our leaders to be inspirers, accelerators, and new thinkers. We value leaders who lead by example and have the courage to challenge the status quo. Safety and sustainability are our top priorities, and we expect our leaders to actively promote safety, inclusion, and diversity, while also prioritizing the well-being and continuous development of our employees. We are looking for you who have the courage to believe in new ideas and see opportunities where others see challenges.



Why Epiroc?By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact.



To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:




    Global career opportunities
    Learning & Development programs
    Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus)
    Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being
    Global Parental Leave Policy
    Community involvement



Location and otherÖrebro, Sweden. Occasional international travel.



Application and contact informationWe encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than October 31, 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.



We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.



For questions about the position, please contact:Hiring Manager: Christel Fuellenbach, Vice President Operations, christel.fuellenbach@epiroc.comRecruitment Specialist: Otto Wetterström, otto.wetterstrom@external.epiroc.com



We have already made our choices regarding advertising channels and consulting providers, and kindly request not to be contacted regarding such inquiries.

jobs.title: Technicien / Technicienne de hot line en informatique
jobs.description:
Enreach for Service Providers développe la plateforme UCaaS sur laquelle les opérateurs télécoms à travers l'Europe font fonctionner leurs communications professionnelles. Nous sommes environ 60 personnes basées à Sophia-Antipolis, membres du groupe Enreach. Notre logiciel est utilisé par des centaines de milliers d'utilisateurs de téléphonie professionnelle. Ici, le support n'est pas une simple fonction de déviation d'appels. C'est le point de contact où la plateforme rencontre la réalité du terrain.

Vos missions :
Être en première ligne : répondre à la hotline de support, qualifier les tickets Jira entrants et effectuer le premier diagnostic réel de chaque problème avant qu'il ne soit transmis ailleurs. C'est vous qui décidez de l'urgence.
Accompagner nos partenaires EUPCloud : nos partenaires SaaS ne disposent pas de leurs propres équipes opérationnelles. Ils comptent sur nous. Vous travaillerez directement avec eux - via Jira, les canaux Teams, le téléphone - pour les guider dans la configuration et les aider à comprendre leur propre plateforme. Cette partie du rôle est nouvelle, et c'est la raison pour laquelle nous recrutons.
Savoir gérer efficacement :  lorsqu'un problème dépasse le niveau L1, vous le documentez correctement et assurez le suivi jusqu'à sa résolution. Ici, on ne se contente pas de traiter des tickets à moitié diagnostiqués.
Documenter les procédures : tout problème que vous résolvez deux fois aurait dû être documenté une fois. Notre base de connaissances est le levier qui permet à l'équipe de gagner en rapidité.
Monter en expertise avec le temps : vous commencerez par le triage. En l'espace d'un an, vous connaîtrez notre plateforme mieux que la plupart de ceux qui l'ont construite, car vous aurez vu toutes les façons dont elle peut tomber en panne.

Votre profil :

Maîtrise du français et aisance en anglais : vous travaillerez en français au quotidien. Cependant, nos partenaires étant répartis dans toute l'Europe, vous devrez également répondre à des appels de la hotline et rédiger des mises à jour de tickets en anglais. Votre anglais n'a pas besoin d'être parfait ou sans accent. Il doit être suffisamment bon pour qu'un ingénieur stressé à Rotterdam se sente pris en charge.
Quelqu'un qui aime le téléphone : pas quelqu'un qui le "tolère", mais qui l'aime. Guider calmement un ingénieur stressé à travers un problème, un vendredi à 16h, est une véritable compétence et est au cœur de ce métier.
Curiosité pour le fonctionnement des systèmes : vous avez cassé quelque chose, vous avez compris pourquoi, et vous l'avez réparé. Linux et Unix, le réseau, et idéalement une première approche de SIP ou VoIP - même s'il s'agit simplement d'un serveur Asterisk maison et de beaucoup de Wireshark.
Autonome : on vous donnera un problème, pas un script. Il s'agit d'une petite équipe de personnes expérimentées qui agissent vite et n'attendent pas qu'on leur dise quoi faire.
Quelqu'un qui tire les autres vers le haut : nous déboguons ensemble, nous nous enseignons mutuellement, et personne ici ne garde ses connaissances pour soi. Si cela vous semble évident, nous nous entendrons bien.

Les petits plus (atouts) :
Maîtrise de Linux (famille Rocky / RHEL) au-delà des bases.
Connaissance de SIP, RTP, et les joies spécifiques du débogage d'un problème d'audio unidirectionnel.
Capacité à scripter dans n'importe quel langage.
Allemand, néerlandais ou espagnol : ces langues sont un plus, mais aucune n'est obligatoire.

Jusqu'à 2 jours de télétravail par semaine, une fois que vous aurez été pleinement intégré et que vous travaillerez en autonomie.

jobs.title: Restaurationsmanager
jobs.description:
Restaurationsmanager

Dit Smørrebrød i Skagen er en travl virksomhed i rivende udvikling. 
Vores kendetegn er traditionelt dansk smørrebrød til Skawboer og turister – uden dikkedarer.
Godt gammeldags smørrebrød, klassiske frokost retter samt “Mormor mad” på aftenmenuen, hvor det er lavet fra bunden med friske råvarer – og ”salt, peber og kærlighed”, råvarer af bedste kvalitet samt vores kvalitet og service er ALTID i top.

Vores restaurant emmer af afslappet stemning og maden indtages i hyggelig gammel dansk atmosfære med rød og hvidternede duge. Skagens hyggeligste frokost og aftens restaurant. 

Vi har stor ansvarsfølelse for vores ansatte - vi værdsætter gensidig tillid. Vi løser vores opgaver i fællesskab ved at serverer godt gedigent mad i en afslappet atmosfære, som er fyldt med grin og glæde for så vel ansatte som for vores gæster.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver
Som restaurantansvarlig får du en central rolle i den daglige drift, hvor du blandt andet skal:

•    Lede og koordinere restaurantteamet under vagterne
•    Fordele arbejdsopgaver og administrere personalets pauser
•    Sikre en effektiv og velfungerende service
•    Tage godt imod gæsterne og hjælpe til, hvor der er behov
•    Overvåge servicekvaliteten og sikre høj kundetilfredshed
•    Håndtere gæstespørgsmål og eventuelle reklamationer professionelt
•    Koordinere samarbejdet mellem køkken og serveringspersonale
•    Åbne og/eller lukke restauranten samt foretage kasseafstemning
•    Sikre, at restauranten altid fremstår ren, organiseret og klar til service
•    Medvirke til oplæring af nye medarbejdere
•    Løse udfordringer løbende under vagten
•    Stå for varebestilling og lagerstyring

Vi forestiller os, at du

•    Har erfaring fra restaurant- eller servicebranchen
•    Trives med ansvar og kan bevare overblikket i travle perioder
•    Er serviceminded, imødekommende og løsningsorienteret
•    Kan motivere og skabe et godt samarbejde blandt kollegaerne
•    Har fokus på kvalitet og gæsteoplevelser

Vi tilbyder

•    Helårsansættelse
•    Mulighed for bolig
•    Et uhøjtideligt arbejdsmiljø med plads til humor
•    Afslappet omgangstone og godt humør i hverdagen
•    Nogle af de gladeste gæster, fordi vi laver god mad
•    Gode kollegaer, hvor vi løfter i fællesskab
•    En hektisk, spændende og sjov højsæson
•    Attraktiv løn efter kvalifikationer

Arbejdstid i tidsrummet mellem kl. 10.00 og 21.00, på alle ugens dage

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning og CV til smag@smag-toscana.dk
