Donnez une nouvelle dimension à vos projets en construction métallique
------------------------------------------------------------------------

Vous êtes **dessinateur projeteur, dessinateur\-constructeur sur métal ou chef de projet en construction métallique** ? Vous souhaitez mettre votre savoir\-faire au service de réalisations techniques variées, en conservant un lien concret entre les études, la fabrication et le chantier ?

Notre partenaire est une **entreprise reconnue sur le marché suisse de la construction métallique**, bénéficiant d’une solide renommée pour son expertise technique et la qualité de ses réalisations. Elle intervient dans les domaines de la **serrurerie\-métallerie, des charpentes métalliques, des façades techniques, du bardage et de l’enveloppe du bâtiment**.

Dans le cadre de son développement, cette structure a fait appel à **l’expertise d’Alpia Recrutement SA** pour l’accompagner dans l’identification et le recrutement du professionnel qui occupera ce **poste stratégique au sein de son bureau technique**.

**Le dessin et la conception constituent le cœur du poste.** Selon votre expérience et vos aspirations, votre fonction pourra également comprendre la gestion technique, organisationnelle et financière des projets.

Vos missions : conception, dessin technique et suivi des réalisations
----------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Réaliser les plans d’ensemble, de détail, d’exécution, de fabrication et de montage**, à l’aide d’AutoCAD et des logiciels métiers utilisés par l’entreprise.
* Étudier les dossiers techniques, analyser les contraintes et développer des solutions adaptées aux ouvrages de **serrurerie, construction métallique et façades**.
* Préparer les dossiers nécessaires à la fabrication et à la pose : détails constructifs, nomenclatures, listes de matériaux et documents techniques.
* Assurer la coordination avec les architectes, les ingénieurs, le bureau technique, les fournisseurs, l’atelier et les équipes de montage.
* Participer au suivi des réalisations et veiller à la conformité des ouvrages, à la qualité d’exécution et au respect des délais.


**Pour les profils disposant d’une expérience en gestion de projet**, les responsabilités incluent également la planification, le suivi budgétaire, la préparation des offres, les consultations fournisseurs, les commandes et la relation client, jusqu’à la réception des travaux.

Votre profil
------------

* Vous disposez d’un **CFC de dessinateur\-constructeur sur métal**, d’une formation technique en construction métallique ou d’une qualification équivalente.
* Vous bénéficiez d’une expérience confirmée en **dessin technique, études ou gestion de projets**, dans la construction métallique, la serrurerie ou les façades.
* Vous maîtrisez le dessin assisté par ordinateur, notamment **AutoCAD** ou d'autres logiciels.
* Vous possédez une bonne compréhension des méthodes de fabrication, des assemblages et des contraintes de pose. La connaissance des normes suisses constitue un atout.
* Vous associez rigueur, autonomie et sens de l’organisation à un bon esprit d’équipe. Vous communiquez aisément en français avec les différents interlocuteurs du projet.


**Une expérience professionnelle en Suisse constitue un atout, mais n’est pas une exigence.** Ne pas avoir encore travaillé en Suisse ne représente en aucun cas un frein à votre candidature : nous porterons avant tout notre attention sur votre expertise métier, vos compétences techniques et votre motivation.

Un **brevet fédéral ou un diplôme fédéral en construction métallique** constitue un atout supplémentaire.

**Vous êtes avant tout dessinateur projeteur et souhaitez rester proche de la conception ?** Votre candidature nous intéresse également : le périmètre des responsabilités sera défini selon votre expérience et les besoins de l’entreprise.

Ce que notre partenaire vous offre
----------------------------------

* Un **poste fixe en CDI**, au sein d’une entreprise reconnue et solidement implantée sur le marché suisse de la construction métallique.
* Des projets variés en **construction métallique, serrurerie, façades et enveloppe du bâtiment**, alliant exigences techniques et qualité architecturale.
* Un environnement de travail structuré, avec une collaboration directe entre le bureau technique, les équipes de fabrication et les équipes de montage.
* Une autonomie adaptée à votre expérience, ainsi que des possibilités de formation et d’évolution technique ou vers la gestion de projets.

jobs.description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more athttps://www.jnj.com/.



About Orthopaedics

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of Orthopaedics? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal? Our Orthopaedics teams help keep more than 6 million people moving each year while delivering clinical and economic value to surgeons and healthcare systems. Our teams build solutions for joint reconstruction; trauma and craniomaxillofacial; sports, extremities, and elective foot and ankle; spine; and robotics and digital surgery.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech



Strategic Account Manager Orthopaedics - Johnson & Johnson

Western Part of Switzerland

Are you passionate about making a tangible difference in healthcare? Do you thrive on building strong relationships and driving growth? We are seeking a Senior Strategic Account Manager to join our sales team, drive market expansion, and deliver innovative surgical solutions to our customers. This role anchors Johnson & Johnson’s go-to-market strategy, emphasizing long-term partnerships and measurable value for patients. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to elevate customer outcomes and fuel sustainable business growth. If you’re a strategic thinker with a proven track record in key account management, we’d love to hear from you.



Responsibilities

Strategic Account Management is an essential part of the future business strategy for the Johnson & Johnson companies. It is how we will go to market as an Orthopaedics organization and will be critical to our future growth plans. With this approach to our non-clinical customers, we can demonstrate the long-term value of partnership and working with Johnson & Johnson, most importantly, our impact on patient care.

In the role as Strategic Account Manager you will report to the Lead of the Strategic Account Management for Orthopaedics and be responsible for developing mutually beneficial long-term partnerships with clinical and non-clinical partners in a given number of designated key accounts.

In conjunction with the Business Units, you will develop and lead the account strategy to drive additional profitable sales and market share growth within Hospital, Hospital Groups & Group Purchasing Organizations.

Together with the clinical team, you will coordinate and support the proposal development process, presenting opportunities and risks along with their implications to the required levels of management.

As key driver of our Value Based Health Care Strategy you will lead negotiations for commercial agreements and coordinate their execution across care centers, in collaboration with the Business Unit and Shared Functions (Pricing, Services & Solutions, HEMA, etc.).

You will be the representative of Johnson & Johnson Orthopaedics for the commercial partners in strategic accounts.



Qualifications

Master’s degree in Business Administration or relevant field is an advantage.

Several years of clinical experience in a Sales Manager or Key Account Manager role, with proven experience in managing non-clinical partnerships.

Deep understanding of the healthcare market and the local regulatory/policy environment; adept at identifying short-term and long-term factors impacting the business.

Experience in contract negotiations and deal structuring.

Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills in French to professionally represent Johnson & Johnson’s MedTech in the country; strong English skills (written and spoken) are required; proficiency in a second official language is preferred.

German language skills in writing and speaking are a plus.

Strong negotiation skills, high self-confidence, courage, and conviction.

Analytical and strategic thinker with solid business acumen.

Project management capabilities with the ability to lead complex initiatives involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.

Strong team spirit and collaborative mindset.



Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone Orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 4 to 9 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals.

Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans.In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.

NGS Scientist (single\-cell and spaital Omics)
==============================================







For our Client, a leading pharmaceutical company based in Basel, we are looking for a motivated NGS Scientist\-







Single\-cell and spatial omics technologies are transforming biomedical research by enabling deep characterization of complex biological systems at unprecedented resolution. These technologies provide critical insights into cellular heterogeneity, disease mechanisms, therapeutic responses, and translational biology.



We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist / Associate Scientist to join a cutting\-edge genomics platform team focused on single\-cell sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, and next\-generation sequencing (NGS) applications. The successful candidate will work at the interface of molecular biology, genomics, and translational research, supporting the development and implementation of innovative omics technologies that accelerate scientific discovery and therapeutic innovation.







Key Responsibilities



* Develop, optimize, and implement advanced NGS\-based workflows with a focus on:
* Single\-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA\-seq)
* Spatial transcriptomics
* Multi\-omics and multimodal profiling approaches
* Independently perform molecular biology experiments and troubleshoot complex workflows.
* Execute sample processing, nucleic acid extraction, PCR/qPCR, library preparation, sequencing, and quality control activities.
* Generate, analyze, and document experimental results with a high level of scientific rigor.
* Work with challenging sample types including FFPE tissues, primary samples, and low\-input materials.
* Collaborate closely with bioinformatics and cross\-functional research teams to interpret sequencing datasets and derive biological insights.
* Ensure generation of high\-quality, FAIR\-compliant data.
* Present scientific findings, protocols, and recommendations to internal stakeholders.
* Contribute to continuous innovation and enhancement of platform capabilities.






Required Qualifications



* Master's degree in Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Life Sciences, Genomics, or a related discipline.
* 1\-3 years of industry or relevant research experience in genomics or molecular biology.
* Hands\-on experience with Next\-Generation Sequencing (NGS) workflows.
* Strong expertise in:
* DNA/RNA extraction
* PCR and qPCR
* NGS library preparation
* Molecular biology laboratory techniques
* Experience handling clinical or challenging biological samples such as FFPE tissue, tumor specimens, or low\-input samples.
* Proven ability to independently design, execute, analyze, and troubleshoot experiments.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
* Fluent English.






Preferred Qualifications



* Hands\-on experience with single\-cell sequencing platforms (e.g. 10x Genomics Chromium).
* Experience with spatial transcriptomics and spatial biology technologies (e.g. Visium, Xenium, CosMx, RNAscope).
* Knowledge of transcriptomics, genomics, and multi\-omics approaches.
* Experience with assay development, method optimization, and technology implementation.
* Familiarity with basic bioinformatics analyses and interpretation of sequencing datasets.
* Experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or translational research environment.






What We're Looking For



We are particularly interested in candidates who combine strong wet\-lab genomics expertise with a passion for emerging technologies such as single\-cell sequencing and spatial biology. Successful candidates are curious, innovative, collaborative, and excited about applying cutting\-edge omics technologies to advance translational research and therapeutic discovery.

jobs.title: Global Merchandising Head Of Lifestyle & Special Projects
jobs.description:
In short
As the Global Merchandising Head Of Lifestyle & Special Projects, you will shape and drive the Global Merchandising strategy across On’s Lifestyle portfolio, spanning both Lifestyle Footwear and Special Projects across Footwear, Apparel and Accessories.
You will own the global range architecture, consumer proposition and tailored assortments, ensuring On delivers the right product, to the right consumer, in the right channel, at the right time and at the right price.
At the heart of this role is creating consumer desirability and brand heat while building a sustainable and scalable Lifestyle business. You will translate On’s global brand and product strategy into compelling assortments that balance commercial performance with premium brand positioning.
You will bring a strong point of view on consumer, product, channel and market opportunity, influencing product briefs and franchise strategies from the earliest stages of development through to seasonal execution and sell-through.
For Special Projects, you will apply the same commercial and consumer lens to build high-impact, culturally relevant and strategically important product stories, using controlled distribution, scarcity and tailored assortments to create demand and strengthen On’s premium positioning.
You will partner closely with Product, Design, Innovation, Brand, Regional Merchandising, Partnership Management, VM and Global and Regional Sales to ensure consumer and market insights translate into differentiated product strategies, global range architecture and commercially successful assortments.

Your mission
Build the Global Lifestyle Merchandising Strategy
- Define and evolve the global merchandising strategy for Lifestyle and Special Projects, translating On’s broader brand and product priorities into clear consumer and commercial strategies.
- Build the global range architecture ensuring an efficient yet compelling Lifestyle proposition.
- Identify opportunities to expand Lifestyle into new consumer segments, channels and categories while protecting On’s premium positioning.
- Develop clear merchandising frameworks that balance consumer desirability, brand heat, commercial opportunity and sustainable profitability.

Drive Product & Franchise Strategy
- Influence product briefs and franchise strategies from concept through to commercialization, ensuring products are rooted in clear consumer and market opportunities.
- Establish clear roles for hero, core, growth and incubation franchises, ensuring the portfolio evolves with consumer demand.
- Identify when franchises should be scaled, reset, repositioned or exited based on consumer and commercial signals.

Own Global Range & Assortment Excellence
- Build seasonal range plans across Lifestyle and Special Projects, translating global strategy into detailed SKU-level line plans.
- Build consumer-right tailored channel assortments globally, balancing global consistency with regional and account-specific opportunities.
- Provide a clear point of view on product flow, colour needs, depth, price and channel distribution to maximize seasonal performance.
- Ensure global and regional teams are aligned on the range strategy while allowing appropriate market localization.

Lead Special Projects
- Own the global merchandising strategy for Special Projects, working project-by-project to define the consumer proposition, range, targets, distribution and commercial strategy.
- Develop clear scarcity and allocation frameworks to balance brand heat with commercial opportunity.
- Partner closely with Product, Design and Brand to bring strategically important innovations and collaborations to market.
- Ensure Special Projects acts as an incubator for future Lifestyle franchises, consumer insights and new business opportunities.
- Set sell-through, volume, NS and productivity targets and ensure the range is structured to deliver against them.

Drive Commercial Performance
- Own global seasonal targets and commercial KPIs across Lifestyle and Special Projects.
- Identify commercial risks and opportunities early and drive cross-functional actions to address them.
- Use performance data, consumer signals and market intelligence to continuously refine the global range strategy.

Your story
- 8+ years of experience within premium sportswear, luxury fashion or streetwear with significant experience owning global or multi-market businesses.
- Strong people leader with the ability to build, develop and inspire a high-performing global merchandising team.
- Proven track record of building global merchandising strategies and commercial plans across multiple channels and markets.
- Deep understanding of Lifestyle and sneaker culture, with a strong instinct for what will create consumer relevance and brand heat.
- Commercially strong, with the ability to balance brand aspiration, consumer desirability and financial performance.
- Highly comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed global environment, with strong executive presence and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
- A strategic thinker who can move seamlessly between 5-year vision and SKU-level detail.
- Exceptional relationship builder who can connect Product, Design, Innovation, Brand, Merchandising, Sales and Regional teams around a common consumer and commercial ambition.
- A resilient, entrepreneurial leader who thrives in ambiguity, embraces change and proactively builds solutions in a high-growth environment.
- Data-led but consumer obsessed, able to combine quantitative insights with strong product and cultural intuition.

Meet the team
On’s Global Merchandising Team sits at the center of Product, Brand and Commercial Strategy, ensuring we create and deliver the right product to the right consumer, in the right market, at the right time and at the right scale.
As the Global Merchandising Head of Lifestyle (Inline) & Special Projects, you will lead the merchandising strategy for one of On’s key future growth opportunities, working across global and regional teams to build a consumer-led, commercially sustainable and culturally relevant Lifestyle business.
You will be a key voice in shaping not only what we sell, but where On plays, how we build demand and how we scale the Lifestyle business globally

### description:

Working within a global clinical supply chain team, you will manage end\-to\-end distribution activities for a portfolio of clinical studies. Your responsibilities will cover the deployment of clinical inventory across an international depot network, from technical release through importation and delivery to depots and clinical sites.

Swisslinx is seeking a Global Clinical Distribution Lead on behalf of an international pharmaceutical company. This role offers the opportunity to support a diverse clinical development portfolio, helping ensure investigational medicines reach clinical trial sites and patients on time.

* Manage on\-time delivery of shipments across the distribution network to meet study requirements and patient demand.
* Represent clinical distribution in cross\-functional study and supply execution teams.
* Resolve operational and system issues affecting delivery performance, working with internal stakeholders and external providers.

* Lead and contribute to distribution projects and continuous improvement initiatives.

* Fluency in English, with strong communication and active listening skills.
* An action\-oriented approach and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders.

    Är ansvarstagande, lyhörd och pålitlig
    Är trygg i dig själv och har ett genuint intresse för att arbeta med människor
    Är flexibel och anpassningsbar efter olika individers behov och personligheter

Vad erbjuder vi?

jobs.title: Lagerarbetare/Chaufför/Innesäljare Södertälje
jobs.description:
Lagerarbetare/Chaufför/Innesäljare

Lundagrossisten grundades år 1977 och bedriver B2B-försäljning av artiklar inom värme, vatten och sanitet. Vi är idag en av Sveriges ledande VVS-grossister med en årlig omsättning på 1,9 miljarder kronor och 240 medarbetare. Våra kunder är uteslutande professionella rörinstallatörer med ett stort och kontinuerligt materialbehov. Vi finns representerade från Malmö i söder till Gävle i norr, genom våra 21 fullstorterade hämtlager med över 17 000 lagerlagda artiklar. Vi är just nu inne i en expansiv fas och har därför ett stort rekryteringsbehov.

Ett omväxlande jobb hos en trygg och långsiktig arbetsgivare!

Som Lagerarbetare/Chaufför/Innesäljare förväntas du arbetar med samtligt förekommande lagersysslor såsom orderplock, inleveranser samt utkörningar av material med B-lastbil. På Lundagrossisten lär du dig en bransch, ett företag och ett yrke från grunden, där praktiskt arbete varvas med interna utbildningar inom bland annat truckkörning och vårt affärssystem. När du är självgående inom lager och logistik kommer du även att gå våra interna utbildningar inom VVS och försäljning och på så sätt även växa in i rollen som innesäljare.  

Vi eftersträvar långsiktiga arbetsrelationer och är stolta över att kunna säga att vi sedan starten 1977 aldrig har varslat eller permitterat någon medarbetare!

Tjänsten är en heltidstjänst och innebär goda utvecklingsmöjligheter, då Lundagrossistens policy är att internrekrytera till befattningar inom inköp, marknad, IT, utesälj och platschefsansvar.

Relevanta egenskaper och förkunskaper

B-körkort är ett krav. Truckkort erhålles på arbetsplatsen.

VVS-kunskaper är initialt inte ett krav, men du ska däremot vara motiverad att tillgodogöra dig dessa kunskaper i arbetet och via våra interna utbildningar.

Som medarbetare på Lundagrossisten krävs det att du har ett strukturerat arbetssätt och tycker om att jobba i ett effektivt tempo och med många kontakter. Egenskaper som är relevanta är engagemang, flexibilitet, prestigelöshet samt en god känsla för service och försäljning. Vi ser gärna att du har ett intresse av teknik, bygg eller mekanik.



Omfattning                   Heltid

Anställningsform         Tillsvidareanställning efter 6 månaders provanställning

Ingångslönen baseras på tidigare, relevant erfarenhet. Vår målsättning är att samtliga nya medarbetare ska ha uppnått kunskapsnivån och kompetensen som teknisk säljare inom två års arbete och därmed erhålla en månadslön om 37 000 kronor. Därefter sker en individbaserad löneutveckling, som baseras på din ansvarskänsla och prestation i arbetet.  

Sista ansökningsdag är den 1 november 2026, men urval och intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan detta datum.

jobs.title: Personlig assistent till Sollentuna
jobs.description:
Särnmark är ett av Sveriges äldsta företag inom personlig assistans och grundades av nuvarande ägare i början av 1990-talet. Vi arbetar med utgångspunkt i en tydlig och uttalad värdegrund och vår främsta drivkraft är att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för en individanpassad personlig assistans utifrån varje persons unika behov. Särnmark har idag över 3500 medarbetare och våra kunder och medarbetare finns över hela Sverige. Särnmarks huvudkontor ligger i Sundbyberg men vi har även kontor i andra delar i Sverige.

Vill du ha ett arbete där du verkligen betyder något för ett barn varje dag?

Vi söker nu flera varma, stabila och engagerade personliga assistenter till en 11-årig pojke i Sollentuna.

Han är en nyfiken och charmig kille som älskar musik, spelar piano och gärna pratar. Han har rätt stort ordförråd men talet är otydligt så du kommer arbeta med hjälpmedel som tex widgitplatta. Du får introduktion i detta.

När han känner sig trygg visar han mycket humor, personlighet och glädje.

Han tycker också mycket om att vara ute, promenader och andra aktiviteter ute är en viktig del av hans vardag.

För att må bra behöver han struktur, förutsägbarhet och lugna vuxna omkring sig.

Ibland kan han bli frustrerad och få utåtagerande beteenden. Därför söker vi dig som är lugn, trygg och har förmågan att behålla lugnet även i svåra situationer. Vi arbetar med lågaffektivt bemötande, tydlighet och respekt för pojkens behov.

När relationen fungerar som bäst kan han vara rolig, nyfiken och social.

Arbetet sker främst i pojkens hem där han bor tillsammans med sina föräldrar. Du blir en viktig del av hans vardag och arbetar nära familjen för att skapa trygghet, struktur och en positiv vardag.

Du får ordentlig introduktion och inskolning, så att du i lugn takt kan lära känna pojken, rutinerna och arbetssättet.

Passar även studenter

Detta arbete kan vara särskilt intressant för dig som studerar eller planerar att studera exempelvis psykologi, beteendevetenskap, specialpedagogik, arbetsterapi eller liknande områden, och vill få värdefull praktisk erfarenhet av arbete med barn inom NPF.

Vad arbetet innebär

Som personlig assistent kommer du bland annat att:

    Vara ett tryggt stöd i pojkens vardag
    Hjälpa till att skapa struktur och lugn
    Hitta på aktiviteter och stimulera hans intressen
    Delta i promenader och andra uteaktiviteter
    Hantera svåra situationer med ett lugnt och lågaffektivt bemötande
    Jobba med kommunikationshjälpmedel
    Samarbeta nära med familjen

Det är ett arbete där relationen och förtroendet är det viktigaste.

Vem vi tror att du är

Du är en person som:

    Har erfarenhet av autism eller intellektuell funktionsnedsättning. Gärna i kombination.
    Är lugn, stabil och trygg i dig själv
    Har tålamod och ett lågaffektivt förhållningssätt
    Kan vara tydlig utan att bli hård
    Har fantasi och kan hitta på aktiviteter
    Trivs i ett arbete där relation och trygghet byggs över tid

Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet och personlig mognad.

📍 Om tjänsten

Plats: Sollentuna

Omfattning: deltid / heltid / timanställning

Arbetstider: dag och kväll

Start: enligt överenskommelse

I din ansökan ska du ange medborgarskap. Om du inte är medborgare i Sverige, EU, EES eller Schweiz måste du kunna styrka att du har ett permanent uppehållstillstånd i Sverige för att kunna få anställning i Särnmark. Om du söker arbete som personlig assistent hos en vuxen kund behöver du uppvisa ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret.Du beställer registerutdraget via Polisens hemsida, här: https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/arbete-i-hemmet-med-aldre-och-personer-med-funktionsnedsattning-e-tjanst/Om du söker arbete som personlig assistent hos ett barn som är under 18 år behöver du också kunna uppvisa ett giltigt utdrag ur belastningsregistret innan du får börja arbeta. Du beställer registerutdraget via Polisens hemsida, här: https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/barn-med-funktionsnedsattning/

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager (FR)

Senior Technical Program Manager, Paris

About Genesis
Genesis is a physical AI research lab and full-stack robotics company building a universal robotics foundation model (one AI "brain" that can power many kinds of robots) and a horizontal robotics platform. We work in San Francisco, Paris and London and combine large-scale AI research, an in-house physics simulation engine, and real robot hardware under one roof.

The role
You'll be the person who turns our most ambitious bets into shipped results. You'll sit between researchers, hardware engineers, software engineers and leadership, across two continents, making sure everyone knows what matters, who owns it and when it lands.

What you'll do

  • Drive cross-functional programs at the frontier of AI and robotics, from foundation model training to hardware–software integration, with pace and accountability

  • Turn ambitious goals into lean, unambiguous roadmaps: clear deliverables, clear owners, clear timelines

  • Dive into robotics hardware, software, simulation, and large-scale AI to understand trade-offs, surface uncertainties, and ask the questions others miss

  • Keep Bay Area and Paris teams tightly aligned, dependencies unblocked, and risks visible early

  • Build lightweight systems (roadmaps, metrics, dashboards) that keep execution focused on what matters

  • Leverage AI to build automated program management workflows, so status updates, risk tracking, and reporting run themselves and the team spends its time on real decisions

What you'll bring

  • 4+ years leading complex technical programs end-to-end in fast-moving environments (startup, research lab, or high-growth tech)

  • Enough technical fluency to hold a real conversation with an ML researcher about a training run and with a hardware engineer about an integration test, so you can challenge an estimate, spot a hidden dependency, or flag a risk before it becomes a delay

  • A track record of learning a new technical domain quickly and becoming useful in it within weeks, not months

  • Crisp, direct communication that aligns researchers, engineers, and leadership

  • Bias for action: many decisions can be reversed and you favor speed over endless analysis

  • Ownership: you own the outcome and drive the process to get tangible results

Bonus

  • Experience in robotics, hardware/software integration, or research workflows

  • Fluency in French

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Nabla

We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine.

Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day.

We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows.

Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere.

This is a great time to join us!

The best of AI at the service of healthcare

Led by former Meta AI Research engineers, our team has consistently anticipated how AI can revolutionize healthcare delivery. Our Machine Learning team continually leverages the latest advancements to unlock AI’s full potential in healthcare.

Yann LeCun, Meta’s ex-Chief AI Scientist and Turing award winner, is an advisor to Nabla. He’s now focused on AMI Labs, with whom we have a close partnership.

Engineering at Nabla

Engineering at Nabla is lean, fast-moving, and deeply technical. Our teams span machine learning, native desktop applications, and platform infrastructure to deliver AI into clinical settings reliably and at scale.

Your Team

At Nabla, product development is led jointly by Engineering and Product, and organized into cross-functional squads, each focused on a specific product area. Squads bring together product managers, designers, engineers of different profiles, and domain experts, and operate with a high level of ownership.

As an AI Engineer, you’ll join one of these squads and contribute end to end to a specific part of the product.

What you'll do

As an AI/ML Software Engineer, you’ll play a key role in redefining clinicians’ workflows, unlocking better care for patients, and ensuring Nabla remains at the forefront of AI innovation. You will take ownership of high-impact projects and contribute to the growth and maturity of our engineering team and product.

Within a team of experts who have built large-scale production systems at Meta, Google, and Microsoft, you will:

  • Build agentic pipelines: chains of LLM-based agents that work together on complex clinical documentation tasks.

  • Go beyond ambient scribing to fully redefine clinicians’ workflows with AI, unlocking transformative efficiencies and improved patient care.

  • Integrate LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others) into production features.

  • Design prompts and build evaluation frameworks to measure and improve output quality, then iterate quickly based on results.

  • Write clean, production-grade code and own your features end to end, from design to deployment and monitoring in a live healthcare setting.

  • Work closely with product managers to turn model capabilities into reliable, scalable product features.

To get a sense of the impact you’ll have:

  • Nabla processes 300 billion tokens/month with LLMs.

  • By the time you’ve read this posting, Nabla will have transcribed 100 new hours of live audio and generated 500 new clinical notes, saving 125 hours of doctor time.

Your DNA:

The ideal candidate will bring strong software engineering skills and a practical, hands-on approach to building with LLMs.

  • You have 3+ years writing production code, with solid skills in software design, testing, and system architecture.

  • You’re proficient in one or more widely used back-end languages (Java, Kotlin, C++, Go, etc.).

  • You’ve built features or products using LLM provider APIs, including prompting and evaluation. You don’t need to have trained or fine-tuned models yourself.

  • You can turn a fuzzy product requirement into a working, testable pipeline.

  • You have a passion for going beyond the status quo to redefine workflows and unlock better care for patients.

  • You communicate clearly and effectively.

  • Bonus: Experience building multi-agent systems or agent orchestration frameworks is a strong plus.

Our Stack

  • Kotlin for backend services

  • LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, and others) for the models themselves

  • Agent orchestration frameworks for building chains of agents

  • Prompt evaluation and testing tools to track output quality over time

  • Google Cloud & Kubernetes for deployment

Where you'll be based

Our offices are based in Paris 3e (Arts & Métiers).
Remote policy: 1-2 days a week (with some flexibility). Possibility of working remotely 1-2 weeks once a year.

Benefits

Just like we’re dedicated to supporting doctors’ well-being, ensuring yours is a top priority. We firmly believe that by prioritizing your well-being, we support you to excel in your work.

Here are the benefits you get when joining Nabla:

  • Stock ownership

  • 100% healthcare coverage

  • Meal vouchers

  • Public transportation costs covered at 50%

  • Exercise class during the workday: Yoga, running, pilates, HIIT

  • Unlimited budget for book purchases, so you can continue to learn about ML / Healthcare

  • Culture of trust & accountability — your output matters more than your clock-in time

Life at Nabla

When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed.

We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. jobs.title: Senior UI Designer
jobs.description:
Would you like to shape how players experience a game, from the first interaction to the details that make each feature easy and enjoyable to use?

As a Senior UI Designer at Snowprint, you’ll design and implement UI for our games, working closely with designers, developers, artists, and other disciplines to turn ideas into experiences that players can use and enjoy. You’ll have ownership of your work, from early concepts and wireframes through to testing and improvement.

At Snowprint Studios, we believe that kindness, collaboration, curiosity, and self-leadership are what make great games possible. We work in small teams where people are trusted to take ownership, share ideas openly, and contribute beyond their own discipline. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how we approach UI, establish good practices, and help create experiences that put the player first.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll design UI for new features and game systems, creating wireframes, mockups, and interaction patterns that make complex functionality clear and easy to use. You’ll bring your designs into Unity using UI Toolkit, working hands-on to turn them into polished, functional experiences.

You’ll playtest and evaluate your work regularly, gathering feedback and using it to improve the player experience. You’ll work closely with game designers, client developers, artists, and other team members throughout planning, development, and testing.

You’ll also contribute to how we work with UI as a discipline. This includes establishing best practices, creating useful workflows, and helping maintain consistency across the game. You’ll have room to influence the direction of the UI while balancing design principles with the practical realities of production.

Is this you?

You’re an experienced UI Designer with professional experience designing for games, including mobile and touch interfaces. You have worked on at least one game in a free-to-play, midcore, turn-based strategy, live-operated, or external IP environment, with experience across several of these areas being particularly relevant.

You have experience implementing UI in Unity, and if you have experience with UI Toolkit that would be great. You’re comfortable working with tools such as Figma, the Google Suite, and Adobe Suite, and have experience with version control such as GitHub.

You care about practical UI/UX design and getting your work into the hands of players. You understand common patterns and best practices in mobile games, but also know when consistency needs to give way to a better solution for the player or the product.

You pay attention to detail and understand that not every problem needs a perfect solution. You’re comfortable giving and receiving feedback, asking questions, and discussing your ideas openly. You take ownership of your work and enjoy working with others to find solutions that balance design, technical constraints, and production needs.

Where you’ll work

Our Stockholm studio is located in Södermalm, with a hybrid working model. We work from the office on Tuesdays and Fridays to support collaboration and social interaction. Other days, you can work from wherever you feel most productive. We provide the setup and tools you need to work comfortably.

About Snowprint Studios

Snowprint Studios believes great games are created by teams of talented, kind and creative individuals working together in a friendly, supportive and inspiring environment — while maintaining a sustainable life-work balance.

Our games include Legends of Solgard, Rivengard, and Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus. We care about making great games and creating an environment where people can do their best work together.

For more information on Snowprint Studios, visit our website and follow us on social media.

At Snowprint Studios, we embrace diversity both in the worlds we create and in our workplace.

Good to know

We are an international company with many nationalities represented. Our company language is English, so your application should therefore be in English.

jobs.title: Vi søker regionsleder for Prima Assistanse Vestland
jobs.description:
I Prima Assistanse jobber vi hver dag for at mennesker med funksjonsnedsettelser skal kunne delta i samfunnet på lik linje med alle andre, gjennom BPA (brukerstyrt personlig assistanse). Vi kaller det frihet til å leve.

Vi er en betydelig aktør i et voksende marked, med en omsetning på ca. 800 MNOK, 11 kontorer over hele landet og 4000 assistenter. Vi har det gøy på jobb, og verdiene våre er humor, tillit, fleksibilitet og lagarbeid. Svært sentralt for oss er å utvikle det gode arbeidsmiljøet. Når folkene våre er fornøyde, blir kundene det også.


Om rollen

Vi skal vokse i Vestland og søker en leder som vil drive regionen som sin egen, med ansvar for lønnsom vekst, drift og utvikling. Regionen har i dag rundt 50 kunder og 300 assistenter, og en omsetning på ca. 50 MNOK. Du starter med tre engasjerte og dyktige medarbeidere på kontoret, og du får ansvaret for å bygge teamet videre.

Rollen passer for deg som motiveres av både resultater og relasjoner, og som vil bruke lederkompetansen din til å skape en positiv forskjell for kunder, kollegaer og assistenter. Du rapporterer til administrerende direktør og blir del av et nasjonalt lederteam med 10 andre ledere du kan sparre med. På hovedkontoret i Oslo har du HR, økonomi, lønn, marked og kvalitet i ryggen, så du kan bruke tiden på å drive og utvikle regionen. Du vil med andre ord aldri være alene i rollen. Du trenger heller ikke erfaring fra BPA, vi lærer deg bransjen.


Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Personalledelse og oppfølging av medarbeidere
  • Ansvar for budsjett, økonomi og resultatoppfølging
  • Oppfølging av kunder og kvalitet i tjenesteleveransen
  • Salg, relasjonsbygging og markedsarbeid for BPA-tjenester i regionen
  • Bygge og ivareta gode relasjoner med kommuner og samarbeidspartnere
  • Videreutvikling og vekst i regionen
  • Utvikle et godt arbeidsmiljø og en sterk organisasjonskultur


Vi ser etter deg som har

  • Erfaring med personal- og resultatansvar, gjerne fra handel, service eller franchise
  • Evne til å sette retning og få med deg folk
  • Forretningssans og evne til å se muligheter og skape resultater
  • Forståelse for at god kvalitet i tjenesten er grunnlaget for lønnsom vekst
  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne, og lett for å bygge relasjoner
  • Gjerne relevant utdanning innen økonomi eller ledelse
  • Motivasjon for å lede i en virksomhet med et tydelig samfunnsoppdrag


Vi tilbyr

  • En meningsfull jobb i en bransje og et selskap i vekst
  • Stor mulighet til å påvirke og utvikle regionen og rollen
  • Et uformelt og sosialt arbeidsmiljø, med rom for både faglige diskusjoner og gode samtaler rundt lunsjbordet
  • Kontor sentralt i Åsane med gode bussforbindelser og parkering
  • Lønn etter kompetanse og erfaring, og bonusordninger som belønner gode resultater


Ønsker du en uformell og konfidensiell prat før du søker, ta gjerne kontakt med HR-direktør Kjersti Sandvik på 932 23 623 eller ks@primanordic.no.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

I Prima Assistanse ser vi stor verdi av å være en mangfoldig organisasjon. Derfor ønsker vi at du uavhengig av etnisitet, alder, kjønn, legning, funksjonsnedsettelse, utdanning eller bakgrunn søker på jobb hos oss. Gjennom verdiene våre "humor, tillit, fleksibilitet og lagarbeid" jobber vi hver dag for at alle skal få frihet til å leve! BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. For mer informasjon: www.prima-assistanse.no

jobs.title: Gör skillnad i vardagen- bli timvikarie i Helsingborg med omnejd!
jobs.description:
Om arbetsplatsen



Furuboda Assistans är en privat assistansanordnare i södra Sverige med rötter i den ideella Föreningen Furuboda. Bolaget skapades år 2005 och är ett växande företag. I dagsläget består Furuboda Assistans av ca 700 medarbetare. Vi strävar efter att vara ett föredöme inom hållbart företagande. För oss handlar hållbart företagande om att ha ett starkt kundfokus, välmående personal samt att eftersträva en låg klimat- och miljö-påverkan.

Att arbeta som personlig assistent är mer än ett jobb. Hos oss får du möjlighet att lära känna en annan människa, vara en viktig del av vardagen och samtidigt utvecklas själv. Vi erbjuder ett tryggt och givande arbete där relation, lyhördhet och respekt står i centrum.

Om jobbet

Som personlig assistent stöttar du en av våra kunder i deras vardag så att hen kan leva ett så självständigt, aktivt och tryggt liv som möjligt. Alla våra uppdrag är unika och anpassade efter den person du arbetar hos.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:

    Hjälp med personlig omvårdnad
    Stöd i vardagliga sysslor och rutiner i hemmet
    Följa med på aktiviteter, utflykter eller träning
    Vara ett tryggt, närvarande och flexibelt stöd i vardagen
    Övriga uppgifter utifrån kundens specifika behov och önskemål

Arbetstiderna varierar (dag, kväll, natt och helg). Du kan arbeta hos en och samma kund över tid eller hos flera olika kunder utifrån din tillgänglighet och verksamhetens behov.

Vem söker vi?

Du behöver inte ha arbetat som personlig assistent tidigare – tidigare erfarenhet är meriterande, men vi lägger absolut störst vikt vid personlig lämplighet och matchning. Vi söker dig som:

    Är ansvarstagande, lyhörd och pålitlig
    Är trygg i dig själv och har ett genuint intresse för att arbeta med människor
    Är flexibel och anpassningsbar efter olika individers behov och personligheter

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Ett meningsfullt och utvecklande arbete där du gör skillnad på riktigt
    Grundlig introduktion och stöd inför dina uppdrag
    Ett flexibelt extrajobb utifrån dina möjligheter
    Goda möjligheter till fortsatt och mer omfattande arbete framöver

Ansökan

Vi rekryterar löpande. Du ansöker enkelt genom att svara på några korta frågor i vårt ansökningsformulär – inget CV eller personligt brev krävs.

Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag!

Övrigt



Som anställd på Furuboda Assistans blir du erbjuden ett meningsfullt arbete med trygg anställning, friskvårdsbidrag på 2500 kronor, utbildningar och möjlighet till att utvecklas i ditt uppdrag. Vi tycker det är viktigt att medarbetare känner glädje och gemenskap på jobbet, och erbjuder därför en rad olika aktiviteter. Hos oss får du precis som våra kunder vara precis den du är. Vi har kollektivavtal och är medlemmar i IfA, Intresseföreningen för assistansberättigade, och möter deras höga kvalitetskrav som IfA-godkänd anordnare av personlig assistans

jobs.title: Kundservicemedarbetare på Mallorca – skiftschema
jobs.description:
Kundservicemedarbetare på Mallorca

Har du service i fokus, gillar att hjälpa andra och drömmer om en vardag i solen när hösten närmar sig?

Vår kundserviceavdelning fortsätter att växa och vi söker nu 5 nya kollegor med start i början av november 2026 till vårt kontor i Palma de Mallorca. Vi söker dig som vill ta nästa steg i din karriär eller som vill upptäcka hur det är att bo och arbeta utomlands.

På Nordic Operation Center arbetar vi med både kundservice och telefonförsäljning för några av Nordens starkaste varumärken. Vi har en prestationsdriven arbetsmiljö med tydliga mål, tävlingar och en stark teamkultur.

Föreställ dig att kunna avsluta arbetsdagen med en promenad längs stranden, träna i solen eller äta middag i Palma tillsammans med dina nya kollegor. Här får du möjlighet att kombinera karriär med livsstil.

Arbetstiderna kan variera mellan dag, kväll och natt, beroende på vilket projekt du tilldelas.

Arbetet innebär bland annat att:

    Hantera bokningar och avbokningar

    Hjälpa både privat- och företagskunder

    Arbeta mot tydliga mål kopplade till kundnöjdhet och effektivitet

Du blir en viktig del av teamet, där din insats direkt påverkar både kundupplevelsen och resultatet.

Vi erbjuder

    Heltidstjänst med stegrande lön

    20 dagars betald semester per år

    Betald introduktion och utbildning

    Möjlighet att utvecklas och göra karriär inom bolaget

    En arbetsplats med stark gemenskap och högt engagemang

    Hjälp med spanska dokument, såsom NIE och socialförsäkring

    Bostadshjälp genom kontaktuppgifter till både mäklare och hyresvärdar

jobs.title: Timvikarier sökes till personlig assistans i Malmö med omnejd
jobs.description:
Om arbetsplatsen



Furuboda Assistans är en privat assistansanordnare i södra Sverige med rötter i den ideella Föreningen Furuboda. Bolaget skapades år 2005 och är ett växande företag. I dagsläget består Furuboda Assistans av ca 700 medarbetare. Vi strävar efter att vara ett föredöme inom hållbart företagande. För oss handlar hållbart företagande om att ha ett starkt kundfokus, välmående personal samt att eftersträva en låg klimat- och miljö-påverkan.

Vill du ha ett meningsfullt och utvecklande arbete där du gör verklig skillnad i en annan människas vardag? Vi söker nu ansvarsfulla och lyhörda timvikarier till flera av våra kunder i Kristianstad med omnejd.

Att arbeta som personlig assistent är mer än ett jobb. Hos oss får du möjlighet att lära känna en annan människa, vara en viktig del av vardagen och samtidigt utvecklas själv. Vi erbjuder ett tryggt och givande arbete där relation, lyhördhet och respekt står i centrum.

Om jobbet

Som personlig assistent stöttar du en av våra kunder i deras vardag så att hen kan leva ett så självständigt, aktivt och tryggt liv som möjligt. Alla våra uppdrag är unika och anpassade efter den person du arbetar hos.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:

    Hjälp med personlig omvårdnad
    Stöd i vardagliga sysslor och rutiner i hemmet
    Följa med på aktiviteter, utflykter eller träning
    Vara ett tryggt, närvarande och flexibelt stöd i vardagen
    Övriga uppgifter utifrån kundens specifika behov och önskemål

Arbetstiderna varierar (dag, kväll, natt och helg). Du kan arbeta hos en och samma kund över tid eller hos flera olika kunder utifrån din tillgänglighet och verksamhetens behov.

Vem söker vi?

Du behöver inte ha arbetat som personlig assistent tidigare – tidigare erfarenhet är meriterande, men vi lägger absolut störst vikt vid personlig lämplighet och matchning. Vi söker dig som:

    Är ansvarstagande, lyhörd och pålitlig
    Är trygg i dig själv och har ett genuint intresse för att arbeta med människor
    Är flexibel och anpassningsbar efter olika individers behov och personligheter

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Ett meningsfullt och utvecklande arbete där du gör skillnad på riktigt
    Grundlig introduktion och stöd inför dina uppdrag
    Ett flexibelt extrajobb utifrån dina möjligheter
    Goda möjligheter till fortsatt och mer omfattande arbete framöver

Ansökan

Vi rekryterar löpande. Du ansöker enkelt genom att svara på några korta frågor i vårt ansökningsformulär – inget CV eller personligt brev krävs.

Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag!

Övrigt



Som anställd på Furuboda Assistans blir du erbjuden ett meningsfullt arbete med trygg anställning, friskvårdsbidrag på 2500 kronor, utbildningar och möjlighet till att utvecklas i ditt uppdrag. Vi tycker det är viktigt att medarbetare känner glädje och gemenskap på jobbet, och erbjuder därför en rad olika aktiviteter. Hos oss får du precis som våra kunder vara precis den du är. Vi har kollektivavtal och är medlemmar i IfA, Intresseföreningen för assistansberättigade, och möter deras höga kvalitetskrav som IfA-godkänd anordnare av personlig assistans

jobs.title: Business & AI Transformation | Engagement Manager
jobs.description:
About Singulier

Singulier is a strategy, transaction advisory and AI transformation consulting firm supporting private equity funds, portfolio companies and established businesses on their most critical strategic and operational challenges. We combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution to help our clients make better decisions, accelerate value creation and deliver tangible business impact.

Singulier x OMMAX are joining forces to build a leading European AI management consulting platform, combining deep strategic expertise with technology, data and AI capabilities. Together, we support clients across the full value creation journey, from strategy and due diligence through transformation and execution.

We operate in a partner-led, entrepreneurial environment where consultants are expected to think critically, take ownership early, work directly with senior stakeholders and contribute to building long-term client impact.

The role

As an Engagement Manager - Business & AI Transformation, you will lead complex transformation engagements for clients facing critical strategic, operational and organisational challenges.

You will combine strategic thinking, product expertise and hands-on execution to translate business needs into high-impact transformation initiatives. Working at the intersection of business, product, technology, data and AI, you will help clients transform functions, teams, operating models and ways of working while ensuring that solutions create measurable and sustainable value.

You will lead taskforces composed of strategy consultants and senior digital experts located across France and the UK, with the support of a Principal or Partner.

What you will do ?

Lead transformation engagements

  • Lead business, product, technology, data and AI transformation programmes from initial framing through execution and closing.
  • Structure the problem, define the overall approach and organise the engagement into clear workstreams.
  • Translate business challenges into actionable transformation roadmaps, prioritised initiatives and concrete delivery plans.
  • Combine strategic analysis, product thinking and operational execution to accelerate impact.
  • Support the identification, prototyping, prioritisation and deployment of high-value solutions where relevant.
  • Drive problem-solving and analyses while maintaining a high level of quality and strategic coherence.
  • Ensure that transformation initiatives deliver tangible business outcomes and sustainable improvements in performance.

Lead clients and stakeholders

  • Manage the day-to-day client relationship with senior and C-level stakeholders.
  • Facilitate workshops, decision-making sessions and alignment discussions across business, product and technology teams.
  • Translate between business priorities, operational requirements and technical possibilities.
  • Handle complex queries and challenges with confidence and pragmatism.
  • Navigate complex, political and multi-stakeholder environments successfully.
  • Build trust with clients by combining strategic perspective, delivery discipline and a strong focus on outcomes.

Own project delivery

  • Lead projects from execution to closing, ensuring that timelines, milestones and team responsibilities remain on track.
  • Manage resources, team capacity and end-products while contributing to project profitability.
  • Participate in setting up the appropriate team of strategy consultants and digital experts.
  • Ensure the quality, consistency and executive-readiness of all key deliverables.
  • Anticipate risks, resolve delivery issues and maintain alignment with the client and the Singulier leadership team.
  • Ensure the appropriate capitalisation of project knowledge, methodologies and reusable assets.

Contribute to business development

  • Contribute to building proposals and responding to client opportunities with the support of Partners, Principals, Directors and practice leaders.
  • Help shape the problem statement, transformation approach, workplan, team structure and commercial scope.
  • Identify opportunities to extend client relationships and support the growth of Singulier’s transformation offering.
  • Bring innovative ideas to proposals, client presentations and problem-solving discussions.
  • Contribute to the development of Singulier’s market positioning and thought leadership on business, product, technology, data and AI transformation.

Develop people and build the firm

  • Lead and develop teams of consultants and digital experts across engagements.
  • Coach Consultants, Analysts and junior team members, helping them build both consulting and transformation capabilities.
  • Provide clear direction, feedback and support throughout projects.
  • Contribute to internal initiatives, methodology development, knowledge sharing and recruitment.
  • Help strengthen the culture, capabilities and long-term growth of Singulier.

Requirements

What we’re looking for

  • 4–5+ years of experience in a strategy, digital, product, technology or business transformation consulting firm.
  • Proven experience leading complex transformation programmes in environments involving multiple stakeholders.
  • The ability to combine strategic vision, structured problem-solving and operational execution.
  • Experience working across business, product, technology, data or AI topics.
  • A strong understanding of how technology, data and AI can transform business functions, operating models and ways of working.
  • Experience translating business needs into transformation roadmaps, prioritised initiatives or actionable delivery plans.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, timelines, resources and deliverables.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills, with confidence operating at senior and C-level.
  • Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly.
  • Demonstrated commercial abilities and an interest in contributing to proposals and business development.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset, with the autonomy, pragmatism and proactivity required to thrive in a fast-growing environment.
  • Fluency in both French and English is required.

Benefits

Why join Singulier?

  • Work at the intersection of strategy, business transformation, product, technology, data and AI.
  • Lead high-impact engagements with senior executives, investors and ambitious businesses.
  • Combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and tangible client outcomes.
  • Work in international taskforces alongside experienced consultants and digital experts.
  • Benefit from significant autonomy, exposure to senior leadership and the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a fast-scaling consulting platform.

Recruitment process

Recruitment process

  • Recruiter interview with Marie Gouze, Talent Acquisition Lead
  • Business Fit Interview, with Clément Huguet, Director & Hiring Manager [1h]
  • Case 1 [1h]
  • Case 2 [1h]
  • Fit with a Partner, with
  • A final call with a member of the leadership team, including a brain teaser

jobs.title: Control System Development Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a hands-on Control Systems Engineer to lead and support the development and sustaining of SIMATIC SPPA-T3000 and PCS 7 control system for our medium gas turbines. As a part of our team, you will develop and maintain control system software applications for our medium gas turbines to ensure our products meet the requirements set in the market. The position requires close collaboration and working alongside other departments and designers to integrate control system into the overall design of MGT products.

How You Will Make an Impact

    Be a part of a highly skilled development team responsible for the development and maintenance of control system software applications for the MGT products.
    Be responsible for the engineering work and technical solutions in the assigned development projects, working closely with the project team and project manager to ensure that the design meets specified requirements aligned with the technical road map.
    Design and configure T3000 and PCS 7 control systems, including control logic, hardware setup, server and computer networks, safety systems, trip chains, and HMI/OS displays, while adhering to configuration management, version control, and rigorous testing to ensure system integrity.
    Integrate field instrumentation and subsystems; manage communications via common industrial protocols (e.g., ProfNet, Profibus, Modbus TCP, and OPC).
    Apply industry standards and best practices for safety, quality, and cybersecurity.
    Consistently acquire new skills and knowledge while sharing them by mentoring and assisting others over time. Contribute to enhancing our processes and methods to improve team performance and project outcomes within the team’s responsibilities.

What You Will Bring

    Bachelor’s or master’s degree in control engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field.
    3+ years of experience working with automation and control technologies, with an interest in new technologies and the use of existing technologies in new contexts.
    Proficient English skills, allowing you to express yourself fluently and communicate effectively at a professional level.
    Excellent interpersonal skills combined with experience working with colleagues and customers in international settings.

Experience in the following areas is advantageous:

    SPPA-T3000 and/or PCS 7
    Modeling and simulation in MATLAB or a related tool
    Functional Safety (SIL)
    Cybersecurity
    System networking and VMware

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. jobs.title: Bo og mestring, 100 % fast stilling
jobs.description:
Om enheten Bo og mestring

Bo og mestring gir tjenester til mennesker med ulike funksjonsvariasjoner og behov for støtte i hverdagen. Enheten består av flere avdelinger og tilbyr:

  • Heldøgns botilbud for personer med ulike funksjonsvariasjoner
  • Ulike avlastningstilbud for barn og unge
  • Dagtilbud for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjoner
  • Ambulerende miljøtjenester

Hos oss møter du et tverrfaglig miljø med høy kompetanse og stort engasjement. Vi har fokus på faglig utvikling, samarbeid og et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø.

Vi søker en medarbeider til en spennende og variert stilling som er delt ca. 50/50 mellom dagsenter og ambulerende miljøtjenester (AMT). Stillingen er praktisk og arbeidsrettet, med fokus på å utvikle og etablere nye aktiviteter og arbeidsoppgaver ved dagsenteret. I AMT vil du ha ansvar for boveiledning, og punkttjenester til unge voksne, og ulike avlastningstilbud til barn og unge. Du vil være en viktig bidragsyter i videreutviklingen av tjenestetilbudet.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Støtte og veilede personer med bistandsbehov
  • Tilrettelegge for arbeid, aktivitet og en meningsfull fritid
  • Bidra til videreutvikling og gjennomføring av arbeidsoppdrag og oppdrag ved dagsenteret.
  • Motivere og veilede til økt selvstendighet og mestring
  • Planlegge og gjennomføre aktiviteter individuelt og i grupper.
  • Dokumentere og følge opp tiltak etter gjeldende rutiner.

 Kvalifikasjoner

  • Fagbrev innen helse- og omsorgsfag, aktivitørfaget, sosialfaglige fag eller relevante håndverksfag. Annen relevant kompetanse eller bred erfaring fra arbeid med mennesker, praktisk tilrettelegging eller arbeidsrettet oppfølging blir også vurdert, og oppfordres til å søke.
  • Erfaring fra arbeid med mennesker med funksjonsvariasjoner
  • Kjennskap til målrettet miljøarbeid og veiledning
  • Gode ferdigheter i norsk, skriftlig og muntlig
  • Førerkort klasse B

 Personlige egenskaper

  • Tar ansvar, er selvstendig og handlekraftig, men samtidig fleksibel og god på samarbeid
  • Engasjert, strukturert og løsningsorientert
  • Er god til å motivere og skape gode relasjoner
  • Gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter
  • Liker uforutsigbare hverdager på brukerens premisser
  • Evne til å stå i utfordrende situasjoner
  • Har et positivt menneskesyn og ser muligheter fremfor begrensninger
  • Du må trives med, og bidra til å finne frem til små og store praktiske arbeidsoppgaver, f.eks. snekring, maling, hagearbeid, vedlikeholdsarbeida, flytteoppgaver etc.

 Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt ved ansettelse

 Vi tilbyr

  • Varierte og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med takhøyde, arbeidsglede og humor
  • Mulighet for faglig utvikling
  • Turnusarbeid dag/kveld, hver 4. helg
  • Lønn etter tariff som fagarbeider
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger gjennom KLP

 Annet

Politiattest må fremlegges ved tiltredelse.

Oppdal er fjellbygda i Midt-Norge, også kjent for Norges største alpine skiområde. jobs.title: BPA-assistent søkes til gutt på 12 år på Godøya
jobs.employer: PRIMA ASSISTANSE AS AVD MØRE OG ROMSDAL
jobs.description:
Jeg er en blid, aktiv og fornøyd gutt på 12 år som bor på Godøya sammen med familien min og katten vår.

Jeg liker å være ute og finne på ting. Jeg synes det er gøy med turer, sykling, bilturer, bading, lek og husking. Jeg liker også å ha det hyggelig sammen med andre.

Jeg er nonverbal autist og trenger derfor litt ekstra støtte i hverdagen. Nå ser jeg etter en trygg, rolig og aktiv assistent som har lyst til å bli med på ulike aktiviteter og være sammen med meg etter skolen.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Hente meg etter skolen
  • Være sammen med meg og finne på aktiviteter
  • Bli med på turer, sykling, bilturer og bading
  • Lek og aktiviteter både ute og inne
  • Hjelpe til med påkledning og personlig hygiene
  • Gi meg støtte og trygghet i hverdagen

Mamma og pappa vil være arbeidsledere og sørge for at du får den opplæringen og veiledningen du trenger for å kunne utføre oppgavene dine på en trygg og god måte. Arbeidsstedet ditt vil være i en avlastningsbolig sammen med andre og i hjemmet mitt. Jeg har behov for at du som BPA-assistent er med meg dit, slik at jeg får den stabiliteten, fleksibiliteten og tryggheten jeg trenger i hverdagen. Det er viktig for meg å ha en kjent og trygg person med meg i avlastningsboligen. Din tilstedeværelse vil bidra til forutsigbarhet og gjøre det lettere for meg å delta i aktiviteter og være sammen med andre på en trygg måte.

Arbeidstiden er:

  • Tirsdag kl. 14.00–19.00
  • Onsdag kl. 14.00–19.00
  • Torsdag kl. 14.00–19.00
  • Hver 3.lørdag

Dette er et vikariat i 40% stilling, med mulighet for forlengelse. Det er et krav at du har førerkort.

Hvem ser jeg etter?

  • Rolig, tålmodig og trygg
  • Aktiv og glad i å være ute
  • Flink til å kommunisere og skape en god relasjon til barn
  • Pålitelig og ansvarsfull
  • Komfortabel med å være med på ulike aktiviteter

Du må kunne kommunisere godt på norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig.

Det er ikke nødvendig med formell utdanning. Det viktigste er at vi har god kjemi, og at du har lyst til å være en positiv og trygg person i hverdagen min.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper jeg du tar kontakt!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Project planner
jobs.description:
Nordec is a supplier of steel frame structures and façade solutions for construction projects across the Nordic region, with an established presence in Central and Eastern Europe, including Poland, Lithuania, the Czech Republic and Germany.

The company designs, fabricates and installs steel structures for buildings and bridges, covering the project lifecycle from engineering to installation. Projects range from industrial facilities, logistics buildings, data centres, commercial, public, sports and cultural buildings, and bridges. Nordec operates its own production units in Peräseinäjoki and Ylivieska in Finland, Oborniki in Poland and Gargždai in Lithuania.

For more information, visit www.nordec.com.

Our Multi-storey unit continues to grow, and we are now looking to strengthen our team with a

**_PROJECT PLANNER_**

**_Would you like to play a key role in ensuring that complex international projects progress according to plan?_**

As a Project Planner, you will be responsible for preparing, maintaining and monitoring overall project schedules. You will plan project activities and their dependencies, while coordinating schedules across engineering, procurement, production, logistics and installation. You will monitor project progress, anticipate potential delays and scheduling risks, and provide project management and customers with up-to-date information on project status. You will be involved in projects from the tendering phase through to execution, working closely with the Project Manager and the wider project organisation.

To succeed in this role, you have previous experience in project planning and scheduling, along with a good understanding of overall project schedules, activity dependencies, progress monitoring, forecasting and reporting. Experience in EPC/EPCM, industrial, construction, data centre, battery factory or other demanding large-scale projects provides a strong foundation for the role. You can take independent responsibility for project planning and scheduling.

The role requires experience with Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project, as well as a relevant technical degree, for example in civil, construction or mechanical engineering. Strong English skills are essential. You should also be able to communicate in Finnish with your team, while Swedish language skills are considered an advantage. For a candidate with extensive relevant experience, the position may be offered with the title Planning Manager.

An analytical, structured and systematic approach to work is important in this role, along with strong collaboration skills and the ability to take responsibility as part of the wider project organisation.
